documents.title: 개인정보 보호법 [시행 2026. 9. 11.] [법률 제21445호, 2026. 3. 10., 일부개정]
documents.title_native: 개인정보 보호법
documents.issuer: 대한민국 국회 (소관: 개인정보보호위원회)
documents.key_dates: 개정 2026-03-10(법률 제21445호), 시행 2026-09-11(부칙 제1조: 공포 후 6개월 경과일). 부칙 제1조 단서: 제32조의2제1항 단서·제75조제2항제15호는 2027-07-01 시행. 이 PDF에는 아직 시행되지 않은 조문이 '[시행일: 2027. 3. 9.]' 표시와 함께 실려 있다: 제2조(제9호 인공지능기술 정의 추가), 제7조의9, 제28조의12~제28조의15(제5절 '인공지능기술 개발을 위한 개인정보 처리의 특례', 2026-09-08 신설), 제37조의2(2026-09-08 개정). 같은 조문이 현행 문안과 시행예정 문안으로 두 번 인쇄되므로 현행 문안(먼저 나오는 것)만 2026-10-17 기준으로 시행 중이다. 이 PDF에서 2026-03-10 개정·신설 표시를 확인한 조문: 제23조, 제24조, 제24조의2, 제25조, 제26조, 제28조의4, 제28조의7, 제29조, 제30조의3(신설), 제31조, 제31조의2, 제32조의2, 제34조, 제39조의2, 제58조, 제64조의2, 제75조.

defect_list.description: scope_ko said the 보호책임자 designation duty is imposed on processors meeting the 종업원 수·매출액 criteria. Art. 31(1) proviso (lines 990-992) is the opposite: those processors MAY omit designation and the business owner/representative becomes the officer (Art. 31(2)).

Said the 2026-03-10 amendment 'made 접속기록 보관 explicit in the body'. The text shows <개정 2015. 7. 24., 2026. 3. 10.> and gives no basis for what changed. The phrase cannot be tied to the 2026 amendment from the extract or the official page.
'접속기록 보관기간은 안전성 확보조치 기준 고시에 위임' is not in the statute, which only says 대통령령. It came from outside the text.
Obligation said '동의 외 사유로 수집할 때도'. Art. 16(1) applies to collection under any item of Art. 15(1), consent included (item 1).
Obligation listed '국외 이전 관련 사항' as a mandatory 처리방침 item. Art. 30(1) items 1-8 contain no such item. The 공개 duty is in Art. 30(2), so the ref also needed the 제2항.
Obligation omitted the 제1항 단서 exemption and that the 이사회 의결 applies only to 법인 (제3항제1호).
'가중한다' (mandatory enhancement) vs text '부과할 수 있다' up to 100분의 10. Item 1 also requires 고의·중대한 과실 for both violations; this was missing.
strength was 'mandatory' for an authority power phrased '명할 수 있다'. Aligned with the 과징금 provisions, which are marked informative.
Claimed the PIPC 생성형 AI 안내서 recommends 영향평가. That document was not read and is not in the extract. It also said 민간 has no duty, but Art. 33(11) says non-public processors must make 적극 노력.
Said the cap is based on 전체 매출액 only. Art. 64-2(3) computes the fine on revenue excluding revenue unrelated to the violation (amended 2026-03-10).

Listed only 5 articles with 2026-03-10 marks and omitted that the PDF prints not-yet-effective versions. Those are 2027-03-09: 제2조 9호, 제7조의9, new 제28조의12~15 (신설 2026-09-08), 제37조의2. And 2027-07-01: 제32조의2제1항 단서, 제75조제2항제15호 (부칙 제1조 단서).
Dropped the precondition that anonymous or pseudonymous processing can still achieve the collection purpose.
Text is permissive ('수집할 수 있으며'); note said '해당할 때만'. Kept mandatory, but added the Art. 18(1) prohibition on use beyond the Art. 15(1) range, which supports the restrictive reading.
Omitted the 제1항 단서 (연락처를 알 수 없는 등 정당한 사유 시 통지 갈음 조치). In 제4항 '항목' was vague; the text says 제1항 각 호의 사항 and 전문기관 is set by 대통령령.

G-codes are WBS items marked '일부 구현' with planned development in mapping.bak.json, yet the controls were written as things the product already does. Reworded the provision 1, 29 and 33 controls as candidates and added a caveat to limitations_ko.

'표본 9곳 모두 일치' and '2026-09-17 인쇄' were not verifiable. The date is only the PDF metadata creationDate. The Copyright Act Art. 7 quote was paraphrased. Art. 7(4) (편집물) was not cited although it covers the 법제처 compilation. I verified 7 articles against law.go.kr, confirmed the SHA-256 matches provenance.json, and fetched Art. 7 (시행 2026-08-11, 법률 제21336호). The notice and reason now state only what was verified.

doc_level_changes: edition and key_dates now state that the PDF also prints future-effective versions (2027-03-09 and 2027-07-01) and list the 2026-03-10 amendment marks found in the extract
scope_ko corrected (제31조 inversion fixed, 제33조제11항 and 제58조의2 added)
pitfalls_ko: PIPC-guide claim fixed, fine-base nuance added, two new pitfalls (시행예정 문안 혼재, 제31조제1항 단서 면제)
reading_scope_ko and limitations_ko updated: reviewer-verified items, 7-article comparison with law.go.kr, G-code caveat, future-effective text not separately verified
license_notice and distribution_reason rewritten from the fetched Copyright Act Art. 7 (1호·4호). Distribution stays public-under-license; the law.go.kr site terms were not checked.
Official page re-checked: the law.go.kr lsId=011357 page and the lsiSeq=283839 page both show '시행 2026. 9. 11. 법률 제21445호, 2026. 3. 10. 일부개정'. status in_force is unchanged.
remaining_concerns: The new 제5절 (제28조의12~제28조의15, AI development special rules, effective 2027-03-09) is in the PDF but has no provision. The brief forbids adding provisions; consider a follow-up note.
The 2027-03-09 and 2027-07-01 versions were not compared with the official site. Only the current text was compared (7 articles), and the 2026-09-08 amending law number is not shown in the PDF.
Art. 15(1) and 17(1) are permissive in wording ('할 수 있다') but kept as mandatory on the basis of Art. 18(1) and the 제64조의2 sanctions. A strict 'shall only' reading would make them informative.
Implementing decree, notices and PIPC guides were not read. 유출 notification deadlines and 접속기록 retention periods are not established by this note.
The G-codes in gateway_control_ko are WBS references and were not verified against the shipped product.
law.go.kr's own terms of use or copyright policy were not checked. The distribution rests on Copyright Act Art. 7(1)/(4) only.

documents.title: 신용정보의 이용 및 보호에 관한 법률 [시행 2026. 9. 11.] [법률 제21445호, 2026. 3. 10., 타법개정]
documents.title_native: 신용정보의 이용 및 보호에 관한 법률 (약칭: 신용정보법)
documents.issuer: 대한민국 국회 (소관: 금융위원회)
documents.key_dates: 현행본은 시행 2026-09-11, 법률 제21445호(공포 2026-03-10, 타법개정)이며 본문 제20조제4항·제5항에 2026-03-10 개정 표시가 있다. 이 판에는 법률 제21646호(공포 2026-05-12, 일부개정)의 부칙이 포함돼 있다. 그 부칙은 공포 후 3개월이 지난 날부터 시행(국가법령정보센터 목록상 시행 2026-08-13)한다고 하고, 제44조의2~제44조의5(채무조정기구 특례)는 시행일부터 3년간 효력을 가진다고 한다(본문 표시: 2029-08-12까지 유효).

defect_list.description: key_dates omitted the 법률 제21646호 (공포 2026-05-12, 일부개정, 시행 2026-08-13 per 국가법령정보센터 API) 부칙 that is embedded in this 2026-09-11 version, and the 3-year sunset of 제44조의2~5 (유효 until 2029-08-12). The note presented only 21445 / 3-10 / 9-11.

Scope sentence restricted 신용정보제공·이용자 to those 'designated by decree' (that wording is from 제20조제3항 CPO rule). The Act applies to 신용정보회사등 (제15조제1항), which includes all 신용정보제공·이용자 (제2조제7호). Also 'overstated 가중 적용' with 개인정보 보호법 was an unsupported legal conclusion.

Claim that 'sample 24 places all matched' the current official page could not be reproduced. Replaced with what was actually verified: header/version plus all 11 anchors found in the official 현행 본문 (시행 2026-09-11). Also stated the PDF is a user-supplied zip copy.

Licence text asserted 저작권법 제7조제1호 only and said 'checked'. Re-verified via official law API (제7조제1호 and 제4호, 시행 2026-08-11 현행본, 공포 21336). Rewritten to state exactly this evidence, note that 법제처 인쇄본 falls under the 제4호 편집물 only by inference, and that no site-level 이용약관/저작권 정책 statement was found. Korea is not in the centrally verified list, so the decision rests on the statutory exclusion (same logic as PRC Art. 5(1)); kept public-under-license with caveat.

Statement that 개인정보 보호법 제37조의2 governs general automated-decision rights is not in the extract. Confirmed only the article title via official API (자동화된 결정에 대한 정보주체의 권리 등); marked as outside the PDF and body unread. Also added the omitted 제36조의2제3항 refusal grounds.
Obligation omitted that 제36조의2제3항 lets 개인신용평가회사등 refuse the request (legal-obligation compliance, relationship impracticable, decree cases). Presented as unconditional.
Same omission of the 제3항 refusal grounds.

Stated as fact that the gateway applies masking/pseudonymisation/encryption and TLS. Only masking and connection verification are listed gateway capabilities; field encryption/pseudonymisation by the gateway is unconfirmed.

Claimed the gateway blocks re-transmission by MCP servers to downstream APIs ('개발 예정' is unsupported). Gateway cannot see server-internal egress; rewritten as an intake-review check with current capability unconfirmed.

defect_list.ref: 제17조제5항, 제20조제2항, 제20조의2제2항, 제20조의2제3항, 제36조의2, 제39조의4 gateway_control_ko
defect_list.description: Controls were phrased as existing features. Prefixed as '후보 통제' and added the organisational/out-of-scope parts (수탁자 교육, 신고, 저장소 분리, 규모 기준 미확인).
POL-48 (temp file/cache cleanup) does not map to segregated retention; removed, POL-25 kept.
POL-27 (per-action approval/human oversight) does not match the explanation-right provision; removed, POL-38 kept.
'로그에 원문을 남기지 않는 설계가 전제다' presented a design inference as a legal premise; hedged and added that 제20조제2항 binds 신용정보회사등 while 제20조의2제2항 binds 신용정보제공·이용자.

doc_level_changes: key_dates and edition: added 법률 제21646호 (공포 2026-05-12, 시행 2026-08-13 per API) 부칙 and 제44조의2~5 sunset (2029-08-12)
scope_ko: corrected to 신용정보회사등 (제15조제1항) / 신용정보제공·이용자 (제2조제7호) and noted narrower scopes of 제20조의2 and 제36조의2
limitations_ko: replaced unverifiable '표본 24곳' with verified 11-anchor match against the official 현행 text; stated PDF is from a user-supplied zip
license_notice / distribution_reason: restated evidence (저작권법 제7조제1호·제4호 verified via official API, site policy not found); distribution stays public-under-license with caveat

status in_force confirmed: official API lists 법령일련번호 283841 (시행 2026-09-11, 법률 제21445호) as 현행; title, issuer (금융위원회 소관), language, jurisdiction, binding, official_page_url (HTTP 200, same header) all correct
remaining_concerns: Distribution rests on 저작권법 제7조 (Korea is not in the centrally verified reuse list, and no law.go.kr site-level copyright policy text was found); kept public-under-license by analogy to the PRC Art. 5(1) reasoning, but the 법제처 headers/footers on the PDF are not covered by any explicit licence statement.
Scouting item file items/LIB-L02.json does not exist, so scouting claims could not be compared.
Only 11 provisions from 6 articles were read; 시행령, 감독규정, 고시 and the rest of the Act are unread, as the note says.
Whether the gateway currently has field encryption/pseudonymisation or server-egress control is unconfirmed and now stated as such.

documents.title: 정보통신망 이용촉진 및 정보보호 등에 관한 법률 [시행 2026. 9. 11.] [법률 제21445호, 2026. 3. 10., 타법개정]
documents.title_native: 정보통신망 이용촉진 및 정보보호 등에 관한 법률 (약칭: 정보통신망법)
documents.issuer: 대한민국 국회 (소관: 과학기술정보통신부·방송미디어통신위원회)
documents.edition: 법률 제21445호(2026-03-10 타법개정) 시행 2026-09-11 본. 2026-10-17 현재 더 새로운 본(법률 제21988호, 2026-09-29 일부개정, 시행 2026-10-02)이 있다. 이 PDF에는 2026-10-01 시행 예정 조문이 같은 조문의 두 번째 본으로 함께 실려 있어 제45조·제45조의3·제47조·제48조의2~4 등이 두 벌로 나온다.
documents.key_dates: 이 PDF는 시행 2026-09-11 본이다(법률 제21445호는 개인정보 보호법 개정에 따른 타법개정으로, 이 법에 대해서는 부칙 제4조제2항이 제45조의3제4항제2호라목의 인용 조문을 바꾼다). 2026-03-31 개정분 중 2026-10-01 시행 조문(제45조, 제45조의3·4, 제47조, 제47조의7, 제48조의2~4, 제48조의7~10 등)이 병기되어 있고 제45조의5(정보보호수준 평가)는 2027-04-01 시행으로 표시된다. 2026-10-17 현재 효력이 있는 것은 2026-10-01 시행본이며, 이 노트의 조문은 그 본문에 맞췄다. 법률 제21988호(공포 2026-09-29, 시행 2026-10-02)는 현행 조문에서 '개정 2026. 9. 29.' 표시가 제44조의7제4항과 제49조의3제1항에만 붙어 있고 문구 차이는 기관 명칭(공소청, 중대범죄수사청장) 반영이다(제·개정이유는 확인하지 못했다). 제48조의9(침해사고 관리·대응 매뉴얼)는 2026-03-31 신설되어 2026-10-01부터 시행한다.

defect_list.description: Note said report 'immediately' and pitfalls said no 24h/72h figure exists in the Act. The PDF's second copy (effective 2026-10-01, identical to current law.go.kr text effective 2026-10-02) requires reporting within 24 hours of becoming aware, with the particulars set by Presidential Decree. The anchor existed only in the superseded copy. Also timing_ko cited para 4 for the decree delegation, but it is para 5 in the current text, and the new para 4 (user notification) was not mentioned.

Paraphrase and anchor came from the superseded copy (analyse cause whenever an incident occurs). The 2026-10-01 text covers analysing occurrence and cause where an incident occurred, or where there are suspicious circumstances and the 침해사고조사심의위원회 finds an investigation necessary. Rewrote obligation, topic and anchor to the in-force text.

Note said the CISO is designated from '임직원'. The in-force 2026-10-01 text says '임원' (including 상법 제401조의2제1항제3호 persons and executive officers) and delegates medium-sized enterprises to the Decree. Fixed with the old/new wording stated.

Marked actor=operator and strength=mandatory. Para 3 requires the Minister's 정보보호지침 to contain these items, and para 2 only lets the Minister recommend that operators follow it. The operator duty is para 1. Changed to actor=authority, strength=recommended and rewrote the obligation.
Marked mandatory although the text is a discretionary power ('명할 수 있다'). Set strength=informative and added that a duty arises only upon an order.

gateway_control_ko cited ISMS-P item numbers (2.5.1, 2.9.4, 2.11.1) and an internal id LIB-K35 that are not in the extract. Removed them and pointed to the 제47조제4항 notice, which was not read. Obligation also omitted the '전기통신사업자 등 중' qualifier. POL-44 was a weak link and was removed.

gateway_control_ko treated internal gateway-bypass connections and 'helper token' bypass as a 'basis for illegality' under a criminal ban on installing or distributing programs that circumvent a network's protection and authentication. That reading is unsupported by the text. Rewrote it neutrally, left the legal assessment to counsel and removed POL-17. The jargon 'helper token' is gone.

timing_ko said the audit cycle is set by the guideline, which the text does not say. The '(2026-03-10 개정 표시)' remark was meaningless. The 2026-10-01 text adds duties (personnel and budget, board reporting) that were not mentioned.

defect_list.ref: gateway_control_ko (제45조제1항, 제45조의2제1항, 제45조의3제1항·제4항, 제48조의2제2항, 제48조의3제1항, 제48조의4제1항·제5항, 제48조의9제3항, 제49조)
defect_list.description: Several controls were worded as capabilities the product already has ('해시 체인', '격리 검사·구성요소 분석·위험 검사', report and summary exports, legal hold, 복원 후 대조, 'blocks the leak path') and some read as compliance assurances. Reworded as candidates, tied to the capability vocabulary in the guide, and noted that decree and notice details were not read.

Claims that personal-data rules were 'moved to the PIPA' and a pointer to PIPA 제34조 were not backed by the extract. The PDF shows only 제28조 etc. deleted on 2020-02-04. Rewrote to that and said the PIPA was not read.

Did not say that the PDF holds two copies of many articles (the 2026-09-11 text and the 2026-10-01 text) and that the second is the one in force on 2026-10-17. This caused the 24-hour and 임원 errors. Added to edition, key_dates and pitfalls, and added a pitfall for the 제48조의4 change.

Said Act 21988 is a 'criminal justice reorganisation title cleanup' and that this was 'confirmed on the revision-reason page'. I could not retrieve the revision reasons. What I confirmed on law.go.kr: [시행 2026.10.2.][법률 제21988호, 2026.9.29.], the '개정 2026. 9. 29.' marker appears only at 제44조의7제4항 and 제49조의3제1항, and the wording change adds 공소청 / 중대범죄수사청장. Rewrote key_dates accordingly and added the 2026-10-01 and 2027-04-01 (제45조의5) dates shown in the PDF.

Threshold sentence omitted the qualifier that applies to telecom operators and those who provide or mediate information over their services, and the 'than 1,500억 OR 100억 OR 100만' structure was loose. Reworded to follow the text.

'표본 8곳' did not match what could be compared. Replaced with the actual comparison of the 10 cited articles against the current law.go.kr text (all equal to the PDF's 2026-10-01 copy) and listed what was and was not read.

Decision public-under-license stands. I fetched law.go.kr and confirmed 저작권법 제7조제1호 (헌법·법률·조약·명령·조례 및 규칙 are not protected; 시행 2026-08-11, 법률 제21336호). The PDF has no licence text. Reworded both fields to say exactly that and to say the 법제처 header and layout and the 국가법령정보센터 usage policy were not confirmed.
title includes the version label from the PDF heading, which duplicates edition. Left as is.

doc_level_changes: edition: added that the PDF carries two copies of many articles (2026-09-11 and 2026-10-01).
key_dates: rewritten (21445 vs 21988 role, 2026-10-01 and 2027-04-01 effective dates, 21988 changes only 제44조의7제4항 and 제49조의3제1항, revision reason marked unconfirmed).
summary_ko: replaced the from-memory PIPA statement with the PDF-backed deletion of 제28조 etc. on 2020-02-04.
scope_ko: ISMS threshold sentence made faithful to 제47조제2항.
pitfalls_ko: corrected the false 'no 24h figure' statement, removed the from-memory PIPA 제34조 pointer, added version-copy warning and 제48조의4 change.
reading_scope_ko / limitations_ko: rewritten to match what was actually read and compared.

defect_list.description: The text only says the Act 'applies' (적용한다) to acts abroad that affect the domestic market or users. The note marked it mandatory, but it is an applicability rule, not a must/shall duty. The gateway_control wording also implied that using a foreign MCP server alone brings a deployment under the Act.

The text names 인공지능사업자 (which includes both developers and users, 제2조제7호), but the note set actor=provider. The pitfall and gateway_control said the duty falls on model businesses and that the deploying organisation is 'probably not a direct target'. The text does not support that; the trigger is the compute of the AI system.
The anchor '인공지능의 최종결과 도출에 활용된 주요 기준' appears twice. Its first occurrence is in 제3조제2항, so it did not prove the 제34조 reference. I replaced it with a phrase unique to 제34조제1항제2호.
The note softened the second sentence to 'may be reflected'. The text says 반영될 수 있도록 하여야 한다. That sentence is a shall, and it is one of the provisions that took effect on 2026-07-21 (부칙).
The Minister's powers are discretionary ('조사하게 할 수 있다', '명할 수 있다'). The note marked strength as mandatory.

The 부칙 limits 제16조제3항부터 제5항까지 to the part relating to the amended 제2항제2호의2, and the note dropped that qualifier. The 2026-07-21 date was not in the 부칙 text; it comes from the version header, and 'sixth month after promulgation' is now stated as the 부칙 words. I added the official-page history: 법률 제20676호 (2025-01-21), 제21065호 (2025-10-01), and the digital medical device 시행일 of 2026-01-24.

gateway_control said the Excel 정책50 POL-02 'cites this article'. No article citation exists in pol_titles.txt or the Act. I replaced it with a statement that POL-02's wording has the same purpose, and phrased the field mechanism as a requirement candidate.

gateway_control said POL-27 'cites' this article (unsupported) and implied that per-request approval satisfies the Act's human oversight of high-impact AI. I replaced it with 'can evidence' wording and a scope caveat.

timing_ko said the retention period is delegated to the decree and notices. The text has no retention period and only delegates the specifics of the measures (제34조제1항·제2항). gateway_control claimed export and retention settings as if they already exist.

gateway_control treated mere lookup of HR or credit data as high-impact. The text covers 'judgment or evaluation' with significant effect on rights and duties. I narrowed it to tools that record or change evaluation results.
gateway_control stated that the gateway attaches a high-impact flag, as if it already exists. I changed it to a requirement candidate.
POL-32 concerns verifying the source of inbound tool responses used for document drafting. It does not concern labelling AI-generated output, so I removed it. pol_ids is now empty.
POL-07 (document handling by the external provider) is unrelated to AI safety duties, so I removed it. POL-03 (provider support check) is kept as a weak link.

The scope omitted that a high-impact AI also needs the 'significant effect on life, bodily safety and fundamental rights' condition. It also omitted that 인공지능사업자 includes developers, users and 국가기관등 (제2조제7호).

The 보관 기간 delegation claim was overstated, so I limited it to the delegations the text states (제31조제4항, 제33조제3항·제4항, 제34조제1항·제2항). I added that the 제43조 fine list and the 제40조제1항 investigation triggers do not cover 제33조 or 제36조 (and 제31조제1항 for investigation).

The sampled-8-spots comparison could not be reproduced, and the reading-scope text mislabelled 제6~30조 as promotion-only (제27~30조 are 제4장 윤리·신뢰성 확보). I replaced both with my own full comparison and an accurate reading scope. The comparison covers the whole body, 제1조 to 부칙 제21311호, and found no differences apart from whitespace and middle-dot variants. The 연혁 list shows this version as the latest, and the page flag nwYn=Y marks it current.

The 저작권법 제7조제1호 text and the 시행 2026-08-11 date are correct, and I confirmed them on law.go.kr (법률 제21336호). However, the note read as if the reuse statement were a licence. I rewrote the notice to say that the PDF carries no reuse notice and that the decision rests on the non-protected-work rule. It also says the law.go.kr site terms were not checked.

doc_level_changes: key_dates: added the 제16조제3항~제5항 qualifier, the official 부칙 history (20676 / 21065 / 21311, 디지털의료기기 2026-01-24), and the wording 'sixth month after promulgation'
scope_ko: added the two-part test for high-impact AI and 제2조제7호 for the actor definition

Verified without change: title, issuer, 법률 제21311호, 시행 2026-07-21, status in_force (nwYn=Y and top of 연혁 list, no later version), binding true, language ko, jurisdiction KR, official_page_url (HTTP 200, same version)
remaining_concerns: Distribution rests on 저작권법 제7조제1호 (statute text is a non-protected work), not on an explicit licence. This is the same logic as the centrally accepted PRC rule, but Korea has no centrally verified evidence entry. The 국가법령정보센터 site terms were not checked.

defect_list.description: Seven provisions were marked 'mandatory' although the instrument is non-binding PIPC guidance (binding=false). Several of them are phrased as 'may' or 'need to review' in the text, for example the cross-border review ('검토하고 확인할 필요가 있습니다') and the §15③ use as a basis the company 'can review' ('검토할 수 있습니다').
The pitfall said the strength column follows the guide's wording. After the downgrade this was wrong.
'MINT 도입 조직은 대부분 모델이용자에 해당한다' is not in the document. The guide only offers the model developer / model user split (쪽 6), and '대상이다' overstated a document meant to be 'consulted' (참고).

쪽 30 접근제어: the text says API permissions 'can' be limited to authenticated parties and access control 'can become' a core defence. The note turned this into a statement that it 'is' the core defence, with strength 'recommended'. Also, the 쪽 30 입출력 필터 item says 'can control' but was marked recommended.
The note says the guide 'recommends' the red-team practice. The text lists it as a case study (사례) with no recommendation wording. Strength changed to informative.
'위원회는 기업용 라이선스 사용을 조건으로 보았다' goes beyond the text. The guide only reports the case (결정 제2024-017-237호, 비공개) as measures taken so that data is processed only for the medical institution's purpose.
timing_ko added '(제공자별)', but in the comparison table the deletion-within-a-reasonable-period cell spans all providers, so it is not provider-specific.
'적용해야 한다' for a sentence that says applying the latest versions and patches 'is important' (중요합니다).
The ref was 쪽 8, but the point about general-purpose AI and making the purpose as specific as possible is on 쪽 9. Ref widened to 쪽 8-9.
The statement that use without pseudonymisation or a new lawful basis may be judged unlawful secondary use is on 쪽 14. Ref widened to 쪽 13-14.

POL-03 (security update support) and POL-05 (tool description vs. behaviour test) do not fit a provision about checking model cards, training-data origin and red-team testing. Removed, leaving POL-01.
POL-34 (task-level context separation) does not fit a notice and opt-out duty. Removed.
Theme data_minimisation_retention_deletion is a weak fit for input/output filters. Changed to security_risk_management.
It claimed the audit ledger can supply the evidence needed to apply for the fine reduction. The text says the evidence is the impact assessment result itself, which the gateway cannot produce.
Masking was presented as satisfying the pseudonymisation route. Added a caveat that masking is not a substitute for a lawful basis and may not meet the legal pseudonymisation standard.
The control implied the gateway can validate model training-data origin. Added a note that it cannot.
No statement that gateway_control_ko entries are candidate capabilities, not claims of implementation or of compliance. Added.

The Copyright line is the portal's site-wide footer, not a statement specific to this post. Added that no KOGL mark was found on the post (2026-10-17 fetch of the HTML) and that the PDF text layer has no licence or copyright text. Added that no centrally verified reuse evidence covers Korean PIPC documents. The local-only decision stands.

The 2025-08-06 release date was not tied to a source. I confirmed it on the PIPC press release 'nttId=11410'; the 2025-08-22 portal date and the 11.24. re-upload remark were confirmed on the portal page. Source added to the text.

documents.issuer: NIST (미국 상무부 국립표준기술연구소), 저자 Scott Rose, Oliver Borchert, Stu Mitchell, Sean Connelly(CISA)
documents.edition: Final, August 2020 (59쪽, doi:10.6028/NIST.SP.800-207). CSRC 문서 이력: 2019-09-23 초안, 2020-02-13 초안, 2020-08-11 최종. 개정판(Rev. 1)이나 초안은 목록에 없고 철회·대체 표시도 없다. 관련 문서: SP 800-207A, CSWP 20.
documents.key_dates: 2020-08-11 최종 발행. 2026-10-17 CSRC 페이지 확인 시 철회·대체 공지 없음(2024-04-19 비공식 번역 안내만 있음).

defect_list.description: The note rested distribution on the Authority notice alone. It omitted that co-author Stu Mitchell is from Stu2Labs (a non-NIST author, per the CSRC author list). It also omitted NIST's statement that foreign copyright may exist and that NIST may hold copyright assigned by non-employees. The notice is limited to the US and grants no open licence. It also implied attribution is a condition, but the text only says attribution 'would be appreciated'.

The passage is about evaluating asset (device) security posture through a PEP. The control text and POL-19/POL-20 describe user and agent identity and delegation, which do not match. The text implied the gateway evaluates device posture.

The passage describes the policy administrator pausing a session to reauthenticate, and terminating it on timeout, workflow completion or alert. It involves no human. It was tagged human_oversight and linked to POL-27 (per-request individual human approval) with a control about an approval-pending state.
gateway_control_ko asserted a MINT pilot plan (start with low-risk read-only MCPs, then widen to write and external-transfer tools). Nothing in the text or guide supports it.

defect_list.kind: wrong page ref, overstated modality, unsupported product claim, weak POL link
defect_list.description: The anchor sits on printed p.31 (PDF p.40), not p.30. The text says false positives and negatives 'can be reduced' with retuning, which is not a recommendation. The control claimed MINT measures false-positive and false-negative rates with normal and attack test sets. POL-05 (tool description vs actual behaviour tests) does not match retuning.
obligation_ko said the providers (공급자) must evaluate holistically. The text says the enterprise should evaluate service providers.
It said federal zero-trust obligations are set by OMB memos and other documents. That was not read and is not in the extract.
instrument_type was 'standard'. The document calls itself a NIST 'guideline' (Authority notice), and the note's own pitfalls say it is a non-binding SP. It is not a standard.
The anchor 'The data plane and control plane are logically separate' is §3.4.1 network requirement 5, not the §3.4 introduction. The other §3.4.1 provisions already use 'requirement' numbering.
The text says organizations must identify privacy risks, and that this 'may include' informing users, obtaining consent and educating. The note turned the options into 'should consider'.

The text says 'Enterprises can mitigate', which is informative, but the note had 'recommended'. The control stated 'high availability is currently out of scope', which is a product-status claim with no support.
POL-14 (plaintext credentials in connection settings) does not fit protecting stored traffic metadata and policy-management tools.
gateway_control_ko cited a 'contract lock', 'diff' and 'ledger with no change or delete code'. None is in the guide or the text.
The control said a dual enforcement path 'is defined', which presents an unconfirmed capability as existing.
The control said an observe-mode staged rollout 'is provided'. It is only a candidate requirement.
There are 31 provisions against the guide's 8-25. The checker does not flag it, and every provision is supported by the text, so none were removed.

defect_list.ref: all 31 anchors, refs and printed page numbers
defect_list.description: All anchors were found verbatim. Printed page = PDF page minus 9, and the refs match apart from the items listed above. Paraphrases, actors and timing were checked against the text with no further defects. Official CSRC page (fetched 2026-10-17): title, authors, final 2020-08-11, no withdrawal or supersession, official_page_url returns 200 and key_dates are correct. The NIST PDF Content-Length 966,908 equals the staged file size.

doc_level_changes: instrument_type: standard -> regulator_guidance
pitfalls_ko[0]: removed the unsupported claim about OMB memos and marked it unconfirmed

license_notice and distribution_reason rewritten to the evidence actually used: the PDF's own Authority notice (US-only, no open licence), the non-NIST co-author, NIST's foreign-copyright and assigned-copyright statement, and the size match with the official PDF; distribution kept as public-under-license but described as a borderline case
limitations_ko: added that the hash was not compared, only the file size
remaining_concerns: Distribution is a judgement call. The only basis is the PDF's own notice that the publication is not subject to copyright in the US. Co-author Stu Mitchell is at Stu2Labs, and NIST says foreign copyright may exist and that it may hold assigned copyright. The lead should decide whether to downgrade to local-only. The reuse rule says non-NIST authors mean local-only unless the document carries a free-use notice, and the notice here is US-only.
The staged PDF came from a user-supplied zip. Only its size matches the official PDF (966,908 bytes, Last-Modified 2020-08-10). The SHA256 was not compared.
The gateway_control_ko texts and the claims about MINT in summary_ko are not checked against the product. The sentences that were clearly unsupported were removed or marked as candidates.

31 provisions exceeds the guide's 8-25. The extract was read for sections 2, 3.1 to 3.4.1, 5, 6.1 to 6.2, 7.3 and the front matter; sections 3.2 and 4 and appendices were not read in full, and the note does not cite them.
Section 5.7 covers AI agents used to administer the zero-trust system itself, not LLM tool-calling agents; the mapping to MINT's agentic_ai theme is the note author's interpretation.

documents.title: Architectural Requirements for Supporting AI Agents on the Internet (draft-daniel-ai-agent-internet-architecture-03)
documents.issuer: IETF 개인 제출 Internet-Draft (S. D. Park, Samsung Electronics / I. Siddique, Opaque)
documents.edition: -03, 2026-08-28(28쪽). 만료 2027-03-01. 데이터트래커 메타데이터(2026-10-17 조회) 기준 rev 03이 최신이고 RFC 번호는 없다.
documents.key_dates: 2026-08-28 제출(rev 03), 2027-03-01 만료 예정(문서 표지 'Expires: 1 March 2027'). 문서 표지의 Intended status는 Informational이나 데이터트래커의 Intended RFC status는 없음(None)이고 스트림도 지정되지 않은 개별(individual) 초안이다(2026-10-17 조회). Internet-Draft는 최대 6개월 유효한 작업 문서이며 'work in progress'로만 인용해야 한다고 문서가 밝힌다.

defect_list.description: 29 provisions were labelled strength=mandatory although the document is a non-binding individual Internet-Draft (binding=false). NOTE_GUIDE allows mandatory only for binding obligations in a binding instrument. The MUST/SHOULD distinction was only implicit in the obligation text.

Source says a protocol MAY bind two or more roles where the binding is explicit, verifiable, and appropriate to the deployment. The note said binding is allowed 'only when explicit and verifiable' and dropped the 'appropriate to the deployment' condition.

Only audience restriction (and binding a consequential authorization to audience, operation and resource) is MUST. Narrow scoping to resources and operations and binding to a task or transaction identifier are SHOULD. The note stated narrow scope as a must.
'revocable or naturally short-lived' is MUST, but 'revocation semantics SHOULD address active multi-agent chains' was rendered as 'must address'.
'distinguish an observed event from an assertion' is MUST, but 'identify the issuer of each material assertion' is SHOULD. The note rendered both as 'must'.
'Authorization evidence SHOULD be audience-, resource-, operation-, and context-restricted' was stated as a duty, while only 're-delegation MUST attenuate rather than amplify authority' is MUST.

Stated as fact that the only unauthenticated paths are health check and login, and that the APIs already require authentication. Nothing in the document or the note's sources supports this product claim.

Present-tense statements of specific implementations (hash chain, policy bundle hash, no prompt collection, delete/pseudonymise on expiry, fail-closed, tested revocation states) read as if MINT already does them. Reworded as candidate controls. A document-level limitation was added that all gateway_control_ko entries are candidates and implementation status was not checked.

The note said discovery, payment, async and transport sections (§8-10, 14-16) were not included, yet it includes REQ-DISC-5 and REQ-DISC-9 from §8. Also 'outside MINT scope' was an unsupported judgement.

The grant was not stated, and the reason conflated the IETF Trust Legal Provisions with BCP 78 and gave no evidence. The decision public-under-license is supportable: TLP 5.0 (fetched 2026-10-17, effective 2015-03-25) section 3.c.i permits copying and distributing IETF Contributions and Documents in full and without modification, and section 3.d bars modification and distribution without the required legends. The staged .txt SHA-256 equals the ietf.org archive file, so it is unmodified. Rewritten to cite exactly this evidence and its limits (unmodified full text, legends kept, no code components extracted).

'Intended status: Informational' appears on the document cover but the datatracker shows Intended RFC status None, no stream, Active Internet-Draft (individual). Added the distinction. Other dates verified: rev 03, 2026-08-28, 28 pages, expires 1 March 2027, rfc null, no newer revision.
POL-14 (plaintext credential exposure in connection settings) does not relate to binding agent identity to rotating keys.
POL-50 (blocking reactivation after backup restore) does not relate to defining revocation effects by task state.
POL-40 (re-approval when the connection destination changes) does not relate to callback authentication or SSRF defence.
POL-48 (temp file and cache cleanup on disconnect) is not about audit-record retention periods.
human_oversight, but the text only says cryptographic validity is not proof of the delegating principal's current intent. Changed to access_control_identity.
secure_development_supply_chain does not fit idempotency or duplicate detection and blind retry. Changed to security_risk_management.
'Services SHOULD apply...' was rendered as a duty ('해야 한다'). The retry sentence uses lowercase 'should'. Both marked.
'Operators should define' is lowercase, not a BCP 14 keyword, and was rendered as a duty. Reworded.

§3 says universal agent runtime and model evaluation are not standardized, but the note said 'single runtime' and omitted model evaluation. Summary said the draft 'requires' items that are SHOULD, and said 'new protocol' where the text says monolithic new agent protocol.
Only the author's partial reading was recorded. Added that the verifier re-read the full text (§1-30) and checked all anchors with surrounding text.
Many requirements address protocols, mechanisms or architectures, not operators. 'operator' is a stand-in. A pitfalls note was added; the per-provision values were not changed.
The note has 32 provisions while NOTE_GUIDE asks for 8-25 and the checker does not flag it. All 32 are supported by the text, so none were deleted, and none were added.

doc_level_changes: All strength=mandatory changed to recommended (non-binding draft); pitfalls_ko now says MUST/SHOULD is shown in obligation_ko and the anchor keyword, and lowercase should is not BCP 14.
key_dates: added cover Expires 1 March 2027, cover Intended status Informational versus datatracker Intended RFC status None and no stream (individual draft).
summary_ko and scope_ko: MUST/SHOULD wording and the §3 non-goals corrected.
pitfalls_ko: fixed the contradictory exclusion bullet and added an actor-column note.
reading_scope_ko and limitations_ko: added the verifier's full re-read, and that gateway_control_ko are candidate controls with implementation status unchecked.

license_notice and distribution_reason: rewritten with the IETF Trust Legal Provisions 5.0 section 3.c.i and 3.d evidence and the SHA-256 match to the ietf.org archive file. public-under-license kept, limited to the unmodified original .txt with legends.

Verified against datatracker on 2026-10-17: title, authors and affiliations, rev 03, 28 pages, last updated 2026-08-28, Active Internet-Draft (individual), rfc null. official_page_url returns HTTP 200.
remaining_concerns: The draft is non-binding and expires 2027-03-01. Cite it only as work in progress with rev -03 and the date.
Product claims in gateway_control_ko were not checked against the actual MINT implementation. They are candidate controls only.
The MUST/SHOULD distinction is no longer in the strength column. Consumers filtering on strength cannot separate MUST from SHOULD items without reading obligation_ko.
32 provisions exceed the guide's 8-25 range. The lead may merge related ones (for example REQ-AUD-*, REQ-REV-*) if the cap is enforced.

provenance.json records the source as a user-supplied zip. The content is byte-identical to the official ietf.org archive text, but provenance.json was not edited because only note.json may be changed.

documents.title: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 Information technology — Artificial intelligence — Management system
documents.title_native: BS ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (사용자가 제공한 사본의 머리글 표기. 'BS' 접두는 영국 채택본 지정번호로 보이나 사본에 BSI 명칭·고지는 없어 확인하지 못했다)
documents.issuer: ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 42 (ISO 카탈로그 기재. 사본 머리글은 'BS ISO/IEC 42001:2023')
documents.edition: ISO/IEC 42001:2023, Edition 1, 2023-12 (ISO 카탈로그: Published, International Standard published [60.60], 51쪽). 사본은 BS ISO/IEC 42001:2023 이미지 전용 PDF 61쪽이며 본문은 OCR로 추출했다.
documents.key_dates: ISO 발행 2023-12(Edition 1). 2026-10-17 ISO 카탈로그 쪽(Status: Published, Stage 60.60, Edition 1, 51쪽, ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 42)에 개정판·철회 표시는 없고, 같은 쪽의 묶음 상품 목록에 ISO/IEC 42005:2025가 표시된다(그 문서의 제목·내용은 이 노트에서 확인하지 않았다).

defect_list.description: The 12 clause 4-10 provisions were tagged strength=mandatory although binding=false (voluntary standard). The guide allows mandatory only for binding instruments. The text does say 'shall'.
obligation_ko said consequences to 개인·집단·사회. Page image 17 reads 'the organization, individuals and societies', so the organization was missing.
gateway_control_ko cited '한국 신용정보법 3년' as a retention example. It is not in the document and is not backed by any official page.
POL-48 (cleanup of temp files and caches at disconnect) does not fit retention and deletion of event logs.
POL-27 (individual approval of sensitive actions and human oversight for high-impact AI) is not tied to 6.1.4 impact assessment documentation.
gateway_control_ko presented a correspondence table and a requirement-matrix export (status, code and test links) as existing. Neither could be confirmed.

gateway_control_ko said an incident summary export was being prepared and implied linking jurisdictional notification deadlines. Reworded as a candidate and noted that notification itself is organisational.
gateway_control_ko said the responsible-use flow is 'implemented in code'.
theme was testing_red_teaming_robustness for 'implement the risk treatment plan and verify its effectiveness'. That is risk management, not AI robustness testing.
theme was data_protection_lawful_basis for a control that only documents data resources.

The note claimed a BSI-issued copy, 'BSI 채택본 고지' and 'BSI 저작권'. Cover and page 2 show only the header 'BS ISO/IEC 42001:2023' with no BSI name or notice. Page 2 does carry the ISO copyright notice. Every page carries a 'Copyrighted Document For Training Purpose Only' watermark, which the note omitted.
'인증 가능한', '인증 심사의 기준' and 'ISO/IEC 42001 인증은...' were not backed by the extract or the ISO page I read. The foreword only states the voluntary nature of standards. Removed or marked unconfirmed.
ISO/IEC 42005:2025 was described as '(AI 시스템 영향 평가)'. The ISO page only lists it in a bundle without a title. Reworded to what the page shows.
'BS 판 61쪽' presumes a BSI edition. Changed to '사본 61쪽'.

doc_level_changes: Re-fetched https://www.iso.org/standard/42001 with the built-in browser (curl and WebFetch got HTTP 403). Confirmed: Published, publication date 2023-12, Edition 1, stage 60.60, 51 pages, ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 42, © ISO 2026, paid (PDF+ePub CHF 225), ISO/IEC 42005:2025 shown only in a bundle. title, jurisdiction INTL, instrument_type standard, binding=false, status voluntary, language en and official_page_url are correct.

distribution stays local-only. No centrally verified reuse evidence exists for ISO, and page 2 of the copy forbids reproduction or intranet/internet posting without written permission. license_notice and distribution_reason now state this, the watermark and the unverified BSI claim.
Added a pitfall explaining why strength is recommended for every provision, and removed the certification wording from summary_ko, scope_ko and pitfalls_ko.
remaining_concerns: The text is OCR from an image-only PDF. I compared all 28 anchors and paraphrases against the OCR text and the Annex B guidance. I viewed images only for page 17 (6.1.2 to 6.1.3), the cover and page 2. Clause numbers 8.2 and 9.2.1 and the A.x.y numbers are inferred from OCR order where the OCR garbled them, for example '62' for 8.2 and 'AAA' for A.4.4. They match the standard's structure.

Setting strength=recommended for clause 4-10 'shall' requirements follows the guide's rule that mandatory applies only to binding instruments. The lead may prefer mandatory with an explicit non-binding caveat. The pitfall text keeps the shall/should distinction either way.

Some gateway_control_ko entries (9.1, 8.3, A.7.5, A.4.4) are still written declaratively, in the exemplar's style. They describe intended or candidate controls and I could not confirm any of them is implemented.
The reading_scope_ko claim that clauses 5-10 were read in full is the lead's statement. I did not re-read every sentence of those clauses.

documents.title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Information security, cybersecurity and privacy protection — Information security management systems — Requirements
documents.issuer: ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 27
documents.edition: ISO/IEC 27001:2022, Edition 3, 2022-10 (사본 26쪽 PDF, 본문 19쪽). ISO 카탈로그에는 Amd 1:2024(기후 변화 대응 변경)가 발행돼 있으나 이 사본에는 포함되지 않았다.
documents.key_dates: 2022-10 제3판 발행(2013판 대체). 2026-10-17 ISO 카탈로그: Published [60.60], 'This standard has 1 amendment' = ISO/IEC 27001:2022/Amd 1:2024(Climate action changes, 발행). 제3판이 제2판(ISO/IEC 27001:2013)을 취소·대체한다(사본 머리말). 카탈로그 상태·개정 정보는 작성자 확인이며 검수 시 ISO 사이트 접속이 403으로 막혀 재확인하지 못했다.

defect_list.description: The claim that the standard is often used with ISMS-P certification criteria in Korea is not in the extract and no official page supports it. It came from memory.
'인증 가능한' (certifiable) is not stated in the extract. Intro 0.1 only says internal and external parties can use it to assess an organization's ability to meet its own security requirements.
The summary said the standard 'evidences' MINT policies. It is now worded as a framework to which evidence candidates can be linked.

'2013판은 철회됨' (withdrawn) is a catalogue status I could not check. The extract only says the third edition cancels and replaces the second. The ISO page returned 403 from curl and WebFetch, so the [60.60] status code could not be re-verified either. A WebSearch confirmed that Amd 1:2024 'Climate action changes' exists on iso.org (published Feb 2024).
The statement that certification audits must use the amended text is not in the extract. It now says the amended text must be checked separately.
'구현 지침은 27002에 있다' (implementation guidance is in 27002) is not in the 27001 text. Annex A only says its controls are derived from 27002 Clauses 5 to 8.
The statement about what ISO 27001 certification covers is not in the extract. It now cites §1: the requirements are for an organization's ISMS.
Annex A is labelled normative and 'shall be used in context with 6.1.3'. Added that, and the link between the Annex A recommended strength and 6.1.3 c)/d).

The quoted copyright notice dropped 'Unless otherwise specified, or required in the context of its implementation'. '유료 표준' (paid standard) was from memory and is now tied to 'Price based on 19 pages' on the last page of the copy. Distribution stays local-only, which is correct.
The obligation text includes risk-owner approval of the treatment plan and acceptance of residual risk. That is 6.1.3 f), not d), but the ref only named d).
Access, storage, change control and retention/disposal (7.5.3 c to f) apply 'as applicable'. The paraphrase made them unconditional.

Theme was incident_reporting, but a nonconformity with corrective action is not an incident report. Changed to governance_accountability. Removed POL-39 (known-vulnerability remediation), which does not fit nonconformity handling; POL-43 stays.
POL-01 (provenance and integrity) does not match the consistency of repeated risk assessments. Only POL-02 stays.
POL-02 and POL-37 do not match a policy-to-Annex-A mapping table, which is organisational work. pol_ids set to empty.

gateway_control_ko claimed the gateway, endpoint and ledger servers' clocks are synchronised and offsets checked. That is operations infrastructure, not a gateway capability. Rewritten as an operational procedure with a candidate deployment checklist item.
48 provisions, but NOTE_GUIDE says 8-25. check_notes.py does not enforce this and every provision is text-backed, so none were removed.
Annex A controls are phrased 'shall' but marked recommended. This is defensible: organizations select controls under 6.1.3 and justify exclusions in the SoA. Documented in pitfalls_ko.

doc_level_changes: summary_ko: removed '인증 가능한'; evidence wording softened to 'candidates'
scope_ko: removed the ISMS-P sentence; now says only that it is not a legal obligation (foreword)
key_dates: replaced '철회됨' with the text-backed 'cancels and replaces the 2013 edition'; flagged catalogue status as the author's check, not re-verified (ISO page returned 403)
pitfalls_ko: removed the unsupported claims about certification audits, ISO 27002 guidance and certification scope; added the normative Annex A context
limitations_ko: added that the ISO official page could not be fetched at review (403)
license_notice: restored the 'Unless otherwise specified...' clause; tied the paid-standard claim to 'Price based on 19 pages' in the extract

Left unchanged and verified: title, issuer (ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 27), edition (Third edition 2022-10), 93 controls (37+8+14+34), binding=false, status=voluntary, distribution=local-only, language en, official_page_url
remaining_concerns: The ISO catalogue page (https://www.iso.org/standard/27001) returned 403 for curl and WebFetch. The status 'Published [60.60]' and the '1 amendment' listing are the lead's claims. A WebSearch result only confirmed that Amd 1:2024 'Climate action changes' exists.

The Amd 1:2024 text was not read. It reportedly adds climate-related statements to 4.1 and 4.2, so the 4.2 NOTE provision and the clause 4 wording should be checked against the amended edition before certification-grade citation.
48 provisions exceed the guide's 8-25 range. The checker accepts it, so the lead should decide whether to prune.

gateway_control_ko texts are written in the present tense (for example 'blocks', 'applies'). They describe MINT capability candidates, not verified product behaviour; no legal-compliance claims were found.
Only note.json was edited (via a Python script, not the Edit tool). A backup is at /tmp/LIB-L10.note.bak.

documents.title: AZS ISO/IEC TR 24028:2024 (ISO/IEC TR 24028:2020 Overview of trustworthiness in artificial intelligence의 아제르바이잔 국가표준 채택본)
documents.title_native: AZƏRBAYCAN RESPUBLİKASININ DÖVLƏT STANDARTI AZS ISO/IEC TR 24028:2024 — İnformasiya texnologiyaları — Süni intellekt — Süni intellektin etimadı doğrultmasına dair icmal
documents.issuer: 아제르바이잔 표준화연구소(AZSTAND), 원문 ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 42
documents.edition: 원본 ISO/IEC TR 24028 Edition 1, 2020-05(기술 보고서, 43쪽, ISO 카탈로그 Published [60.60]). 사본은 AZSTAND의 동일 채택(IDT) 2024년 초판(64쪽, 아제르바이잔어)이다. 승인 결정의 날짜와 번호는 사본에 빈칸('..........')으로 남아 있다.
documents.key_dates: ISO/IEC TR 24028:2020 — 2020-05 발행. AZS ISO/IEC TR 24028:2024 — 2024 초판(승인 결정의 일자·번호와 적용 시작일 'Tətbiq edilmə tarixi'는 사본에 빈칸, 연도 2024만 표기), 정기 점검 주기 연 1회(머리말 5항). 원본 ISO/IEC TR 24028:2020은 ISO 카탈로그(2026-10-17 조회)에서 2020-05 발행, Edition 1, 43쪽, 단계 60.60 Published로 확인했다. 아제르바이잔 채택본 자체의 현재 효력·적용 시작일은 AZSTAND 공식 목록에서 확인하지 못했다.

defect_list.description: The 'AI is non-deterministic, so test success criteria are hard to judge (oracle problem)' statement was attributed to 9.10.1. That passage is in 9.10.2.1, and it says AI systems are 'less deterministic', not non-deterministic. 9.10.1 itself is one paragraph saying a combination of several approaches 'may be required' (tələb oluna bilər), which the note overstated as 'must combine'.

The text says a transparent AI system 'informs' stakeholders, and 'can inform and explain' when decisions are automated (bilər). The note wrote 'must be able to explain' (있어야 한다). The condition that metadata was recorded at collection was also turned into a looser conditional.
The text says control points 'should be defined' (təyin olunmalıdır) and that they can be set periodically or at decision points. The note only said they 'can be set'.

'The defence is a continuously re-validated item' was presented as what the text implies, but the text does not say it. The note was edited to mark it as the note author's interpretation. POL-37 was also removed as unrelated.

The text says a reliable AI system 'gives' consistent results, which is descriptive. The note said it 'must' (내야 한다). The gateway_control claimed deterministic decisions and a pinned policy version, which are not established, so it is now marked as a candidate requirement. POL-05 was removed because it is a tool-description test policy and unrelated.

gateway_control said MINT pseudonymises personal data before external transfer. The guide only lists masking, so the claim is now a masking candidate and pseudonymisation is marked unconfirmed. The actor was changed from controller to any because the text names no actor.

POL-07 (external provider document handling) does not relate to training-data filtering and was removed. gateway_control claimed MINT checks training-data provenance at intake, which is not in the capability vocabulary. It is now an organisational candidate procedure.

gateway_control claimed that tool-response and external-document controls reduce 'poisoning paths'. The text is about training-data poisoning, which is outside MINT's scope, so the control is now linked only as a separate candidate. The mistranslation '유리한 AI를 악용하는' (favourable AI) was corrected to 'AI 시스템을 악용하는'.

POL-05 (tool description vs actual behaviour test) was removed as unrelated to adversarial ML inputs. A scope note was added that perturbing ML model inputs is outside the gateway, and the input check and attack tests were reworded as candidates.

gateway_control stated rate limits and folder-listing bans as existing. They are now candidate controls, the 'whole-folder listing' reference (a document-reading context, not model queries) was dropped, and model-replication defence is stated to be out of scope.
The actor was 'controller', but the passages are general threat descriptions with no controller named. Changed to any.
gateway_control asserted details of the LLM-harness test practice (fixed repeat counts) from memory. It is now an organisational test-plan candidate and POL mapping was kept as POL-05 and POL-42.
The staged copy is an Azerbaijani state standard issued by AZSTAND, but jurisdiction was INTL and type was standard. Changed to AZ and national_standard.

'2024 초판 채택' left out that the approval decision date and number and the application start date are blank in the copy. The current force of the AZ adoption could not be confirmed on the AZSTAND site. The ISO catalogue page (fetched 2026-10-17 with a browser User-Agent) confirmed the original: Edition 1, 2020-05, 43 pages, stage 60.60 Published, JTC 1/SC 42. key_dates and limitations were corrected accordingly. 'voluntary' stays, since the copy's foreword refers to the voluntary nature of standards.

'규범 요구사항이 없는 개관 문서'/'인증 기준이나 의무가 없다' was an unsupported conclusion, since the text contains some 'should' phrasing. It was replaced with what the text states: the cover says technical report and section 1 puts trustworthiness-level specification out of scope. '(서문)' pointed to the wrong section; the scope text is in GİRİŞ and section 1. A pitfall noting that the oracle problem sits in 9.10.2.1 was added.

The decision local-only is correct. The copy states all rights reserved and forbids reprinting, copying or distributing in whole or part without AZSTAND permission (pp.2). None of the centrally verified reuse bases applies. The notice was extended with the ISO catalogue price page (CHF 196) and the azstand.gov.az footer '©2026 Bütün hüquqlar qorunur' with no reuse terms found.

documents.title: ISO/IEC 5230:2020 Information technology — OpenChain Specification
documents.issuer: ISO/IEC JTC 1 (JTC 1 PAS 절차로 채택, 원문은 Joint Development Foundation의 OpenChain Specification)
documents.edition: ISO/IEC 5230:2020, First edition, 2020-12 (본문 9쪽, 사본 16쪽 PDF). ISO 카탈로그상 현행 상태(검토·확정 여부 포함)는 이번 검증에서 ISO 사이트 접근 차단(HTTP 403)으로 확인하지 못해 미확인.
documents.key_dates: 2020-12 발행(사본 표지의 First edition 2020-12; OpenChain 프로젝트 페이지도 2020년 12월 ISO/IEC 5230:2020으로 채택됐다고 밝힘). ISO 카탈로그의 2026년 검토·확정 표기는 ISO 사이트 접근 차단(HTTP 403)으로 재확인하지 못해 미확인. 적합성 유효기간은 검증 취득일로부터 18개월(3.6.2).

defect_list.description: The note stated ISO catalogue status 'Published, confirmed [90.93]' and quoted 'last reviewed and confirmed in 2026' as verified on 2026-10-17. I could not verify this. iso.org/standard/81039.html returned HTTP 403 via curl and WebFetch (alternate ISO URLs and the ANSI webstore also failed). The extract and the OpenChain project page support only 2020-12 publication, and the OpenChain page does not mention any 2026 confirmation.

The note said the OpenChain project publishes a separate edition under CC-BY-4.0 with different copyright terms. Annex A only says translations are offered under CC-BY-4.0, and the OpenChain page I fetched shows no licence for the spec text. This came from memory, not the text.

The ellipsised quote dropped the 'Unless otherwise specified, or required in the context of its implementation' qualifier and did not say the copy is a user-supplied zip file or that the ISO terms page could not be checked. The local-only decision itself is correct, since there is no central or in-document reuse permission.

gateway_control_ko said unclear or non-commercial licences are put on hold at intake, which the standard does not require. It was also written as if the product already does this. POL-02 (scope, permissions, lawful basis review) is not an implausible fit.
POL-37 (change re-approval) does not match BOM creation. The control text read as a current practice.

POL-01 (provenance and integrity at intake) was linked to the outbound artifact definition and to the use-case provision. Both are outbound licence handling, and the note's own pitfalls said only the BOM links to POL-01. I kept POL-01 only on 3.3.1 and aligned pitfalls_ko[0].

defect_list.kind: gateway control stated as existing practice
defect_list.description: Several gateway_control_ko texts used present-tense wording that implies the product or repo already does this (e.g. 'existing rule', 'tracks in the same ledger as vulnerabilities', 'stores BOM'). The standard imposes none of this.
The text says the use-case list is neither exhaustive nor all applicable. The paraphrase presented it as a fixed set.
'확인 문서가 최근 18개월 이내여야 한다' garbled 3.6.2.1 ('within the past 18 months of obtaining conformance validation'). The registration procedure is on the OpenChain website, which the note did not mention.

gateway_control_ko 'retention follows jurisdiction/contract' is only the footnote to 'reasonable period', and the 'compliance artifacts' theme could also be supply_chain. Reworded to attribute it to the footnote; theme left as is.
'본문 9쪽(서문...)' mixed the 9-page body with the roman-numbered front matter. The PDF has 16 pages, all present in the extract.
There was no statement that the ISO catalogue status was unverified, or that the 'candidate' gateway controls are proposals.

doc_level_changes: edition: removed the unverified '90.93, reviewed and confirmed in 2026' catalogue claim and marked the current ISO status unconfirmed (ISO site returns HTTP 403)
key_dates: kept 2020-12 (cover plus OpenChain page) and the 18-month validity from 3.6.2; marked the 2026 confirmation unconfirmed
pitfalls_ko[0] and [2]: aligned the POL-01 statement with the remaining mapping; removed the unsupported CC-BY-4.0 'separate edition' claim and limited the CC-BY-4.0 statement to Annex A translations

license_notice and distribution_reason: replaced the ellipsised quote with a faithful paraphrase including the 'unless otherwise specified' qualifier, noted the copy is user-supplied, and stated that no reuse permission exists in the document or the central evidence. Distribution stays local-only.
reading_scope_ko and limitations_ko: corrected the page description and added the unverified ISO status and the 'candidate controls' caveat
pol_ids: removed POL-02 and POL-37 and POL-01 from 4 provisions (2.1, 3.1.5, 3.3.2 and the extra POL-37 on 3.3.1); only 3.3.1 keeps POL-01
remaining_concerns: ISO catalogue status as of 2026-10-17 (current or revised) could not be checked: iso.org returned HTTP 403 on every attempt. Re-check from an unblocked network before relying on 'voluntary / current'.

The scouting item file items/LIB-L12.json does not exist in the items directory, so the lead's scouting claims could not be compared. I relied on the note, the extract and the OpenChain project page (last updated 2025-07-10; it says the standard graduated as ISO/IEC 5230:2020 in December 2020).

All 11 provision refs, anchors and obligations (2.1, 3.1.1, 3.1.4, 3.1.5, 3.2.1, 3.2.2, 3.3.1, 3.3.2, 3.4.1, 3.5.1, 3.6.2) matched the extract. The 'recommended' strength is right for a voluntary standard even though the text says 'shall'.
The standard is irrelevant to MINT runtime controls, so most gateway controls are organisational candidates. This is already stated in pitfalls_ko.

documents.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 June 2024 laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence and amending Regulations (EC) No 300/2008, (EU) No 167/2013, (EU) No 168/2013, (EU) 2018/858, (EU) 2018/1139 and (EU) 2019/2144 and Directives 2014/90/EU, (EU) 2016/797 and (EU) 2020/1828 (Artificial Intelligence Act)
documents.issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union (관보 발행: Publications Office of the EU)
documents.status: in_force (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744로 개정됨; 제3장 제1~3절의 고위험 요건·의무는 아직 적용 전이며 2027-12-02 또는 2028-08-02부터 적용)
documents.edition: 관보 OJ L, 2024/1689, 2024-07-12 공포 원문(비통합본). 2026-07-08자 개정규칙 2026/1744의 내용은 이 PDF에 없으며, 개정 부분은 별도로 확인해 key_dates·pitfalls에 반영했다.
documents.key_dates: 서명 2024-06-13(원문 말미 Done at Brussels, 13 June 2024), 관보 공포 2024-07-12. 발효는 공포 후 20일째 날(제113조), 즉 2024-08-01이며 위원회 AI 규제체계 페이지가 'entered into force on 1 August 2024'로 확인한다. 적용: 원칙 2026-08-02(제113조). 예외(OJ 원문): 제1·2장(제4조, 제5조 금지 관행) 2025-02-02, 제3장 제4절·제5장(범용 AI 모델)·제7장·제12장(과징금, 제101조 제외)·제78조 2025-08-02, 제6조제1항 및 관련 의무 2027-08-02. 개정: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744(2026-07-08 서명, OJ L 2026-07-24 공포, 공포 후 3일째 날 발효이며 위원회 페이지가 2026-07-27 발효로 확인)가 제113조 제3항을 고쳐 제3장 제1~3절(고위험 요건·의무, 제6조제5항 제외)을 부속서 III 시스템은 2027-12-02, 부속서 I 시스템은 2028-08-02부터 적용하게 했고, 제5조제1항 신설 (ba)(bb)와 제5조제1a·1b항은 2026-12-02부터, 2026-08-02 이전에 출시된 생성형 시스템의 제50조제2항 이행은 2026-12-02까지(신설 제111조제4항)로 정했다. 제50조의 2026-08-02 적용일은 개정문에서 바뀌지 않았다. 미확인: 통합본(consolidated) 본문, 2026/1744 이후의 추가 개정이나 정오표 유무.

defect_list.description: The paraphrase follows the 2024 OJ wording, which lists 'AI system, tools, services, components, processes' as what the third party supplies. Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, Art. 1 point 12(b), added 'AI model' to that list. The note's own pitfalls say Art. 25(4) was amended, but the provision text did not reflect it. I read the amending text on the Publications Office XHTML to confirm.

gateway_control_ko said the product 'warns when the ledger retention is set under 6 months' and implied the ledger covers the provider log duty. That feature is not an established product capability, and Art. 19 concerns the provider's own logs. Reworded as a requirement candidate with an explicit limit.

gateway_control_ko said the ledger is supplied as evidence of the deployer's retained logs and that retention is set by policy. The duty covers logs automatically generated by the high-risk AI system, which the gateway ledger does not replace. Reworded as a possible supporting record and a requirement candidate.

The obligation text also covers 73(1) (report to the market surveillance authority of the Member State where the incident occurred) and 73(5) (initial incomplete report), so the ref range was too narrow. The anchor sits in 73(2) and the 15-day, 2-day and 10-day periods are correct. The ref now reads Art. 73(1)-(5).
POL-07 concerns an external provider's handling of documents (storage, reuse, third-party sharing). It is unrelated to obtaining the provider's instructions for use. Removed it and kept POL-02.
POL-07 concerns an external provider's document handling, not downstream-provider documentation on model capabilities and limits. Removed it and kept POL-03.

The summary said the regulation is enforced separately by Member States. Under Art. 88(1) the Commission has exclusive powers to supervise and enforce the general-purpose AI model obligations in Chapter V. Corrected the sentence.
The title left out the OJ title clause 'and amending Regulations (EC) No 300/2008, ... and Directives ...', which appears on the first page of the extract. Restored the full official title.
The note gave 'Chapter III Sections 1-3' as Arts 9-27. Section 1 starts at Art. 6 (Arts 6-7), Section 2 is Arts 8-15 and Section 3 is Arts 16-27. Changed to Arts 6-27.

The note said the Publications Office copyright page tells readers to see EUR-Lex's own notice for EU legal documents and OJ content. The page I fetched says only that reusing content from EUR-Lex, European Data, EU Tenders and CORDIS is governed by each site's own notice, and that Cellar re-use terms are obtained by contacting the Publications Office. Reworded. The distribution decision is unchanged.
actor is 'operator', which the Act defines as including importers, distributors and others. Art. 4 addresses only providers and deployers. The schema has no combined value, so I left it.

doc_level_changes: title: restored the full official OJ title, including the 'and amending ...' clause
summary_ko: corrected the enforcement description (Member State market surveillance authorities; the Commission for general-purpose AI model obligations, Art. 88(1))
pitfalls_ko[1]: Chapter III Sections 1-3 range corrected from Arts 9-27 to Arts 6-27

license_notice: aligned the Publications Office copyright-page paraphrase with the fetched page. distribution stays local-only because no explicit reuse statement for the OJ text could be confirmed (the EUR-Lex legal notice returns HTTP 202 with an empty body; the Commission legal notice's CC BY 4.0 covers Commission content only).

status, edition, key_dates, language, jurisdiction, binding and official_page_url verified, no change. Verified against the OJ extract (Art. 113, signature date, ELI), the Commission page (entered into force 1 Aug 2024; Omnibus entered into force 27 July 2026; Annex III from 2 Dec 2027; Annex I from 2 Aug 2028) and the text of Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (of 8 July 2026, OJ L 24.7.2026, entry into force on the third day after publication, Art. 113(a)/(c)/(d) as amended, new Art. 111(4) giving 2 Dec 2026 for Art. 50(2)).
remaining_concerns: The EUR-Lex ELI page, the consolidated text and the legal notice all return HTTP 202 with an empty body to curl, so the official_page_url was not fetched directly. It matches the ELI printed in the OJ PDF. I could not rule out a corrigendum or a further amendment after Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, and the note's limitations_ko says so.

Art. 4 and Art. 25(4) are cited from the 2024 OJ text with the 2026/1744 changes flagged in the text. Readers should use the amended wording for Art. 4: it now requires measures to support the development of AI literacy and no guaranteed level.

Most high-risk provisions (Arts 9, 12-15, 19, 25-27, Annex III) carry no application date in timing_ko. The status field and pitfalls_ko give 2 Dec 2027 for Annex III systems and 2 Aug 2028 for Annex I products, but individual rows read without that context could look as if they apply now.

Gateway-control wording in several rows is a design intent or requirement candidate rather than a confirmed product capability (for example, the Art. 6 'high-risk candidate' labels and the Art. 14 approve/deny/revoke flows). That is consistent with the exemplar's style and none of it promises legal compliance.

documents.title: Accelerating the Adoption of Software and AI Agent Identity and Authorization (concept paper)
documents.issuer: NIST National Cybersecurity Center of Excellence (NCCoE) - 저자 Harold Booth, Bill Fisher, Ryan Galluzzo, Joshua Roberts (National Institute of Standards and Technology)
documents.edition: DRAFT 개념 문서(concept paper), 2026년 2월판, 11쪽 PDF (후속 NIST 페이지는 'Software and Agentic AI Identity and Authorization'이라는 약간 다른 명칭을 쓴다)
documents.key_dates: 표지에 'DRAFT, February 2026'. 문서 p.2 l.42: 의견 접수 기간 2026-02-05 ~ 2026-04-02(NIST AI Agent Standards Initiative 페이지의 마감 'April 2'와 일치). 그 NIST 페이지는 2026-02-17 생성, 2026-08-14 갱신으로 표시되며 이 문서를 'Draft Concept Paper'로 계속 나열한다. CSRC 기록은 발행일 2026-02-05, 의견 마감 2026-04-02(접수 종료 표시)로 적는다. NIST 소식(2026-09-29)은 600건 넘는 의견이 접수되어 의견 요약이 공개됐고, 첫 구현 사례는 NCCoE DevSecOps 프로젝트(소프트웨어 개발수명주기)와 함께 만들고 이후에는 고정된 의견 기간 없이 자료를 공개하며 의견을 수시로 검토한다고 밝힌다. NCCoE 의견 요약 허브는 NCCoE가 초안 프로젝트 설명서(draft project description)를 낼 계획이라고 적는다. 개정된 개념 문서, 최종 프로젝트 설명서, 실무 안내서(practice guide)는 확인하지 못했다. PDF 메타데이터상 파일 생성일은 2026-02-04. NCCoE 프로젝트 페이지는 자동 요청이 차단되어(HTTP 403) 직접 읽지 못했다.

defect_list.description: The note said every use case needs delegated and managed access to multiple data sources. The text (p.8 ll.157-163) says this only of use case 1. Use case 2 is 'as with use case #1' with elevated risk, and use case 3 concerns entitlements and authorization in deployment pipelines.

gateway_control_ko stated flatly that MINT verifies OAuth responses and tokens and requires encrypted transport. That reads as current behavior, which the guide does not establish. It is now framed as a mapping item, with current support not confirmed by the note.
The abstract does not say the paper sets no controls or requirements. That was the author's inference, attributed to the abstract. It now reads as an observation about the body text.
'native delegation' was rendered '기본 위임' (default delegation). It is now '내장 위임' (built-in delegation).

Two checked facts were missing. The CSRC record gives published 2026-02-05, comments due 2026-04-02 and 'CLOSED'. The 2026-09-29 NIST news says feedback is now taken on a rolling basis with no fixed comment period. Both were added. The other date and status claims were confirmed (NIST initiative page: created 2026-02-17, updated 2026-08-14, deadline April 2; news and hub: 600+ commenters, DevSecOps first use case, draft project description planned; PDF metadata creation date 2026-02-04).

defect_list.ref: p.6 ll.98-101 and other POL links
defect_list.description: A few pol_ids are loose but not clearly wrong, for example POL-12 on the untrusted-external-agent exclusion, POL-02 on the scope provision, and POL-34 on data provenance. They were left in place.

doc_level_changes: key_dates: added the CSRC record (published 2026-02-05, comments due 2026-04-02, CLOSED) and the 2026-09-29 NIST news statement on rolling feedback with no fixed comment period

edition, issuer, language, jurisdiction, binding=false, instrument_type=draft, status=draft, official_page_url confirmed or left unchanged. The official_page_url is in the NIST search index and the page itself returns Cloudflare 403 to curl and WebFetch, so it was not read or worked around.

distribution=public-under-license kept. Both license_notice URLs were fetched and confirmed: nist.gov/copyrights-disclaimers (NIST site information is public and may be distributed or copied, credit requested) and the NIST copyright/fair-use/licensing statement (works of NIST employees fall under 17 U.S.C. 105, with a royalty-free worldwide grant for any foreign rights). The PDF has no copyright mark, and its four authors are listed as NIST on the CSRC record. The NCCoE project page notice remains unread, as the note already says.
remaining_concerns: The NCCoE project page (official_page_url) could not be read (HTTP 403 Cloudflare), so its own status line and any page-specific notice are unverified. The status draft was checked against the CSRC record, the NIST initiative page, the 2026-09-29 news and the resource hub. No draft project description, revised concept paper or practice guide was found as of 2026-10-17.
Figures 1 and 2 have no text layer and were not checked.

Some gateway_control_ko entries describe MINT behaviors (delegation verification, token claim checks, input normalization) beyond the capability list in NOTE_GUIDE. They are framed as mappings or design inputs and the limitations_ko says so, so they were left, with only the MCP entry softened.

documents.title: Careful adoption of agentic AI services
documents.issuer: 호주 ASD ACSC, 미국 CISA·NSA, 캐나다 Canadian Centre for Cyber Security, 뉴질랜드 NCSC-NZ, 영국 NCSC-UK 공동 저술(문서 본문이 ‘authoring agencies’로 명시). 호주 정부 ASD 사이트가 대표 게시처
documents.edition: 2026년 5월 공동 지침(발행 2026-05-01), 29쪽. 수집본은 NCSC-NZ 호스팅 PDF(SHA-256 d41bc59c…, 1,282,578바이트)이며 ASD 호스팅 PDF(2026-10 경로, 1,257,754바이트)와 파일은 다르나 본문은 쪽 단위로 대조해 실질 동일함을 확인했다
documents.key_dates: 발행일 2026-05-01: ASD 공식 게시 페이지(Published 01 May 2026, Last reviewed 01 May 2026), CISA 페이지(Publish Date May 01, 2026), NCSC-NZ 페이지(PUBLISHED DATE: 1 May 2026), 캐나다 Cyber Centre 페이지(Date modified: 2026-05-01)로 확인. 문서 본문에는 발행일·버전·시행일 표기가 없다(비구속 지침이므로 시행일 개념 없음). 일부 2차 출처의 2026-04-30 표기는 공식 페이지로 확인되지 않았다. ASD 사이트의 PDF 파일은 파일명에 (May 2026)이 붙어 있으나 2026-10 경로에 올라와 있고 서버 Last-Modified가 2026-10-13, PDF 생성일이 2026-10-01이다. 페이지에는 개정 이력 표시가 없어 이 재게시가 내용 개정인지는 확인하지 못했다.

defect_list.description: 요약이 문서의 권고를 '건별 사람 승인'이라고 적었다. 원문(p.15, p.22)은 의사결정 단계의 필수 사람 승인과 오류 비용이 큰 행동의 사람 검토·승인 체크포인트를 권고할 뿐 호출 건별 승인을 요구하지 않는다.
함정 항목이 22쪽의 권고를 '건별 승인 요구'라고 표기했다. 원문은 고비용 행동에 사람 승인 체크포인트를 두라는 취지다.
gateway_control_ko가 서버별 자격증명 브로커가 '단기·범위 한정 자격을 발급'한다고 이미 가능한 것처럼 적었다. 제품 능력 목록은 서버별 자격 중개와 회수·교체까지만 정한다. 단기(JIT) 발급은 후보 요구사항으로 낮췄다.
gateway_control_ko가 '권한 축소' 자동화를 제품 기능처럼 적었다. 제품이 갖춘 것은 연결 자동 중지다. 권한 자동 축소는 요구사항 후보로 표기했다.

defect_list.ref: p.18 개발 · 서드파티 구성요소(자기 권한 변경·무승인 위임 금지)
defect_list.description: 원문 'without explicit expiry timers and recorded grant chains'가 걸리는 범위가 모호한데 한쪽 해석으로만 풀어 썼다. 모호함을 그대로 밝히도록 고쳤다.
앵커는 '최소권한 원칙의 엄격한 준수가 핵심'인데 obligation_ko에 그 내용이 없었다. 해당 문장을 앞에 추가했다.
'Validate context to ensure the system correctly interprets intent'를 '의도를 맥락에서 검증'으로 풀어 의미가 뒤틀렸다. 맥락을 검증해 의도를 올바르게 해석하는지 확인한다는 뜻으로 바로잡았다.

defect_list.ref: p.21 운영 · 모니터링과 감사(런타임 이상 탐지)
defect_list.description: timing_ko가 '실시간'이었다. 해당 불릿은 'runtime monitoring'이며 real-time은 다른 불릿에 나온다. '런타임'으로 고쳤다.

defect_list.ref: pol_ids (p.11 도구 사용 POL-37, p.15 신원 관리 POL-11, p.19 거버넌스 POL-02)
defect_list.description: 세 연결은 관련성이 약하지만 명백히 틀리지는 않고 gateway_control_ko의 근거와 이어져 그대로 두었다.

NCSC-NZ 페이지(PUBLISHED DATE 1 May 2026)와 캐나다 Cyber Centre 페이지(Date modified 2026-05-01) 기재는 두 페이지의 URL을 찾지 못해 직접 재확인하지 못했다. ASD 페이지(Published 01 May 2026, Last reviewed 01 May 2026)와 CISA 페이지(Publish Date May 01, 2026)는 확인했다. NCSC-NZ PDF의 Last-Modified(2026-04-30 23:27 GMT, 뉴질랜드 시각 5월 1일)는 기재와 모순되지 않는다.
ASD 호스팅 PDF와 수집본의 쪽 단위 텍스트 비교 결과(22쪽 일치, 7쪽 라벨 차이)는 다시 대조하지 않았다. 재확인한 것은 ASD PDF의 크기 1,257,754바이트와 Last-Modified 2026-10-13, 수집본 PDF의 크기 1,282,578바이트다. 두 값 모두 기재와 일치한다.

doc_level_changes: summary_ko: '건별 사람 승인'을 '고비용 행동의 사람 승인 체크포인트'로 정정

제목, 발행기관, 판본, 발행일, 상태(voluntary), 언어, 관할, 구속력, official_page_url은 ASD 공식 페이지와 CISA 페이지로 확인하고 수정하지 않았다

distribution public-under-license 유지: 문서 29쪽 저작권 항목(CC BY 4.0, 국장과 별도 표시 자료 제외)과 https://www.cyber.gov.au/copyright(2026-10-17 열람, Last reviewed 13 Jan 2026, 귀속 표기 '© Commonwealth of Australia 2026')를 직접 확인했다
remaining_concerns: NCSC-NZ 페이지와 캐나다 Cyber Centre 페이지의 날짜 기재는 직접 재확인하지 못했다. 발행일 2026-05-01은 ASD와 CISA 페이지로 뒷받침된다.
ASD 호스팅 PDF(2026-10 경로, Last-Modified 2026-10-13)가 내용 개정본인지는 알 수 없다. 페이지에는 개정 이력 표시가 없다.

CC BY 4.0 안내는 '국장과 별도 표시 자료 제외'다. 공동 저자 기관 로고나 표지 그림을 그대로 재배포할 때의 권리는 중앙 검토에서 확인해야 한다.
ref는 조문 번호가 없어 쪽과 절 제목으로 표기했다. 25개 앵커가 모두 ref에 적은 쪽 안에 있음을 스크립트로 확인했다.

documents.title: Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI (Version 1.5)
documents.issuer: Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA), 싱가포르
documents.edition: Version 1.5, 발행 2026-05-20, 갱신 2026-06-05 (PDF 표지 표기). 최초 공개판은 2026-01 (IMDA 페이지: 2026-01 최초 발행, 2026-05 개정)
documents.key_dates: PDF 표지: 'Version 1.5 | Published 20 May 2026 (Updated 5 June 2026)'. IMDA 보도자료(게시일 2026-01-22): 싱가포르 디지털개발정보부 장관이 세계경제포럼(WEF)에서 이 프레임워크의 공개를 발표했다고 밝힌다(보도자료 본문에 개최지 표기는 확인하지 못함). IMDA 'Artificial Intelligence in Singapore' 페이지(페이지 갱신일 2026-10-14 표기)는 IMDA가 2026년 1월에 처음 발행했고 2026년 5월 갱신으로 사례와 다중 에이전트·제3자 에이전트·자동화 편향 관련 모범 사례를 추가했다고 적고 v1.5로 PDF를 링크한다. 보도자료는 '살아 있는 문서(living document)'라 밝힌다. 시행일·적용일·이행 기한은 없다(비구속 문서). v1.0 PDF의 판 표기·정확한 일자는 확인하지 못했다.

defect_list.description: Note said the framework was announced at WEF in Davos. The IMDA press release (22 Jan 2026) says only that the Minister announced it 'at the World Economic Forum (WEF)'. It does not name Davos; the scout lead was the origin of that detail.

Source says organisations 'can consider testing for' task execution, policy compliance, tool calling and robustness. The note turned this into an instruction ('시험하라고 한다'). The pre-deployment testing duty itself is stated with 'should' in the source.

defect_list.ref: §2.3.3 Key considerations for monitoring (p.44), alert thresholds
defect_list.description: Source says higher-priority alerts 'might require temporarily halting agent execution until a human reviewer can assess'. The note said execution should be paused until review. Termination and fallback were already correctly stated as 'should be considered'.

defect_list.ref: §2.3.3 Key considerations for monitoring (p.44), what to log
defect_list.description: Multi-layer monitoring (user-agent, agent-tool, model reasoning) sits under 'Organisations can consider implementing these practices'. The note phrased it as an instruction ('모니터링하라고도 한다').

The provision is marked informative. Its anchor is a statement that deployers and their overseers remain accountable, but the paraphrase also includes a recommendation (chain of accountability, adaptive governance, from 'organisations should consider'). Informative is defensible for the anchored statement, so no change was made.

doc_level_changes: Document-level facts re-checked against the IMDA 'Artificial Intelligence in Singapore' page, the 22 Jan 2026 press release and the IMDA Terms of Use, all fetched live. Title, issuer (IMDA only, no AI Verify Foundation anywhere in the PDF text), edition v1.5 (published 20 May 2026, updated 5 Jun 2026), first publication Jan 2026, May 2026 update, 'living document' wording, the AI page's last-updated date (14 Oct 2026) and status voluntary/non-binding all hold. The only doc-level fix: key_dates no longer says Davos.

Distribution decision confirmed as local-only. The IMDA Terms of Use (last updated 25 May 2026) allow use, copying and distribution only for personal, internal, non-commercial, informational purposes, and require prior written permission for other reproduction or distribution. The PDF itself carries no copyright, licence or reuse notice (grep of the full extract finds none). license_notice and distribution_reason therefore stand.

Checked reading_scope_ko and pitfalls_ko against the extract. The 14 case-study names all appear. The word 'voluntary' does not appear in the PDF, as the note says. There is no PDPA, cross-border or incident-reporting content, as the note says. The extract has 3,225 lines, matching the note's 'about 3,200 lines'.
remaining_concerns: Binding status is inferred from the document's guidance tone, not from an explicit 'voluntary' statement. The note says so in pitfalls_ko, which is honest.

gateway_control_ko entries describe MINT capabilities per the NOTE_GUIDE capability list. They are mapping proposals, and the note's limitations_ko says current implementation was not checked. Where a field's current support is unverified (the independent/on-behalf-of field, user-defined approval thresholds), the text hedges.

The scout lead's 'AI Verify Foundation' co-issuer claim is correctly dropped. The note also records that the v1.0 PDF was not seen, so citing the original January edition could give different section positions.

documents.status: in_force (비구속 정책 의견: 2026-05-08 공동 인쇄·게시, 본문에 시행일 조항 없음, 2026-10-17 공식 페이지 게재 유지 확인)
