documents.key_dates: 中国网信网 게시 2026-05-08 18:00(페이지 표기). 같은 날 게시된 공식 문답은 세 기관이 공동 인쇄했다고 서술한다. 본문에는 시행일·문서 번호가 없는 정책 의견이다. 별도 시행일을 적은 외부 요약이 있다는 정보(조사 메모)는 공식 본문·문답으로 확인되지 않았으므로 인용하지 않는다.

defect_list.description: The note stated as fact that 'some law-firm summaries' give 2026-07-15 and that this date comes from a separate Anthropomorphic AI Interaction measure. Neither the extract nor the official pages (article and Q&A) support this; it was copied from the scouting memo.

scope_ko said items 5 and 11 'foreshadow' enactment of laws and introduction of tiering. Item 5 only says 'accelerate research on' policies, laws and ethics, and pitfalls[0] itself says this is not a legislative announcement. Item 11 states a governance framework without any timing.

Bare 'in_force' for a non-binding policy opinion with no effective-date clause. Now qualified as a non-binding policy opinion, jointly issued and published 2026-05-08, still posted on 2026-10-17 (the live page hash is identical to the staged copy).

Cited verification sources (State Copyright Administration full text, MOFCOM database) that I cannot confirm were consulted, and relied on an unverified cross-reference to LIB-M09. Rewritten to rest only on the centrally verified Art. 5(1) evidence, the footer '(c) all rights reserved' with no reuse terms, and the Q&A statement of joint issuance. States that the 'administrative document' classification is the note's judgment. The staged HTML also contains site menu/footer/ICP chrome, so the reasoning covers the document text only. Decision kept at public-under-license, with a revert condition.

gateway_control claimed 'recovery' via POL-50 (restore does not reactivate decommissioned connections). The text's 'recovery' means restoring compliant behaviour; this is a stretch. The control text also said 'implements'. Removed POL-50 and the recovery clause, and reworded to 'can provide'. Also changed 'adversarial sample' wording (对抗样本).

defect_list.ref: actor on provisions 제6, 제7(x2), 제8, 제9, 제10, 제21
defect_list.description: actor was 'operator', but the text names no addressee and the note's own scope_ko says there is no specific obligated party. Changed to 'any'. Authority actors for 4/11/12/六 kept (item 11 and 六 name the authorities explicitly; 4 and 12 are policy-level).

Said the default-deny rule 'acts as' a behaviour fence and the ledger 'provides' verifiability, with no limit on the physical-place legality that the text mentions. Hedged and scoped to tool-call level.
Claimed linkage to policy versions and detection of tampering via a hash chain. Neither is in the product description or the POL text. Replaced with the append-only audit ledger.
Used English decision labels (Block/Approval/Restrict) that are not in the guide or the POLs. Replaced with the generic block, individual approval and call/bulk-read limits.
Claimed the product keeps test plans and exports the ledger in a reproducible format. Not supported. Changed to a possible evidence input, marked as unconfirmed.

'Conceptually identical' to a national agent digital-identity platform. MINT's registry is of servers and capabilities, not agent digital identities. Changed to 'similar in nature' and stated that agent identity management is outside the gateway's scope.
信贷违约预测 rendered as 'loan delinquency' (연체); 违约 is default (채무불이행).
Traditional-character slips (中国網信網, 網信) where the source uses simplified characters. Also: the issuer evidence now cites the official Q&A ('联合印发') as well as chapter 六.
English gloss in the title was presented as if official; no official English version exists. Labelled as an unofficial translation.
'No sanctions' did not mention item 14 (credit evaluation, 失信惩戒 'in accordance with laws'). Added a note that it is not a penalty provision of this document.

doc_level_changes: issuer: added the Q&A statement of joint issuance as evidence (checked the live Q&A page c_1779979789738376.htm)
status: qualified (non-binding policy opinion, no effective-date clause, still posted 2026-10-17)
key_dates: removed the unverified 2026-07-15 / other-document claim; kept the 2026-05-08 18:00 publication date (matches the page)
scope_ko: removed the 'foreshadows legislation' contradiction
license_notice and distribution_reason: rewritten to state exactly the evidence used; distribution kept public-under-license
reading_scope_ko: recorded that the Q&A was checked only at verification time
title: marked English text as unofficial translation
remaining_concerns: Distribution rests on the note's reading that a non-binding joint 'implementation opinion' is a document of an administrative nature under PRC Copyright Law Art. 5(1). The site makes no explicit reuse statement. The staged HTML also carries site template, footer ('(c) all rights reserved') and ICP chrome that this reasoning does not cover. A conservative reviewer may prefer local-only.
The POL mappings for provision 2 (基本原则 principle: POL-22, POL-38) are generic and weak. They were kept because they are not wrong, only loose.
Provisions 'Item 7 (행동 관제)' and 'Item 7 (추적 가능성)' overlap in obligation text. Both anchors are correct, so both were kept.
The 2026-07-15 claim in the scouting memo remains unverified. It is no longer cited, but no search was run to refute it.
Korean renderings such as 备案=등록 and 授权=승인 are translation choices. 'Authorised decision' is rendered as 'approved decision' (사용자 승인 결정).

documents.title: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data, and repealing Directive 95/46/EC (General Data Protection Regulation)
documents.issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union (관보 OJ L 119, 4.5.2016 게재; 발행처 Publications Office of the EU)
documents.edition: OJ L 119, 4.5.2016, pp. 1-88 최초 게재본 (정오표 미반영, EUR-Lex PDF 판)
documents.key_dates: 채택 2016-04-27. 관보 게재 2016-05-04(PDF 각 쪽 머리글의 4.5.2016). 제99조제1항: 게재일 이후 20일째 날 발효 — Publications Office의 CELLAR 레코드는 발효일 2016-05-24, 유효 종료일 9999-12-31(종료 없음), in-force=true로 기록. 제99조제2항(원문 확인): 2018-05-25부터 적용. CELLAR는 이 규정에 연결된 정오표 3건(OJ L 314 [2016], OJ L 127 [2018], OJ L 74 [2021])을 기록하며 이 PDF에는 반영되지 않았다(정오표 내용은 읽지 않음). CELLAR에서 이 규정을 개정하는 법령은 확인되지 않았다(2026-10-17). 디지털 옴니버스 개정 제안은 COM(2025) 837, 2025-11-19 제출(절차 2025/0360(COD)); 유럽의회 입법관측소 페이지(2026-10-17 열람)는 '위원회 결정 대기(Awaiting committee decision)'로 표시하며 채택·관보 게재 사실은 없다. EUR-Lex의 ELI·HTML 페이지는 봇 차단(HTTP 202, 빈 응답)으로 직접 열람하지 못했다.

defect_list.description: Art. 45(1) is permissive ("may take place ... shall not require any specific authorisation"), but the provision was tagged strength=mandatory. The guide reserves mandatory for must/shall duties.

obligation_ko listed "제3국 이전과 보호조치 문서" as if safeguards documentation were required for every third-country transfer. Art. 30(1)(e) requires safeguards documentation only for transfers under the second subparagraph of Art. 49(1).

gateway_control_ko said the alert timestamp in the ledger "proves" the 72-hour start. The legal trigger is the controller "becoming aware", which is not the same as the alert time. The control also implied a legal conclusion.

The anchor began in the tail of Art. 13(2)(e) ("possible consequences of failure to provide such data") and only then reached (f). The same words also appear in Art. 14(2)(g) and Art. 15(1)(h). Replaced with a (f)-specific verbatim phrase.
POL-08 (connection approval and user consent) does not match a notice duty about automated decisions or the gateway_control text. POL-38 kept.
gateway_control_ko stated retention expiry, deletion and deletion evidence as existing capabilities. Reworded as a requirement to build.

The note has 30 provisions, above the guide's 8-25 range. All 30 are text-supported, so none were removed, as the instructions say not to delete supported provisions. check_notes.py does not flag the count.
The title omits the OJ heading suffix "(Text with EEA relevance)". This is cosmetic; the rest of the official title matches the PDF.

doc_level_changes: No document-level fields were changed.

Verified against the CELLAR SPARQL endpoint (publications.europa.eu): signature 2016-04-27, entry into force 2016-05-24, application 2018-05-25, in-force=1, end of validity 9999-12-31. Three corrigenda R(01), R(02) and R(03) are linked and no amending act is linked.

Verified against the European Parliament Legislative Observatory page for 2025/0360(COD): COM(2025)0837 published 19/11/2025, status 'Awaiting committee decision', no adoption. The page lists the procedure as amending Regulation 2016/679.
Verified Art. 99(1) and 99(2) against the extract. Publication 4.5.2016 plus 20 days gives 24.5.2016, and the Regulation applies from 25.5.2018.

Distribution kept as public-under-license. license_notice quotes the EUR-Lex Copyright notice (© European Union 1998-2026, Decision 2011/833/EU, legal documents re-usable commercially and non-commercially unless otherwise specified). The staged copy web/eurlex_legal_notice.html contains that text. A grep of the extract found no PDF-specific restriction.
remaining_concerns: EUR-Lex returns HTTP 202 with an empty body to curl and WebFetch (both the ELI page and the legal notice). I could not re-fetch the legal notice live. The licence text was checked only against the author's staged copy (web/eurlex_legal_notice.html). Status and dates were checked through CELLAR and the Legislative Observatory.

The Art. 22(1) gateway_control_ko proposes human approval for high-risk tools. The note's pitfalls already warn that this may not remove the 'solely automated' character, and that is left to the organisation to judge.

Art. 25(1) is tagged theme=security_risk_management. Data protection by design could equally fit data_minimisation_retention_deletion or secure_development_supply_chain. This is a judgement call and was not changed.
The PDF is the original OJ text without the three corrigenda. The note says so, but any citation should be checked against the corrected consolidated text.

documents.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
documents.issuer: 미국 상무부 국립표준기술연구소(NIST), 정보기술연구소(ITL) AI 프로그램
documents.edition: AI RMF 1.0 (NIST AI 100-1), 2023년 1월판, DOI 10.6028/NIST.AI.100-1
documents.key_dates: 2023-01-26 공개(NIST 공식 페이지의 'Released on January 26, 2023'로 확인; 문서 표지는 January 2023). 문서 'Update Schedule and Versions'(PDF 3쪽)는 AI 커뮤니티의 공식 의견을 받는 검토가 늦어도 2028년까지 있을 것으로 예상한다고 적는다. 2026-10-17에 연 NIST 공식 페이지는 'AI RMF 1.0 is being revised as part of the White House AI Action Plan'이라고 밝히지만 개정 초안·후속 문서 번호는 그 페이지에서 확인되지 않았다. 같은 페이지에 따르면 생성형 AI 프로파일(NIST-AI-600-1)이 2024-07-26에, 핵심기반시설 AI 프로파일 개념 노트가 2026-04-07에 공개되었다. 자발적 틀이라 시행일·발효일 개념은 없다.

defect_list.description: obligation_ko said organizations 'must document' risk management with AI RMF. The text says only that once tolerance is defined, the AI RMF 'can be used to manage risks and to document' them. The 'should' applies to following existing regulations and to defining reasonable risk tolerance.

The text says higher initial prioritization 'may be called for' (permissive), not a 'should'. Strength was 'recommended'. gateway_control_ko also stated flatly that personal-data calls are designated high-risk. Changed to 'informative' and reworded the control as something policy can be configured to do.
The source says transparency is 'often necessary' for actionable redress. The note dropped 'often'.
gateway_control_ko stated a role-separation and self-approval-ban permission model as an existing feature. That is not in the MINT capability vocabulary. Reworded to say it can be configured.
gateway_control_ko stated the tool catalog with intended-use, risk-grade and approval-type fields as an existing feature. Hedged to 'can'.
gateway_control_ko said evidence of description/behaviour tests is kept, as if already done. Hedged to 'can keep'.
obligation_ko said 'human override' (사람의 번복). The source says only 'appeal and override' and does not say the override is by a human. Removed the added actor.

Theme was agentic_ai, but the passage covers human roles and oversight across human-AI configurations. The document never mentions agents (grep confirmed). agentic_ai could imply NIST addresses agentic AI. Changed to human_oversight. The MINT-interpretation caveat in gateway_control_ko is kept.

POL-02 is only loosely related to the AI system definition, and the claim that read/write/execute logs let autonomy level be told apart afterwards is a stretch. This is not clearly wrong, so it was left and flagged.
The note has 29 provisions, above the guide's 8-25 range. The checker passes. All provisions are supported by the text, so none were removed.

doc_level_changes: None needed. Re-checked against the NIST official page fetched 2026-10-17. Released January 26, 2023. The page says 'The AI RMF 1.0 is being revised as part of the White House AI Action Plan', and no draft or successor ID exists on the AI RMF page or the AI RMF Development page. The generative AI profile NIST-AI-600-1 was released 2024-07-26. The Critical Infrastructure Profile concept note was released 2026-04-07. The page links the PDF at nvlpubs and the DOI 10.6028/NIST.AI.100-1, and the local PDF SHA-256 matches provenance.json. The 'review no later than 2028' sentence is on PDF p.3 (Update Schedule and Versions) of the extract. Title, issuer, edition, status (voluntary), binding=false, language, jurisdiction and official_page_url are correct.

Distribution 'public-under-license' confirmed. The NIST Technical Series statement at nist.gov/open/copyright-fair-use-and-licensing-statements-srd-data-software-and-technical-series-publications says NIST-employee works are not copyright-protected in the US, grants a worldwide, non-exclusive, perpetual, royalty-free right to reprint, asks for 'Republished courtesy of the National Institute of Standards and Technology', and warns that third-party-written works may be copyrighted. The NIST series page lists NIST AI 100 under the Technical Report Series. The extract has no copyright notice, and Fig. 2 is marked 'Modified from OECD (2022)'. The license_notice paraphrase and the distribution_reason hedge match these sources.
remaining_concerns: NIST says AI RMF 1.0 is being revised, so subcategory numbers and wording may change. The note already says this in key_dates and pitfalls_ko. Re-check before citing in requirements.
The licence grant covers works authored by NIST employees. The document does not state its authorship, and Fig. 2 is OECD-derived. The note leaves figure inclusion to central review.
gateway_control_ko entries are MINT proposals. Even after hedging, some read as declarative statements, as in the exemplar. They are not claims of legal compliance.
Page refs use printed page numbers (PDF page minus 5). All 29 refs were checked against the extract page markers and are consistent.

documents.title: Securing Agentic AI – An Addendum to the Guidelines and Companion Guide on Securing AI Systems
documents.issuer: Cyber Security Agency of Singapore (CSA, 싱가포르 사이버보안청)
documents.edition: 버전 1.0 (2026-06-17 정식 발간). 버전 0.1은 2025-10-22 공개 의견수렴본(PDF 4쪽 버전 이력)
documents.key_dates: PDF 4쪽 버전 이력: 0.1은 2025-10-22 공개 의견수렴용으로 공개, 1.0은 2026-06-17 정식 발간. 공식 페이지: 게시일 2026-06-17, 공개 의견수렴 기간 2025-10-22~2025-12-31. 법적 효력 발생일·시행일은 없음(자발적 지침이며 문서 스스로 의무적이지 않다고 밝힘). 2026-10-17 시점의 공식 페이지에는 이 PDF 한 건만 게시되어 있고 후속 개정판은 확인되지 않았다.

defect_list.description: gateway_control_ko가 '게이트웨이를 거치지 않는 직접 연결을 차단·탐지한다'고 현재형으로 적었으나 이는 제품 기본 기능 목록에 없는 후보 기능(POL-12)이다.
'SIEM으로 내보내는 연동을 제공한다'는 제품이 이미 제공한다는 뜻이라 근거가 없다. 요구사항으로 낮췄다.
원문은 중앙 미들웨어 경유를 'where applicable'(해당되는 경우)로 한정하는데 obligation_ko가 이를 빠뜨렸다.
'Validate package hashes if available'를 무조건 해시 검증으로 적었고, SLA는 'could be done by'(예시)인데 확보 수단처럼 단정했다.
원문은 에이전트 고유 식별자를 분산 식별자(DID)로 쓰라고 하는데 obligation_ko가 DID를 빠뜨렸다. gateway_control_ko의 'DID 지원 여부는 확정되지 않는다'는 문장과 맥락이 어긋났다.
POL-40(연결 목적지 변경 재승인)은 도구 정의 몰래 재정의(rug pull) 점검과 직접 관련이 없다. POL-37, POL-11, POL-05는 유지했다.
입력·실행 대상을 규격과 대조해 거부한다는 문장이 현재 구현된 기능처럼 읽힌다. 요구사항 표현으로 낮췄다.
원장에 소요시간 등을 '포함한다'고 현재형으로 적었으나 제품 기본 기능 목록에 없다. 요구사항 표현으로 낮췄다.
통제 표제는 사람의 감독을 'when viable or appropriate'(실행 가능하거나 적절한 경우)로 한정하는데 빠져 있었다.
문서는 이 목록을 'Anthropic의 MCP 규격이 제공하는 안전한 사용·구성 권고'로 소개하고 각주 20·21로 출처를 단다. 노트는 이를 CSA 자체 권고처럼 읽히게 썼다.
공식 페이지 제목은 하이픈이 아니라 en dash(–)를 쓴다.

doc_level_changes: title의 하이픈을 공식 페이지 표기(en dash)로 정정
provisions 4·7·21·23의 gateway_control_ko에서 제품이 이미 하는 것처럼 읽히는 현재형 서술을 요구사항 표현으로 낮춤
provisions 8·10·27의 obligation_ko에 원문 단서를 보강(해시 검증은 가능하면, DID, 사람 감독은 실행 가능하거나 적절한 경우)
provisions 28·29에 Anthropic MCP 규격 권고 목록(각주 20·21)이라는 출처 표시를 추가
provision 19에서 POL-40 연결 제거
official_page_url, 게시일(2026-06-17), 의견수렴 기간(2025-10-22~2025-12-31), 버전 이력, 2024년 지침 발간, 파일 크기(5.12 MB), 이용약관(2025-01-27 갱신) 재확인. 변경 없음. distribution은 local-only 유지
remaining_concerns: 통제표가 PDF 텍스트 레이어에서 열 순서가 섞여 추출되므로, 각 anchor가 속한 통제 번호와 쪽은 앞뒤 헤더로 확인했지만 표의 위험-완화 행 대응은 원본 쪽에서 눈으로 확인하는 것이 안전하다.
pol_ids 일부(provision 18의 POL-05·POL-42, provision 13의 POL-40)는 연관이 느슨하지만 명백한 오류는 아니라서 남겼다.
사례 연구(57~85쪽)와 참고문헌은 이 노트의 근거가 아니고, 해당 부분은 이번 검증에서도 읽지 않았다.

documents.title: 生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法
documents.issuer: 국가인터넷정보판공실(CAC)·국가발전개혁위원회·교육부·과학기술부·공업정보화부·공안부·국가광파전시총국 (7개 기관 공동 령)
documents.edition: 국가인터넷정보판공실 등 7개 기관 령 제15호(2023-07-10 서명), 총 5장 24조
documents.key_dates: 2023-05-23 CAC 室务会 심의 통과, 2023-07-10 령 일자(gov.cn 정책문서고 成文日期도 동일), 2023-07-13 中国网信网 게시, 2023-08-15 시행(제24조). 2026-10-17 시점에 CAC 게시본과 gov.cn 정책문서고 게시본에서 개정·폐지 표시를 찾지 못했고 웹 검색에서도 개정·대체 사실을 찾지 못했다(공식 법규 데이터베이스에서의 현행 효력 조회는 하지 못함).

defect_list.description: The text says 及时 (promptly / in a timely manner). The note rendered it as 즉시 (immediately) in obligation_ko and timing_ko, which contradicted its own pitfall saying 及时 sets no fixed time.
The article has no must/shall wording. It states the penalties and orders that authorities impose, so 'mandatory' was wrong for an enforcement clause.
Art. 4 opens with 提供和使用 (provision and use), so it covers both providers and users. The note set the actor to provider only.
gateway_control_ko said the labelling duty is dealt with in a separate document, 'AI 생성 합성 콘텐츠 표시 방법'. Art. 12 actually cites 《互联网信息服务深度合成管理规定》, and no such separate document was read.

The summary listed safety assessment and algorithm filing as general requirements. Art. 17 imposes them only on services with 舆论属性 or 社会动员能力. It also called the document a '부문규장', which the extract does not say.
The note said users have almost no duties. Art. 4 applies to both providing and using services.

The note said a foreign provider becomes a 'subject of disposition' under Art. 20. Art. 20 says the national internet-information authority notifies the relevant bodies to take technical and other measures. It also added '내부' (internal) to the Art. 2 exclusion, which the text does not say.
'내부 연구개발·응용' is not in Art. 2(3). The exclusion depends on not offering a service to the domestic public.

gateway_control_ko stated as fact that the ledger can search by data subject, is exportable, or can be queried by complaint, and that the gateway runs a response flow. None of this is established as an existing capability. For 제14조제2항 the note also implied MINT performs the provider's own measures.

POL-07 (external provider's document storage, reuse and third-party provision) was linked to transparency/accuracy, safety assessment and provider-definition provisions. POL-49 (cleanup at termination) was linked to contract signing. Neither fits.

The status in_force relied on the scout's search and the note said it had not repeated the check. I checked the CAC page, the gov.cn policy library (公文种类 命令, 成文日期 2023-07-10, no repeal marking) and web searches. I found no amendment or repeal. I could not read the official legal database (flk.npc.gov.cn, script-rendered). The wording now states exactly this.

The note called the document a 부문규장 and did not say the staged file is the full CAC HTML page with site navigation and a '© 版权所有' footer. I confirmed PRC Copyright Law Art. 5(1) and its 2020 amendment (effective 2021-06-01) on the MOFCOM database, which disclaims being authoritative. I also confirmed 命令 on gov.cn. The fields now state that the evidence covers the legal text and that the status of the page wrapper is not established.
The title field carried an unofficial English translation. It now holds the native title, and title_native is empty because it would be identical.

doc_level_changes: title -> native Chinese title only; title_native emptied
key_dates: replaced the scout-dependent status sentence with the checks I actually performed
summary_ko: removed the '부문규장' label and the unconditional safety-assessment claim
scope_ko and pitfalls_ko: corrected the Art. 2(3), Art. 20 and Art. 4 paraphrases
limitations_ko: states the legal-database gap and that the English title is unofficial

license_notice and distribution_reason rewritten to the evidence used: PRC Copyright Law Art. 5(1) (checked on MOFCOM DB), gov.cn 命令 listing, and the page-wrapper caveat; distribution stays public-under-license
remaining_concerns: The PRC current-validity check rests on CAC and gov.cn listing the document without a repeal marking, plus web searches that found nothing. The official legal database could not be read, so 'in_force' is not confirmed there.

Distribution is kept as public-under-license on the strength of PRC Copyright Law Art. 5(1). That covers the order text, not the CAC page template or its '© 版权所有' footer, which are inside the staged HTML. Treat it as a reviewer decision, with local-only the conservative alternative if the wrapper matters.
The note did not read the cited 《互联网信息服务深度合成管理规定》 or 《互联网信息服务算法推荐管理规定》.

Remaining POL links (POL-02, POL-07, POL-38, POL-43, POL-44, POL-31, POL-48, POL-49) are plausible but judgement calls, not exact matches. The 'candidate' wording in gateway_control_ko was added where the capability is not established.

documents.title: Cybersecurity Law of the People's Republic of China (as amended 2025) / 中华人民共和国网络安全法（2025年修正）
documents.title_native: 中华人民共和国网络安全法
documents.issuer: 중화인민공화국 전국인민대표대회 상무위원회 (수정 결정 2025-10-28 통과, 주석령 제61호로 공포)
documents.edition: 2016-11-07 통과 원법을 2025-10-28 수정 결정(제14기 전국인대 상무위원회 제18차 회의)으로 개정한 통합본(제1~81조), 2026-01-01 시행. 통합본은 국가인터넷정보판공실(CAC) 사이트에 2025-12-29 게시(표기 출처: 중국인대망)
documents.key_dates: 원법: 2016-11-07 통과(제12기 상무위 제24차 회의), 제81조에 따라 2017-06-01 시행. 개정: 2025-10-28 수정 결정 통과(주석령 제61호, 서명일 2025-10-28, CAC 사이트 게시 2025-10-29), 결정 본문과 주석령에 따라 2026-01-01부터 시행. 수정 결정은 신설 제3조·제20조·제63조·제73조를 추가하고 구 제40조를 제42조로, 구 제59조를 제61조로 옮기는 등 조문 순서를 조정해 재공포하도록 했다. 이 통합본 이후의 추가 개정은 확인하지 못했다.

defect_list.description: POL-27(민감한 작업의 개별 승인)은 내부 안전관리제도 수립과 네트워크 안전 책임자 지정이라는 이 조항의 요구와 맞지 않는 연결이었다. 책임자 지정은 조직 절차다.

license_notice가 저작권법 제5조제1호를 근거로 들면서 확인 가능한 URL이 없었다. 국가판권국 게시 저작권법 전문(https://www.ncac.gov.cn/xxfb/flfg/flfg_532/202103/t20210309_50530.html)에서 제5조제1호(법률·법규와 그 공식 번역문은 이 법의 적용 대상이 아님)와 2001·2010·2020-11-11 개정 표시를 직접 확인하고 URL을 추가했다. 이 근거는 발행 기관의 이용 허락 문구가 아니라 법정 비보호 규정이다. CAC 페이지 바닥글에는 사이트 판권 표기가 있으나 별도의 이용 허락·제한 문구는 찾지 못했다. public-under-license는 유지했다.

remaining_concerns: distribution=public-under-license는 발행 기관의 명시적 이용 허락문이 아니라 중국 저작권법 제5조제1호(법률은 보호 대상 아님)에 기댄다. 원본 HTML과 추출본에는 CAC 사이트 메뉴와 판권 바닥글이 섞여 있어, 공개 시에는 조문 본문만 추출한 텍스트를 쓰는 것이 안전하다. 노트의 distribution_reason에도 같은 단서가 있으며 중앙 검토에서 재판단이 필요하다.
공식 PDF가 없고 CAC 사이트의 HTML 통합본을 썼다. npc.gov.cn 법률 데이터베이스의 통합본과는 대조하지 못했다. 수정 결정 원문(npc.gov.cn과 CAC)과는 일치함을 확인했다.

핵심 사실은 모두 공식 페이지에서 재확인했다. 수정 결정은 2025-10-28 제14기 전국인대 상무위 제18차 회의에서 통과됐고 2026-01-01 시행이며, 신설 제3·20·63·73조와 구 제40조의 제42조 이동, 구 제59조의 제61조 이동도 맞다. 주석령 제61호는 CAC 사본에서 서명일이 2025-10-28임을 확인했다. 2026년 추가 개정은 검색에서 발견하지 못했으나 전수 조사는 아니다.
provisions가 27개로 NOTE_GUIDE의 8~25개 권장 범위를 넘지만 check_notes.py는 통과한다. 모든 조항은 근거가 확인돼 삭제하지 않았다.

documents.title: Directive (EU) 2022/2555 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 14 December 2022 on measures for a high common level of cybersecurity across the Union, amending Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 and Directive (EU) 2018/1972, and repealing Directive (EU) 2016/1148 (NIS 2 Directive)
documents.issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
documents.edition: OJ L 333, 27.12.2022, pp. 80-152 (영어본, 관보 원문 PDF 73쪽). 2023-12-22 정오표(OJ L, 2023/90206)는 제19조제1항만 정정하며 이 PDF에는 반영돼 있지 않다.
documents.key_dates: 서명 2022-12-14, 관보 공포 2022-12-27. 발효 2023-01-16(제45조: 공포 후 20일째 날, EUR-Lex 문서 정보 'Date of effect'로 확인). 회원국 국내법 채택·공표 기한 2024-10-17, 적용 2024-10-18(제41조제1항), 같은 날 지침 (EU) 2016/1148 폐지(제44조). 제3조제3항: 필수·중요 개체 목록 작성 기한 2025-04-17. 제27조제2항: 클라우드·관리형 서비스 제공자 등 정보 제출 기한 2025-01-17. 제36조: 처벌 규정 통보 기한 2025-01-17. 제40조: 위원회 검토 2027-10-17 및 이후 36개월마다. 제38조제2항: 제24조제2항 위임 권한은 2023-01-16부터 5년. EUR-Lex 문서 정보(2026-10-17 열람)는 종료일 없음, 현행 통합본 27/12/2022, 개정 '제안' 2건(COM(2025) 837 final 2025-11-19 디지털 옴니버스, COM(2026) 13 final 2026-01-20 NIS2 간소화·사이버보안법 2 정합)을 표시한다. 두 제안의 채택 여부와 각국 국내법 시행일은 이 노트에서 확인하지 않았다.

defect_list.description: The pitfall said the 24h, 72h and 1-month deadlines all run from when the entity becomes aware. Art. 23(4)(d) runs the one-month final report from submission of the incident notification (the provision entry itself was correct). Rewritten.

The second sentence said minimal processing is required for incident reports and logs. Art. 2(14) does not say that. Also omitted single points of contact from the list of processors. Sentence removed and the actor list completed.
'감사 방해' dropped the qualifier in (a)(iv): the obstructed audits or monitoring must be ones the authority ordered after finding an infringement. Qualifier restored.

Said the product provides a 24-hour deadline timer and owner notification, which are not part of the stated MINT capabilities. Reworded: the alert time is recorded in the ledger as evidence, and the timer and notification are only feature candidates.
Asserted that the export feature already generates results directly from the ledger and records a hash. Reworded as a requirement candidate.

Said the equivalent duty is under 'Arts. 21 and 23'. Art. 4(1) says 'obligations laid down in this Directive'; the Art. 21(1)-(2) and 23(1)-(6) equivalence tests are in Art. 4(2). Also omitted the rule that the Directive still applies to entities the sector act does not cover. Fixed both.
'제21조 요건 준수' should be 'particular requirements of Article 21'. Fixed.

The sentence about stating the purpose of a request comes from Art. 32(3), not 32(2). Ref changed to Art. 32(2)-(3). Also corrected 'regular and ad hoc audits' to regular and targeted audits plus ad hoc audits.
The turnover base is the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year of the undertaking the entity belongs to. Added.
Described Art. 32 as 'ex ante and ex post'. Art. 32 does not use those words and the recitals were not read. Art. 33(1) does say 'ex post'. Reworded to what the articles say.
The statement that NIS2 does not replace the GDPR rests on Art. 2(12) (without prejudice), not only 2(14) and 35. Cite added.
POL-07 covers checking an external provider's document handling. The provision is about whether MINT itself is an in-scope service type. Link removed.
POL-44 (revocation and disconnection) does not relate to telling service recipients about a cyber threat. Link removed, POL-43 kept.
The text lists criteria (a) and (b) with no 'or'. The note's '또는' follows the usual alternative reading. Left unchanged.
Trust service providers have a 24h (not 72h) deadline under the derogation in 23(4). Not mentioned in the note. Left unchanged since it affects few MINT customers.
The note has 30 provisions; NOTE_GUIDE suggests 8-25. check_notes.py does not flag this. No provision was removed because all 30 anchors and refs are supported.

doc_level_changes: No change to title, issuer, edition, status (in_force), key_dates, language, jurisdiction, binding, official_page_url or the distribution decision. All checked against the OJ PDF extract and the live EUR-Lex pages (read through the browser pane; curl returns HTTP 202).

EUR-Lex document information confirms: OJ L 333, 27.12.2022, pp. 80-152; document date 14/12/2022; date of effect 16/01/2023; transposition adoption 17/10/2024 and application 18/10/2024; review deadline 17/10/2027; art. 38.2 deadline 16/01/2028; no end date; 'In force'; amendment proposals 52025PC0837 and 52026PC0013.
COM(2025) 837 final is dated 19.11.2025 (Digital Omnibus, regulation). COM(2026) 13 final is dated 20.1.2026 (directive, simplification and alignment with Cybersecurity Act 2).
Corrigendum R(04) (OJ L 2023/90206, 22.12.2023, covers EN) changes Art. 19(1) from 'on 17 January 2025' to 'by 17 January 2025'. The extract still has 'on', as the note says.

Licence: EUR-Lex copyright notice (https://eur-lex.europa.eu/content/legal-notice/legal-notice.html) says, based on Decision 2011/833/EU and 'unless otherwise specified', EUR-Lex legal documents can be reused commercially or non-commercially. Only OJ documents are authentic. A text search of the PDF found no reuse restriction. The public-under-license decision is kept.
remaining_concerns: 30 provisions exceeds the 8-25 range suggested in NOTE_GUIDE; the checker does not flag it.
Art. 23(3) is paraphrased with '또는'; the text has no conjunction, though the alternative reading is the common one.
The recitals, Arts. 7-19, 31 (partly), 37 and Annexes II-III were not read, as the note says, so the pitfalls rely only on the articles that were read.
National transposition laws and the Commission implementing acts under Arts. 21(5) and 23(11) are not covered, as the note says. The adoption status of the two amendment proposals was not checked.

documents.title: Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations (NIST SP 800-53, Revision 5)
documents.issuer: NIST (미국 국립표준기술연구소) Joint Task Force, 미국 상무부
documents.edition: Rev. 5, September 2020 (includes updates as of 12-10-2020), DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-53r5. 읽은 PDF는 Release 5.2.0(2025-08-27) 변경이 반영되지 않은 2020년판이다.
documents.key_dates: 확인한 사실. (1) 표지 쪽: 'September 2020', 'INCLUDES UPDATES AS OF 12-10-2020; SEE PAGE XVII'. 쪽 xvii의 정오표 표는 모든 항목이 12-10-2020 날짜이고 이후 날짜 항목은 없다. (2) CSRC 공식 페이지(csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/53/r5/upd1/final): 'Date Published: September 2020 (includes updates as of Dec. 10, 2020)', 'Supersedes: SP 800-53 Rev. 5 (09/23/2020)'. 즉 최초 공개일은 2020-09-23이다. (3) 같은 페이지 Planning Note(2025-08-27): Release 5.2.0(minor release)이 2025-08-27에 발행되었고 신규 SA-15(13), SA-24, SI-02(07), 개정 SI-07(12), 해설 갱신 SA-04·SA-05·SA-08·SA-08(14)·SI-02·SI-02(05), 관련 통제 갱신 모든 -01 통제·AU-02·AU-03·CA-07·IR-04·IR-06·IR-08·SA-15·SI-02·SI-07을 포함한다. 변경 목록은 별도 보충자료('SP 800-53 Release 5.2.0 Summary of Changes' PDF)로 제공되고 PDF 본문에는 반영되지 않았다(추출문에 SA-24·SI-02(07)·2025가 없음). (4) 본문 §1.1: 연방 정보시스템에는 OMB A-130과 FISMA에 따라 사용이 의무. 미확인: CSRC 페이지에서 후속 개정(Superseded by) 표기는 찾지 못했으나, 페이지 전체를 정독한 것은 아니다. 정찰 메모에 있던 'Release 5.1.1'은 페이지에서 확인하지 못했다.

defect_list.description: Said Release 5.2.0 updated AU-02's discussion. The CSRC page lists AU-02 only under 'Updates to Related Controls', not under 'Updates to Control Discussion'.
Said Release 5.2.0 updated 'IR-06 관련 내용'. The CSRC page lists IR-06 only as a related-controls update.

Lumped AU-02, AU-03, IR-04, IR-06 and IR-08 together with 'discussion and related-controls updates', implying their text may differ. The CSRC page lists only SA-04, SA-05, SA-08, SA-08(14), SI-02 and SI-02(05) as discussion updates. The AU, IR and CA-07 items are related-controls updates only.
Claimed the gateway holds calls with unclear class or scope and passes them to a human. POL-25 says unclear asset or class means block, so this is only a requirement candidate.
The control is about software programs authorised to execute. Treating MCP tools and servers as that is a MINT interpretation and was not marked as one.
'수치는 카탈로그가 정하지 않는다' goes beyond the passage, but a grep found no fixed time period in any control statement (only an MTTF example at 20401). Left unchanged.

doc_level_changes: Corrected the Release 5.2.0 attribution for AU-02, AU-03 and IR-06 to 'related controls list updated' in pitfalls_ko[0], the AU-2 gateway_control_ko and the IR-6 gateway_control_ko, and added a caveat that the Summary of Changes PDF was not compared.
Added a not-confirmed hedge to the AC-4(9) gateway_control_ko and a MINT-interpretation hedge to the CM-7(5) gateway_control_ko.

Document-level fields left unchanged after the check: title, issuer, edition, key_dates, status in_force, language en, jurisdiction US-federal, binding false and official_page_url. The CSRC page (HTTP 200) shows 'Date Published: September 2020 (includes updates as of Dec. 10, 2020)', 'Supersedes: SP 800-53 Rev. 5 (09/23/2020)' and the 08/27/2025 Release 5.2.0 planning note, which matches key_dates. It shows no Superseded-by or Withdrawn entry.

Licence confirmed: page i of the PDF says the publication 'may be used by nongovernmental organizations on a voluntary basis and is not subject to copyright in the United States' (extract lines 96-97). nist.gov/copyrights-disclaimers (HTTP 200) says NIST site information is public except marked copyrighted material, may be distributed or copied, and asks for credit. distribution public-under-license is kept; the note already flags that non-US terms were not checked.
remaining_concerns: The extract is the 2020 text. Release 5.2.0 (2025-08-27) changes are not in it, and the Summary of Changes PDF and OSCAL catalog were not compared. The note says this.
Several pol_ids links are marginal but not clearly wrong, so I kept them: POL-45 on AC-3(8), POL-25 on AC-4(9), POL-10 on SC-8(1), POL-03 on SA-9.

The product-capability sentences in gateway_control_ko, such as the policy-version field in AU-2 and the tamper alert in AU-9, follow the capability list in NOTE_GUIDE.md and the exemplar style. I could not verify them against the real product.

documents.title: Directive on Automated Decision-Making
documents.title_native: Directive sur la prise de décisions automatisée
documents.issuer: Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat (캐나다 연방 재무위원회 사무국, TBS)
documents.edition: 공식 페이지 'Date modified: 2025-06-24' 현행본(영어). 같은 페이지의 보관 목록에 대체된 이전 판 2021-03-24, 2023-04-24가 올라 있다.
documents.key_dates: 제1.1항: 2019-04-01 시행, 늦어도 2020-04-01까지 준수. 제1.2항: 2020-04-01 이후 개발·조달한 자동 의사결정 시스템에 적용. 제1.2.1항: 2025-06-24 이전에 개발·조달한 기존 시스템은 새로 바뀐 요건을 2026-06-24까지 준수(2026-10-17 기준 이미 경과). 제1.2.2항: 의회 소속 기관(Agents of Parliament)도 2026-06-24까지. 제1.3항: 2년마다, 그리고 연방 CIO가 정할 때 검토. 확인한 것: 영어·프랑스어 페이지의 수정일 메타가 모두 2025-06-24이고 2026-10-17 조회 시점에 그보다 늦은 개정은 보이지 않았다. 확인하지 못한 것: '4차 검토'라는 명칭과 개정 사유 요약(본문에 없음), 2023년 개정의 정확한 날짜(보관 목록 표기는 2023-04-24).

defect_list.description: timing_ko said 'notice at the decision-time service channel', which the text does not state. 6.2.1 only says notice that the decision 'will be made or assisted' through all service delivery channels in use, with no time limit.
'released versions' was rendered as '공개된 모든 버전' (publicly disclosed), which conflicts with the topic_ko ('배포 버전'). It means released/deployed versions. Changed to '릴리스(배포)된'.

timing_ko said the retention period is 'delegated to the Directive on Service and Digital'. The text only says documentation is done 'in accordance with' that directive and sets no retention period. Reworded to 'not stated in this directive; documentation follows the Directive on Service and Digital'.

POL-20 (delegation scope and validity check) has no real link to the 'final decision must be made by a human' requirement or to the gateway_control text (per-case human approval, no self-approval). Removed. POL-27 and POL-22 remain.

'이전 시스템은 2026-06-24까지 유예' blurred the two date rules. Section 1.2 applies the directive to systems developed or procured after 2020-04-01. Section 1.2.1 gives systems developed or procured before 2025-06-24 until 2026-06-24 to meet the new or updated requirements only. Reworded with the section references.
Said 26 provisions were selected, but note.json has 28. Corrected to 28.

'이 지침 본문에서 집행 방식이 확인되지 않는다' ignores 7.4 (TBS raises compliance issues with the deputy head) and 8.3.2 (heads of agents of Parliament monitor compliance themselves). Reworded to say no sanction or enforcement mechanism is stated, and to cite 7.4 and 8.3.2.
28 provisions exceeds the guide's 8-25 range. The checker does not enforce it and every provision is supported by the text, so none were deleted.

remaining_concerns: 28 provisions, above the guide's 8-25 range. The checker passes; the central reviewer can trim 1.1 (2019 effective date) and the A(production) definition if the range is enforced.

instrument_type is 'directive', the document's own name. This is a Treasury Board policy instrument binding on federal institutions, not an EU-style directive; the note's limitations_ko already says so. The scout lead used 'regulator_guidance'. Check whether the wiki index groups by this field.

Document level confirmed against the official pages fetched 2026-10-17. English page title, French title 'Directive sur la prise de décisions automatisée', issuer TBS, and dcterms.modified 2025-06-24 on both language pages all match. The only 'inactive' text on the page is the archive link; the archive list shows 2021-03-24 and 2023-04-24 as replaced editions, so status in_force holds. The scout lead's '25 Apr 2023' and 'fourth review' wording appear nowhere in the page text; the note correctly uses the archive-list date 2023-04-24.

Distribution: local-only is correct. WebFetch of https://www.canada.ca/en/transparency/terms.html confirmed non-commercial reproduction without charge, conditional on an accuracy check, title and author credit, and a copy statement. Commercial redistribution needs prior written permission. The page does not mention the Open Government Licence. No explicit unconditional reuse statement exists, so public-under-license is not supported. curl to the terms page timed out, so the terms were read only via WebFetch, as the note itself says.

gateway_control_ko text for 6.3.2, 6.3.11 and 6.1.3 describes gateway capabilities (alerts, auto-stop, hash checks, re-approval on change) in the present tense. They match the product capability list in the guide but remain design candidates, not verified product features.

All 28 anchors were verified verbatim in the extract and each ref matches where its anchor sits. Appendix C column assignment (Level I, II, III, IV) was re-derived from the extract and the explanation, human-involvement and approval rows are correct.

documents.title: CCPA Updates, Cybersecurity Audits, Risk Assessments, Automated Decisionmaking Technology (ADMT), and Insurance Regulations - Approved Regulations Text (Cal. Code Regs., tit. 11, div. 6, ch. 1)

documents.edition: Approved Regulations Text, OAL 승인 2025-09-22 (OAL Matter No. 2025-0808-04), 127쪽 변경 표시본(redline)
documents.key_dates: 2025-07-24 CPPA 이사회가 규정을 채택(공식 페이지). 2025-09-22 OAL 승인 및 Secretary of State 접수(공식 페이지, OAL 승인 통지 OAL Matter No. 2025-0808-04). 시행일 2026-01-01(공식 페이지와 OAL 승인 통지가 일치). 단계적 준수일(본문 확인): ADMT 준수 2027-01-01(§ 7200(b)); 시행 전부터 계속되는 처리의 위험평가 2027-12-31(§ 7155(b)); 2026~2027년 위험평가 정보 제출 2028-04-01(§ 7157(a)(1)); 첫 사이버보안 감사 보고서 2028-04-01 / 2029-04-01 / 2030-04-01(매출 구간별, § 7121(a)); 이후 매년 4월 1일(§ 7121(b)). 2026-10-17 조회 시 CPPA 규정 목록 페이지는 진행 중인 제안 규정이 없다고 표시했다. 후속 개정·소송 여부는 확인하지 못했다.

defect_list.description: Source 'ARTICLE 9/10/11/12' was rendered as '제9~12장' (chapter), which clashes with 'ch. 1' in the title and in the same note. § 7051 in the source itself says 'Article 9/10/11'.

obligation_ko listed 'processing sensitive personal information' as a risk-assessment trigger without the carve-out in § 7150(b)(2)(A) (employee/contractor data used solely for pay, work authorization, benefits, accommodation or wage reporting). That made the trigger broader than the text.
obligation_ko also covers (d)(2)-(3) (negative impacts, additional safeguards), but the ref cited only (d)(1).
The ref included (d) (trade-secret and security exemptions), which obligation_ko does not mention; the content covers (a)-(c) only.

'요건 충족 연도의 다음 12개월' could be misread. § 7121(b) says: if the § 7120 criteria were met for the preceding year as of 1 January, the audit covers the next 12 months from that 1 January, and the report is due 1 April of the following year.
Grammar slip: 'DLP 시스템이 예로 든다'.
Said masking is 'enabled by default', which states an unconfirmed product behaviour as fact. Rewritten as a requirement candidate.
Said the gateway 'records stop notices to downstream servers'. That capability is not in the product vocabulary. Rewritten as a requirement still to be defined.

'이 웹사이트' did not say that the public-domain wording on https://www.ca.gov/legal/conditions-of-use/ refers to the ca.gov site, not to this regulation PDF. '공유 재산' was a loose rendering of public domain. The local-only decision is correct and unchanged.
The note has 30 provisions against the guide's 8-25. check_notes.py enforces no upper limit and every provision is accurate, so none were removed.

doc_level_changes: Replaced '제9/10/11/12장' and '제9~11장' with 'Article N' in summary_ko, pitfalls_ko, reading_scope_ko and the § 7200 and Art. 11 gateway text.
license_notice: named the ca.gov site as the scope of the public-domain wording and replaced '공유 재산' with '퍼블릭 도메인'.

Re-checked against the official page and the OAL Notice of Approval: title, issuer, adoption 2025-07-24, OAL approval and filing 2025-09-22, OAL Matter No. 2025-0808-04, effective 2026-01-01. The page shows the rulemaking as complete.

The CPPA regulations list page (fetched 2026-10-17) shows no proposed packages and the 'CCPA Regulations (Effective January 1, 2026)' consolidated version. status=in_force, language=en, jurisdiction=US-CA, binding=true and official_page_url were all unchanged.
Distribution kept as local-only: the PDF text and metadata carry no reuse statement; only the generic ca.gov Conditions of Use wording exists.
remaining_concerns: All 30 anchors and refs were checked against the extract and the PDF page text. In the PDF drawing layer none of the cited anchor spans is struck through, and Articles 9-11 (pp. 88-123) contain no strike-through at all.
Not compared with the codified consolidated CCPA Regulations. § 7155(b) still has the placeholder '[OAL to fill in the effective date...]', and the note already says so.

Weak but not clearly wrong POL links, left in place: POL-01 on § 7153, POL-08 on § 7220, POL-33 on § 7221(n), POL-38 on § 7120.
The Civil Code § 1798.140(d)(1)(A)/(C) thresholds are not in this PDF. The applicability of § 7120 needs the statute, as pitfalls_ko already warns.

documents.issuer: Colorado General Assembly (콜로라도 주 의회; 2026-05-14 주지사 승인)
