documents.key_dates: 확인한 사실: (1) 세션로 PDF 말미에 'Approved: May 14, 2026'; 의회 법안 페이지(leg.colorado.gov/bills/sb26-189, WebFetch 요약)도 주지사 서명 05/14/2026, 주지사 송부 05/12/2026, 세션로 Chapter 131로 표시. (2) 섹션 5(1): 이 법은 2027-01-01 시행. 섹션 5(2): 6-1-1704(4), 6-1-1705(3), 6-1-1706(6), 10-3-1104.9(3)(e), 섹션 4(예산), 섹션 5, 섹션 6은 공포(passage) 즉시 시행. (3) 섹션 5(3): 2027-01-01 이후에 내려진 consequential decision에 적용. (4) 6-1-1702(1) 개발자 문서 제공 의무는 '2027-01-01 이후'. (5) 6-1-1704(4)(b)·6-1-1705(3): 법무장관은 2027-01-01 또는 그 이전에 규칙을 채택해야 함. (6) 6-1-1706(3)(e): 2028년 1월부터 매년 법무장관 보고; (3)(f): 같은 항은 2030-01-01 폐지. (7) 법무장관 페이지(coag.gov/ai, 2026-10-17 열람, 페이지 수정일 2026-10-08)는 '2027-01-01 시행'을 확인하고, ADMT·챗봇 규칙안이 2026-08-11 주 국무장관에 제출되었으며 2026-10-06 중간 초안이 공개되었고 서면 의견은 2026-10-26까지 받는다고 밝힌다. 규칙이 최종 채택되었는지는 확인하지 못했다. 확인하지 못한 것: 2026-10-17 이후 후속 개정 여부, 구법(SB 24-205)이 2027-01-01 이전에 시행된 적이 있는지(이 본문에는 언급 없음).

defect_list.description: The note described the exceptions as '개발자 면책 한도 등', which suggests a cap on developer indemnity. The text ((7)(b)) instead says the voiding rule does not apply to a developer when the use was not intended or contracted for and the developer complied with 6-1-1702. The note also wrote '면책·방어·면책', repeating a word for 'indemnify, defend, hold harmless'.
The paraphrase omitted 6-1-1702(3), which limits the developer duties in (1) and (2) to a covered ADMT marketed, configured, contracted or licensed to materially influence a consequential decision.

'연방법이 금지하거나 법이 요구하는 ... 프로그램' could be read as 'programs prohibited by federal law'. The text has two separate limbs: where disclosure is prohibited by federal law, or where it would compromise the confidentiality or integrity of legally required cybersecurity, fraud, AML/CTF or sanctions programs.
POL-07 covers an external provider's handling of documents and results. The control for this provision is a legal review of whether MINT itself counts as a developer, which has no link to POL-07.
Both anchors were written in upper case, but the session-law text of Section 5 is in sentence case. The checker is case-insensitive, so it passed, but the guide asks for verbatim anchors.
The note said the bill page's summary shows 05/14/2026 as the effective date. That date appears in the 'Session laws' table (Effective Date column), not in the bill summary.
The note said the disclosure deadline is only the 30 days after an adverse outcome. 6-1-1704(1) also sets a prior-notice timing, so the sentence now says the post-adverse-outcome disclosure deadline.

doc_level_changes: No document-level field needed changing. I re-checked these against the bill page and the AG page. The Session Laws ch. 131 PDF re-downloaded with the same SHA-256 as the staged original. leg.colorado.gov/bills/sb26-189 shows Became Law, Governor Signed 05/14/2026, Sent to Governor 05/12/2026, Session laws chapter 131, and a summary mentioning SB 24-205. coag.gov/ai (modified 2026-10-08) confirms the 2027-01-01 effective date, the 2026-08-11 filing of the draft rules, the 2026-10-06 interim draft, comments and hearing on 2026-10-26, and HB 26-1263 signed 2026-07-01 effective 2027-01-01. Title, issuer, edition, status adopted_not_yet_applicable, key_dates, language en, jurisdiction, binding and official_page_url are all consistent.

distribution local-only confirmed. leg.colorado.gov/terms-use, /terms-of-use and /copyright return 404, and content.leg.colorado.gov/privacy-policy and /accessibility return 403. The bill page, /laws/session-laws and /colorado-revised-statutes show no reuse statement, and the PDF text has no copyright notice. No explicit official reuse statement can be confirmed, so public-under-license would be unsupported.
pitfalls_ko, limitations_ko and license_notice were otherwise accurate and are unchanged.
remaining_concerns: The staged temp file for the bill page was first written into the LIB-M15 stage folder by mistake and then moved to the scratchpad; the stage folder now contains only the original files plus note.json.
limitations_ko says curl to the bill page returns 406. With a browser User-Agent I got HTTP 200, so the live page can be re-read directly. This does not change the facts.
6-1-1708(3)(a) is labelled mandatory, but the anchor sits in an exemption clause. The (3)(c)/(d) duties in the same paraphrase are 'shall' obligations, so the label was left as is.

Several gateway_control_ko entries describe candidate features such as correlation IDs, export profiles and retention settings in the present tense. This matches the exemplar's style and was left unchanged. Product owners should treat them as requirements, not shipped features.
The AG's final rules were not adopted as of 2026-10-17. Disclosure content and the 'materially influence' indicators may change after the 2026-10-26 hearing.

documents.title: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 8 July 2026 amending Regulations (EU) 2024/1689, (EU) 2018/1139 and (EU) 2023/1230 as regards the simplification of the implementation of harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Digital Omnibus on AI)
documents.issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union (OJ L series, Publications Office of the EU)
documents.edition: OJ L, 2026/1744, 24.7.2026 (영어 CELLAR XHTML 판본). 정오표 OJ L 2026/90810(2026-09-29)이 별도로 있음(독일어판 문구 정정)
documents.key_dates: 본문과 간행물청(CELLAR) 메타데이터로 확인한 사실: 서명 2026-07-08(Strasbourg). 유럽의회 입장 2026-06-16, 이사회 결정 2026-06-29(본문 각주 4). 관보 게재 2026-07-24. 시행: 제4조에 따라 게재 후 3일째 되는 날, 메타데이터상 시행일 2026-07-27, in-force=true, 종료일 없음. 적용일 변경: 제113조 제3항 (a)에서 제5조(1) 첫 단락 (ba)·(bb), 제5조(1a)·(1b)는 2026-12-02부터 적용, (c)에서 제3장 제1~3절(제6조(5) 제외)은 부속서 III 고위험(제6조(2))에 2027-12-02, 부속서 I 고위험(제6조(1))에 2028-08-02부터 적용, (d)에서 제102~110조는 2026-07-27부터 적용. 제111조(4): 2026-08-02 이전 출시된 합성 콘텐츠 생성 AI 시스템은 제50조(2)를 2026-12-02까지 준수. 제111조(2): 공공기관용 고영향 AI는 2030-08-02까지. 기타 기한: 제2조(13) 위임법령 2027-08-02까지, 제57조(1) 국가 샌드박스 2027-08-02까지 운영, 제72조(3) 시판 후 모니터링 지침 2027-09-02까지, 제96조(1)(g) 지침 2027-08-01까지, 제43조(3) 기존 통지기관 지정 신청 2028-01-28까지, 규칙 2023/1230 위임법령 2028-08-02까지 적용. 미확인: 제50조 자체의 기본 적용일(2026-08-02)은 이 문서에서 전문 (38)·(40)과 제111조(4) 문언으로만 확인되고 AI Act 본문은 읽지 않았다.

defect_list.ref: Art. 1 pt 7(a) (AI Act Art. 5(1) 첫 단락 (ba)·(bb))
defect_list.description: obligation_ko omitted the (bb) carve-out 'except where a without right defence applies under national law' and the word 'performance' (공연), so the prohibition read broader than the text.
Release-date threshold was written as '2026-08-02, 제3장 적용일 이전 여부', conflating the Art. 111(4) date (2026-08-02) with the Art. 111(2) Chapter III application dates (2027-12-02 / 2028-08-02).

Provision text was supported, but it left out 'where applicable' on the periodic-penalty cap. It also had no POL mapping and no gateway relevance, and the note had 27 provisions against the guide's 8-25 cap, so it was dropped as the weakest.

Provision text was supported (Commission code of practice on marking and labelling), but it is an authority-only, informative item with a speculative gateway control. It was dropped to bring the note to the 25-provision cap.

doc_level_changes: scope_ko: clarified the release-date criteria (Art. 50(2) grace period is keyed to 2026-08-02; high-risk transitional rule to Chapter III application date)
provisions: removed 2 weakest provisions (Art. 50(7), Art. 75c(5)) to meet the 8-25 cap; 27 -> 25
Document-level fields unchanged and confirmed: title, issuer, edition, status in_force, key_dates, language, jurisdiction, binding, official_page_url, distribution local-only
remaining_concerns: The authentic OJ text on EUR-Lex (HTTP 202 WAF) could not be fetched, so the check relied on the CELLAR XHTML extract and CELLAR XML metadata. The metadata confirmed signature 2026-07-08, publication 2026-07-24, entry into force 2026-07-27 (Art. 4, +3 days), in-force true, no end date, and corrigendum 32026R1744R(01) of 2026-09-29. CELLAR holds no English expression of the corrigendum, so the note's statement that the English corrigendum could not be read is accurate.
The note's article numbers are Digital Omnibus point numbers (Art. 1 pt N), not consolidated AI Act text. The note says so, and the AI Act base text was not read.

The 'public-under-license' decision was re-checked and not claimed. The Commission and data.europa.eu legal notices do state CC BY 4.0 for EU-owned content on those websites, and say only the electronic OJ on EUR-Lex is authentic. Neither names the OJ text of a Parliament and Council regulation, so 'local-only' is the right call.
Several POL links are plausible but thin (POL-32 on labelling, POL-03/POL-39 on the Cyber Resilience Act presumption, POL-09 on deletion). None were clearly wrong, so none were removed.

documents.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile (NIST AI 600-1)
documents.issuer: 미국 국립표준기술연구소(NIST)
documents.edition: NIST AI 600-1, 2024년 7월 발간본. 64쪽(PDF 기준)
documents.key_dates: 표지는 2024년 7월이고 3쪽에 NIST 편집검토위원회 승인일 2024-07-25가 적혀 있다. NIST 발간물 페이지와 AI RMF 페이지는 2024-07-26 발간으로 기재한다. 문서는 EO 14110 제4.1(a)(i)(A)항에 따라 작성됐다고 밝힌다. EO 14110(2023-10-30)은 2025-01-20 서명된 EO 14148(90 FR 8237, 2025-01-28 게재) 제2절의 폐지 대상 목록에 포함됐다(Federal Register 본문 확인). 2026-10-17에 확인한 NIST 발간물·AI RMF 페이지에는 이 프로파일의 철회 공지가 없고, AI RMF 페이지는 AI RMF 1.0이 개정 중이라고 안내한다.

defect_list.description: obligation_ko가 '공격 능력을 낮추는'이라고 써서 원문(lowering the barriers for or easing automated exercise of offensive capabilities, 즉 공격 역량의 진입 장벽을 낮춤)과 반대로 읽혔다.
원문은 '콘텐츠 출처(provenance)와 관련된' 생성 콘텐츠의 성능·신뢰 특성에 대한 실시간 모니터링인데 이 한정을 빠뜨려 일반적 콘텐츠 모니터링처럼 읽혔다. gateway_control_ko도 도구 호출 이상 경보를 이 조치의 구현처럼 서술했다.

EO 14110 폐지를 '스카우트 보고, 미확인'으로만 적고 발간일도 없었다. Federal Register(90 FR 8237)에서 EO 14148(2025-01-20 서명) 제2절이 EO 14110을 폐지 대상으로 열거함을 확인했다. NIST 발간물 페이지에서 발간일 2024-07-26을 확인했고, 2026-10-17 기준 AI RMF 페이지에 철회 공지가 없고 'AI RMF 1.0 개정 중' 안내가 있음을 확인해 반영했다.
폐지 사실을 확인하지 않았다는 문구와 '최종판 기준' 서술이 확인 결과와 맞지 않았다. 확인 결과로 갱신하고 AI RMF 개정 중이라는 주의와 MG-3.2-006 범위 주의를 추가했다.
'최종판'은 문서 본문에 없는 표현이다. 발간본으로 바꾸고 64쪽이 PDF 기준임을 명시했다.
해당 표의 AI Actor Tasks가 'Governance and Oversight'뿐인데 actor를 deployer로 적었다. any로 정정했다.
민감정보 유출·추론 위험 서술에 data_minimisation_retention_deletion은 맞지 않아 data_protection_lawful_basis로 바꿨다.
POL-32(중요 문서용 Tool 응답의 출처 검증)는 간접 프롬프트 주입 서술과 연결이 약해 제거했다.
gateway_control_ko가 지표 집계·내보내기를 이미 제공하는 것처럼 서술해 후보 기능으로 표현을 낮췄다.
local-only 결정은 중앙 근거(비NIST 저자·작업반 기여, 문서 본문에 자유 이용 문구 없음)와 맞다. 3쪽에는 저작권 안내 제목만 있고 본문이 없음을 명시하고 DOI 재취득 경로를 추가했다.
3장 도입부를 인용하면서 읽은 범위에 빠져 있어 추가했다. official_page_url은 문서 전용 NIST 발간물 페이지(HTTP 200, 발간일·DOI 표시)로 바꿨다.

doc_level_changes: edition: 최종판을 발간본으로 바꾸고 64쪽이 PDF 기준임을 명시
key_dates: 승인일 2024-07-25(PDF 3쪽), 발간일 2024-07-26(NIST 페이지), EO 14110 근거 조항, EO 14148 제2절 폐지(90 FR 8237), 2026-10-17 철회 공지 없음과 AI RMF 1.0 개정 중 안내를 반영
official_page_url: 문서 전용 NIST 발간물 페이지로 교체
pitfalls_ko, limitations_ko, reading_scope_ko 갱신
license_notice, distribution_reason: local-only 유지, 근거 문구 정밀화
remaining_concerns: provision의 actor는 표 하단의 AI Actor Tasks에서 추정한 것이어서 deployer 지정은 대략적이다(AI Deployment/Operation and Monitoring 등이 섞인 표).
gateway_control_ko는 NOTE_GUIDE의 MINT 기능 목록을 전제로 쓴 후보 서술이며, 제품이 실제로 구현했는지는 이 검증에서 확인하지 않았다.
약 211개 제안 조치 중 인용한 20개 provision 주변만 읽었고 나머지 표와 부록은 검증하지 않았다.
본문이 EO 14110 제4.1(a)(i)(A)항을 근거로 든다는 점은 각주 2에서 확인했다. EO 14110 자체 원문은 대조하지 않았다.

documents.title: M-26-14: Ensuring Effective and Efficient Agency Logging and Network Visibility to Defend Against Evolving Cyber Threats
documents.issuer: 미국 행정관리예산처(OMB), 국장 Russell T. Vought
documents.edition: OMB 메모 M-26-14, 2026-05-22, 8쪽(본문 4쪽, 부록 A·B·C). 연방 부처·기관장 대상 메모이며 민간에 직접 적용되지 않는다.
documents.key_dates: 2026-05-22 발행, M-21-31 즉시 폐지. CISA는 90일 내 로깅 참조 아키텍처(LRA) 공개, 각 기관은 LRA 공개 후 90일 내 로깅 계획 제출, 120일 내 기본(1단계), 180일 내 중간(2단계), 320일 내 고급(3단계) 성숙도 달성(본문 '모든 기관' 표). CISA의 LRA 안내 페이지(https://www.cisa.gov/Logging)에는 게시일이 2026-08-20으로 표시돼 있다(2026-10-17 확인). 이 날을 기산일로 단순 계산하면 로깅 계획 2026-11-18, 1단계 2026-12-18, 2단계 2027-02-16, 3단계 2027-07-06이나, 기관별 공식 기한은 확인하지 않았다.

defect_list.description: The note said the LRA publication date was not confirmed and no absolute dates were given. The official CISA page https://www.cisa.gov/Logging shows Publish Date August 20, 2026 (fetched 2026-10-17). The plan and maturity deadlines therefore already run from a known date.

defect_list.ref: Appendix C (log management and data retention)
defect_list.description: The obligation said the maturity model 'requires' Level 4 (JIT access, two-gate approval, 6-month search plus 12-month retrieval). The memo's schedule (p.4) requires only Level 3 within 320 days, and Level 4 has no deadline. Marked mandatory without that qualification.

The note told readers to cite Appendix B as the minimum without saying the two retention figures disagree. Appendix B item 1 says 'must' 6 months searchable plus 1 year retrievable, but those numbers equal Level 4 in Appendix C. Level 3, the required end state, is only 3 months searchable plus 12 months retrievable.

The controls were written as things the product already does or provides. They also contained unsupported product-status statements: 'currently only OTLP traces and hashed audit export exist, SIEM forwarding is planned'; 'arguments over 300 characters stored as prefix plus hash'; 'provide 6/12 months as federal default'. None of this comes from the document, and the 300-character rule is not found in the gateway source I grepped.

theme was incident_reporting. The provision defines which logs to collect and automated alerts, not notification of an incident to anyone, so logging_records fits better. The gateway control also omitted the automated-alert limb.
POL-48 covers cleanup of temporary files and caches at disconnection. It does not concern audit-log retention.

The memo encourages time sources 'traceable to' the U.S. Naval Observatory or NIST 'where feasible'. The note said 'authoritative sources such as USNO or NIST', dropping 'traceable' and 'where feasible'.
The note said the memo does not apply to private companies. Page 2 puts systems operated by third parties on an agency's behalf in scope. The memo is addressed only to agency heads.
Said the body mentions AI only briefly. The AI mentions are in body p.1 (threat actors), Appendix A (LRA discussion of AI) and Appendix C Level 4 (ML/AI tuning).

The notice put a paraphrase in quotation marks as if verbatim and omitted the sentence that the US Government may hold copyrights transferred by assignment or bequest. The reason also asserted 'no third-party content' without limiting it to what was read. I re-fetched https://www.whitehouse.gov/copyright/ today and it confirms 'government-produced materials ... are not copyright protected'. The PDF itself carries no copyright or licence text. The public-under-license decision is consistent with the central evidence, so the label is unchanged.

defect_list.ref: Appendix C maturity row (provision 13) gateway control
defect_list.description: The note presented an MCP-server coverage metric as the answer to a requirement that counts IT/OT/IoT assets in the HWAM/SWAM inventory. The mapping is only loose.
Agencies are the duty-bearers in most provisions but are labelled 'authority'. The schema has no better label for a federal agency, since operator would also be arguable. Left as is.
The text says agencies 'will measure and report', not 'must', and names no recipient or frequency. It is a directive memo, so mandatory is defensible.

doc_level_changes: key_dates: added the CISA page publication date 2026-08-20 and simple-arithmetic deadlines (2026-11-18, 2026-12-18, 2027-02-16, 2027-07-06), marked as not official agency deadlines
scope_ko and pitfalls_ko: added that third-party-operated agency systems are in scope; stated the Appendix B versus Appendix C retention discrepancy; corrected the AI-mention location
limitations_ko: added that the LRA document itself was not read (only the CISA page date) and that all gateway controls are implementation candidates

license_notice and distribution_reason: restated the whitehouse.gov Copyright Policy evidence accurately, including the assignment caveat and that the PDF has no notice of its own. distribution stays public-under-license

Document-level facts checked: title, issuer, date 2026-05-22 and M-21-31 rescission, 8 pages, language, binding on agencies, and status in_force. whitehouse.gov/omb/information-resources/guidance/memoranda/ still lists M-26-14 (May 22, 2026). No later memo in that listing rescinds M-26-14, but I checked only the listing text, not the later memos themselves. The official_page_url is a listing page and is acceptable.
remaining_concerns: The LRA PDF was not read. The note does not establish what the LRA adds to the memo's requirements.

The memo does not reconcile the Appendix B retention figure (6 months searchable, 1 year retrievable) with the Appendix C Level 3 figure (3 months searchable, 12 months retrievable). The note flags the conflict but does not resolve it.
Whether the LRA 'publication' that starts the 90/120/180/320-day clocks is the CISA page's Publish Date of 2026-08-20 was not confirmed. The absolute dates are arithmetic only.
The gateway controls are candidates; no feature was verified against the current product. The DEV-13 backlog reference was kept and only reworded as a candidate.
The actor label 'authority' for federal agencies is a schema compromise.

documents.title: M-25-21: Accelerating Federal Use of AI through Innovation, Governance, and Public Trust
documents.issuer: 미국 행정관리예산처(OMB), 국장 Russell T. Vought
documents.edition: OMB 메모 M-25-21, 2025-04-03(PDF 본문 일자; OMB 메모 목록 페이지도 2025-04-03), 25쪽(본문 3쪽, 부록 구현 지침·조치 요약표 22쪽). M-24-10을 폐지하고 대체한다(본문 개요).
documents.key_dates: 2025-04-03 발행. 발행 후 기한: CAIO 지정 60일(부록 3.a.i), CFO Act 기관의 AI 거버넌스 위원회 90일(3.a.ii), CFO Act 기관의 AI 전략 180일(2.a)과 전 기관의 준수 계획 180일 및 이후 2년마다 2036년까지(3.b.ii), 내부 정책 갱신·생성형 AI 정책 270일(3.b.iii~iv), 고영향 AI 최소 관행 이행 문서화 365일(4.a.i). 2026-10-17 확인: OMB 메모 목록 페이지에 M-25-21이 게재되어 있고 M-26-01~M-26-19 제목 가운데 M-25-21을 폐지하는 메모는 없다(제목 기준). 2025-12-11자 M-26-04(AI 관련)는 M-25-21을 기관이 따를 지침으로 인용한다.

defect_list.description: Note said the PDF has 24 pages. The PDF and provenance have 25 pages (3-page memo body, then the appendix on pp.4-25 including the table of actions on p.25).

The 2026-10-17 status check was delegated to the scout stage and not stated. Section references were loose: the 180-day AI strategy is Sec. 2(a) and CFO Act only, the 90-day board is CFO Act only, and the compliance plan is 180 days then every two years to 2036. Rewrote key_dates with the correct sections and my own check: the OMB memoranda page (fetched 2026-10-17) lists M-25-21 dated 2025-04-03 linking to the same PDF, and no M-26-01..M-26-19 title rescinds it. M-26-04 (2025-12-11) cites M-25-21 as a directive to follow. Status in_force stays; the basis is title-level only.

The note presented 'develop processes for traceability and transparency' as unconditional. The text says 'where possible' and also requires mitigations and system/use documentation. Added the qualifier and the omitted duties.

The note dropped the qualifier 'when appropriate' on the duty to ensure timely human review and appeal. It also turned 'should be designed to avoid unnecessary burdens' into a must, and misattributed 'may extend or adapt' as the duty. Rewrote with 적절한 경우, may-extend, and should (바람직).
'Training should be conducted periodically as determined by the agency and should be specific to the AI system' is a should. The note's '특화되어야 한다' read as mandatory. Marked as should.

'All Executive Branch agencies' ignores the 44 U.S.C. 3502(1) definition used in fn.5, which excludes GAO, FEC and others. Also said 'contracts pass the duties to suppliers', which the memo does not say. Sec. 2.d only recommends contract terms, and OMB acquisition guidance (M-25-22) was not read. IC exemption specified as Sec. 4(a)-(b). Fixed in scope_ko and pitfalls_ko.
Listed the generative-AI policy among things the memo 'requires'. It is a 'should' (3.b.iv). Marked as a recommendation.

Said Sec. 7 excludes privacy/security/confidentiality risks 'managed by other policies'. The text only says the definition does not include all AI risks, such as those tied to the privacy, security and confidentiality of training or input data. The 'other policies' clause is not in the text. Rewrote.

The note presented 'discontinue if non-compliant' (4.a.i) without noting CAIO waivers (4.a.ii: annual re-certification; 4.a.iii: report to OMB within 30 days). Added a pitfall; the pilot exemption was already in the provision.
Did not say the 90-day governance board and the 180-day AI strategy apply only to CFO Act agencies. Added.
Ref said '(개요)'. The passage sits under the heading GUIDANCE ON FEDERAL USE OF AI on p.3, not under OVERVIEW. Corrected the ref label. Anchor is verbatim.
POL-19 (user/agent identity verification) does not match an annual AI use case inventory. Removed; POL-11 kept.

Said the OPA rules could be seen as non-AI components, which is a legal conclusion about MINT. Reworded to leave the call to the federal customer and to flag any learned classifier/anomaly components.
Claimed the control 'reduces manipulation risk'. Prompt-injection controls are not the same as the adversarial misclassification the memo describes. Reworded to a related reference control.

The notice put a Korean paraphrase in quotation marks as if quoting, and omitted the actual caveat that the US Government may hold copyrights transferred to it by assignment, bequest or otherwise. Verified the live whitehouse.gov/copyright page on 2026-10-17 and checked that the PDF text has no copyright or licence statement. Rewrote both fields to state exactly this. The distribution decision stays public-under-license, in line with the central evidence for OMB memoranda, and rests on the whitehouse.gov copyright page.

Said '24쪽'. Did not disclose that the PDF is a scan with the publisher's OCR text layer: the extract shows 'OMB' as '0MB', with garbled letterhead. Also relied on the scout for status. Corrected the page count, listed the sections not turned into provisions, added the OCR caveat, and stated the title-level basis for the status check.

doc_level_changes: edition: 24쪽 -> 25쪽, OMB 목록 페이지 일자 병기
key_dates: rewritten with correct sections, CFO Act limits, and the 2026-10-17 status check (M-25-21 listed, no rescission by title, M-26-04 cites it)
scope_ko: statutory agency definition (GAO/FEC excluded), IC exemption limited to Sec. 4(a)-(b), contract-passthrough claim removed
summary_ko: generative-AI policy marked as a recommendation
pitfalls_ko: contract effect softened, CFO Act limits added, waiver pitfall added, Sec. 7 pitfall corrected
reading_scope_ko / limitations_ko: scope honest, OCR caveat, status basis stated
license_notice / distribution_reason: rewritten from the live whitehouse.gov copyright page and the PDF text; distribution unchanged (public-under-license)
remaining_concerns: Status in_force rests on the OMB memoranda page listing (titles only) plus M-26-04 citing M-25-21. The bodies of the M-26 memos were not checked, apart from M-26-04.
M-25-22 (acquisition) was not read, so the effect of contract terms on suppliers is unconfirmed.
The extract is OCR text from a scanned PDF, so the wording of verbatim anchors can contain recognition errors. All 15 anchors were found by the checker.
gateway_control_ko entries are written as capabilities MINT can evidence, in the same style as the exemplar. They are candidate controls, not claims of legal compliance.
The licence rests on the whitehouse.gov copyright policy, which carries a caveat about copyrights transferred to the Government. The PDF text carries no notice of its own.

documents.title: Adversarial Machine Learning: A Taxonomy and Terminology of Attacks and Mitigations (NIST AI 100-2 E2025)
documents.issuer: 미국 NIST(ITL 컴퓨터보안부, 미국 AI안전연구소) 및 영국 AI보안연구소, Northeastern University, Cisco 소속 공저자
documents.key_dates: 표지는 2025년 3월. PDF 3쪽: NIST 편집심사위원회 승인 2025-03-20. 공식 페이지 문서 이력: 2025-03-24 최종본(E2025). 공식 페이지 공지(2026-10-17 확인): 2025-04-01 정정 PDF 업로드(저자 소속 반영, 그림 대체 텍스트 개선), 2025-06-03 색인(p.x)의 오류를 확인해 잠정 정정 목록(potential updates)을 공개했으며 이는 공식 개정이 아니다. 같은 페이지에 철회·대체 표시는 없고 E2026 판 페이지는 없다(404).

defect_list.description: key_dates delegated the 2025-04-01 and 2025-06-03 dates to the scouting lead and said they were not re-checked. The official CSRC page was fetched on 2026-10-17. It shows a 03/24/25 final, a 4/1/25 corrected PDF (author affiliations, figure alt text) and a 6/3/25 errata notice on page x. The PDF itself says the Editorial Review Board approved it on 2025-03-20.

The note did not say whether a later edition exists. The official page has no withdrawn or superseded marker, and the e2026 final, ipd and draft URLs return 404. The errata PDF only concerns the page x index.

The local-only decision was correct but incomplete. It omitted the U.K. AI Security Institute co-author. It also did not say that the PDF carries no free-use text (page 3 only has the 'available free of charge' line and a link to the NIST copyright statements). The evidence is now stated exactly.
'defense under any law' was rendered as '방어 수단', which reads as a technical defence. In context it is a legal defence, so the text now says '법적 항변 사유'.

The text lists verifying web downloads as a mitigation: 'this includes verifying'. The note said it 'must be verified' (검증해야 한다). The actor was 'deployer', but the text means the downloader of training data, i.e. the model developer. gateway_control_ko presented an analogy to MCP server artifacts as an existing function.
The source says risks 'can be reduced by' understanding models as untrusted components. The note turned this into an instruction ('설계하라고 한다'). It also stated the scanning limitation too absolutely.
The source says identity verification and incentive policies 'may enhance the efficacy'. The note said they raise it (효과를 높인다).

The source calls this one of the 'potential mitigations' that rely on designing systems under the assumption that the model can produce malicious output. The note said the document 'tells you to design' that way (설계하라고 한다).

The note said mitigation 'must combine' (결합해야 한다). The source says it 'requires a multifaceted approach'. pol_ids POL-03 (security update support) and POL-39 (fixing known vulnerabilities) have no basis in the passage or in gateway_control_ko, so they were removed.
gateway_control_ko said that not following extra instructions in server descriptions is something the product does. That is agent-side behaviour (POL-04), not something the gateway guarantees.
POL-33 (data transfer between MCP servers) does not fit exfiltration to an attacker URL or mailbox.
The source addresses organisations in general, not specifically the deployer. Actor changed to 'any'.

The note said chapter 4 covers scale, supply chain and risk management, and that every attack type has a NISTAML identifier. Chapter 4 also covers trade-offs, theoretical limits, evaluation, multimodal and quantized models. The index covers the main attack types, not every type.
The official errata (2025-06-03) says the p.x index entries for availability violations in the GenAI taxonomy are wrong and should be NISTAML.016 and NISTAML.017. This is now listed as a pitfall.

remaining_concerns: All 15 provisions were checked against the extract. Every anchor sits under the cited section, and none had a wrong ref, wrong article number, wrong date or wrong threshold. The defects were mostly modality and wording.
reading_scope_ko is honest: chapter 2, the glossary and the references were not read, and the note covers only parts of chapter 3 and 4.2.2 and 4.2.5.
instrument_type 'framework' is a loose fit for a taxonomy and terminology report. It is not wrong, so it was left as is.
The distribution decision (local-only) rests on the centrally verified NIST evidence and the lack of a free-use notice in the PDF. This session did not re-fetch the NIST copyright page.
The scout item says 'standard'. The note correctly kept it as non-binding and voluntary.

documents.title: Cybersecurity Framework Profile for Artificial Intelligence (Cyber AI Profile) — NIST IR 8596 iprd (Initial Preliminary Draft)
documents.issuer: 미국 국립표준기술연구소(NIST) 응용사이버보안부(ITL)와 국가사이버보안우수센터(NCCoE)·MITRE
documents.edition: NIST IR 8596 iprd, 2025년 12월 '초기 예비 초안'(Initial Preliminary Draft), CSF 2.0 기반 공동체 프로파일. 107쪽
documents.key_dates: 문서 표지는 2025년 12월판이며 의견 접수 기간은 2025-12-16~2026-01-30으로 표기돼 있다. 공식 페이지(2026-10-17 열람)는 게시일 2025-12-16, 의견 마감 2026-01-30('마감됨' 표시)과 2026-04-21자 안내(2026-04-28·05-05·05-12 가상 실무 세션)를 싣고 있으며, 초기 공개 초안·최종본 주소(/ipd, /final)는 404였다. 따라서 이 문서보다 새로운 판은 확인되지 않았다.

defect_list.description: ref was 'RS.MA 대응·격리' but the anchor 'autonomy/privileges of a' sits in RS.MI-01 'Incidents are contained' (Incident Mitigation RS.MI, extract line ~8763-8798), not RS.MA. Also the 'faster-than-human' rationale was generalised to all incidents; the text says 'AI-initiated incidents', and it sits in the Secure column (priority 2) while the AI-specific containment step is in the Defend column (priority 3).

obligation merged the Defend-column 'manage AI agent privileges over time (e.g., periodic reviews and updates)' into a sentence ending 'Secure priority 1'. Only the least-privilege/separate-policy sentence is General Considerations (Secure priority 1); the periodic review is Defend (priority 2). Gateway control also claimed unused-permission revocation as an existing feature.

obligation presented new logging metrics (Secure column) and 'logs should show request data, response data, and whether responses matched policy' (Defend column 'Sample Opportunities') and tamper protection as one statement. Priority 1 for all three focus areas is correct. Gateway control asserted a 'hash-linked' ledger, which is not in the stated gateway capability set.
gateway_control_ko stated the ledger is a hash chain with periodic integrity verification as an existing feature; only 'append-only audit ledger' is established.

gateway_control_ko claimed server-side mutual authentication is verified in connection setup; this capability is not established (only transport-token authentication and connection-target verification are).

claimed per-call verification of issuer/audience/validity/signature and delegation-scope rejection as existing; narrowed to transport-token signature/validity evidence and flagged the rest as policy requirements (POL-20/21).

passage only states that embedded AI makes inventories hard to maintain (descriptive, Secure priority 2), not a recommendation; strength changed from recommended to informative. Gateway control narrowed to gateway-routed connections (cannot see AI embedded in purchased systems).

anchor passage is a descriptive statement (AI can leak sensitive data; model sensitivity equals sensitivity of trained/accessed data), not a recommendation; strength changed from recommended to informative. Priorities 1/1/3 were not cited so no number error.

obligation_ko contained '게이트웨이는 주로 Secure 영역의 통제 지점이다', the note author's inference, not document text; removed from obligation and kept in gateway_control_ko explicitly labelled as the note's interpretation.
'확정된 요구사항으로 인용하면 안 된다' read as a statement of the document; reworded as the note's own caution.
'우선순위 1은 ... 가장 먼저 다뤄야 하고 / 3은 긴급성이 낮을 뿐' overstated 'should typically be addressed most immediately' and 'may not require the same level of urgency'; softened.
recording external-data provenance with response metadata was stated as existing; marked as a requirement candidate.

said the Profile does not replace 'CSF 2.0 and SP 800-53 controls'; the text (Exec Summary) only says it is not meant to replace existing frameworks. SP 800-53 non-replacement is not stated. Reworded.

key_dates relied on the scout report for the April 2026 session note and limitations said later drafts were not re-checked. Official CSRC page fetched 2026-10-17: Date Published December 16, 2025; Comments Due January 30, 2026 (CLOSED); Planning Note 04/21/2026 re spring 2026 working sessions (Apr 28, May 5, May 12); /ipd and /final return 404; NCCoE project page returned 403 so absence of a newer draft is not proven. Both fields rewritten with these verified facts.

said only 'some' agent recommendations are in the Defend column; PR.AA-03, PR.AA-04, PR.AA-05 periodic review, PR.PS-04 tamper protection and RS.MI-01 containment step are Defend-column text. Reworded to list them.

distribution local-only is correct (7 of 9 authors listed as MITRE on the CSRC page; the PDF has no free-use statement, only link text 'Copyright, Use, and Licensing Statements', and a patent-claims call). Added exactly that evidence; no change to the decision.

doc_level_changes: key_dates rewritten from verified official page (2025-12-16 published, 2026-01-30 comments closed, 2026-04-21 planning note, /ipd and /final 404)
scope_ko: removed unsupported SP 800-53 non-replacement claim
limitations_ko: states what was re-checked on 2026-10-17 and that NCCoE page was unreachable (403)
license_notice and distribution_reason: added author-affiliation evidence and the absence of a free-use statement in the PDF; distribution stays local-only
pitfalls_ko: Defend-column attribution list corrected
status draft, jurisdiction US-federal, binding false, language en, official_page_url, edition (107 pages, December 2025) all confirmed
remaining_concerns: Secure/Defend/Thwart attribution of priorities depends on column order in a PyMuPDF text dump of a multi-column table; checked by sequence pattern (priority number precedes its column text) but the PDF tables should be eyeballed before quoting a specific priority.
NCCoE Cyber AI Profile project page returned HTTP 403, so a newer initial public draft cannot be ruled out beyond CSRC /ipd and /final returning 404.
reading_scope_ko (what the lead read in full) cannot be independently verified; only the 18 cited passages were re-read.

Several gateway_control_ko lines still describe capabilities in present tense (e.g. per-call permission re-evaluation, masking, alerts) taken from the stated gateway capability list; they are not evidence the product implements them for this standard.

documents.title: Deploying AI Systems Securely: Best Practices for Deploying Secure and Resilient AI Systems (Joint Cybersecurity Information)
documents.issuer: 미국 NSA AI 보안센터(AISC)·CISA·FBI와 호주 ASD ACSC·캐나다 사이버보안센터·뉴질랜드 NCSC-NZ·영국 NCSC
documents.edition: Cybersecurity Information Sheet, 2024년 4월 Ver. 1.0(문서 번호 U/OO/143395-24, PP-24-1538), 11쪽. 이 사본은 NCSC-NZ 사이트(ncsc.govt.nz)에 게시된 PDF이며 NSA가 게시한 원본 PDF(media.defense.gov)와 바이트 단위 동일성은 확인하지 못했다.
documents.key_dates: 2024-04 Ver. 1.0(문서 표지). 발행일 2024-04-15(CISA 알림 페이지의 Release Date 'April 15, 2024', 2026-10-17 확인). 같은 날 확인한 이 알림 페이지에는 개정·대체 안내가 없고 다른 판은 찾지 못했다. media.defense.gov는 curl 요청에 HTTP 403(Access Denied)을 돌려줘 NSA 원본 PDF는 직접 받지 못했다.

defect_list.description: The summary said '7개국 기관'. The document names 7 agencies from 5 countries (US, AU, CA, NZ, UK).

The publication date and the 'still listed on 2026-10-17' claim rested on scout reports. I re-checked the CISA alert page on 2026-10-17: it gives a Release Date of April 15, 2024 and carries no supersession notice. The 403 on media.defense.gov was also confirmed. The text now states these checked facts.

The note said CISA renamed the document 'SI Systems' under EO 14434. No fetched page mentions EO 14434. The CISA topic page (cisa.gov/ai redirects to /topics/cybersecurity-best-practices/super-intelligence) does list it as 'Deploying SI Systems Securely'. The alert page and the PDF cover still say 'AI'. I removed the EO claim and recorded only what was observed.

The text quoted three sentences of the document, against the paraphrase rule, and called the NCSC-NZ file a 'mirror'. It also missed the licence statements that exist. CISA Notification says TLP:CLEAR content may be shared without restriction 'subject to copyright controls'. The NCSC-NZ legal page says its Crown-copyright material is CC BY 4.0 unless stated otherwise within the material. The PDF has foreign co-authors and says 'standard copyright rules'. No explicit licence for the whole PDF was found, so local-only stays correct. I rewrote both fields to cite exactly this evidence.
The note said the contract should 'reflect' deployment-environment security requirements. The text only says to 'Consider' them when developing contracts.
The note said input validation makes sure malicious input is 'not passed' to the AI system. The text only says it reduces the risk of such input being passed.
It claimed MINT intake has threat-model and contract-link fields. Those are not in the capability vocabulary. I recast it as an organisational procedure with an evidence attachment as a candidate.

It claimed MINT preserves normal/attack test results as evidence of release testing. The provision concerns external audits of the deployer's AI system. I recast it as an organisational procedure with an evidence attachment as a candidate.

It claimed a 'hash chain' tamper-detection feature and a 'no record-editing code' design. Neither is in the capability vocabulary. I reduced it to the append-only ledger and noted that external immutable backup is customer infrastructure.
It claimed responses are logged as 'hash/size/result' (unsupported detail). It also did not say that model-internal intermediate-state logs are outside the gateway.
The claim that admin routes require admin authentication is unsupported. Admin MFA and PAW (privileged access workstations) belong to the organisation's IdP and endpoints.
The gateway was credited with OAuth token validation, which POL-21 assigns to HTTP OAuth servers. I rephrased it as a separate POL-21 requirement.
The undefined term '계약 잠금' was removed. I added that signature and checksum verification of model artifacts sits in the deployer's model repository, not the gateway.

The text said MINT 'corresponds to' and 'implements' these items. I changed it to 'can correspond to' and 'can be used to implement', and noted that the document is about ML models and does not cover MCP.
The provision concerns breach assumption, detection and containment, not incident reporting. The theme changed from incident_reporting to security_risk_management.

defect_list.ref: Provision 10 (모델 가중치 보호, 쪽 7) theme + obligation_ko
defect_list.description: The provision is about protecting model weights, not personal-data minimisation. The theme changed to security_risk_management. I added the text's hedge 'as feasible' for hardware protection.
The heading is 'robust logging and monitoring'. The theme changed from security_risk_management to logging_records.
The note wrote 'must redeploy' for what is a best-practice bullet. POL-40 (destination-change re-approval) has no link to a model version evaluation and was removed.
It claimed the PDF was read. Only the text-layer extract was checked, not figures or layout. The wording was made precise.

doc_level_changes: summary_ko: 7개국 -> 5개국 7개 기관
key_dates: re-verified against CISA alert page on 2026-10-17 (Release Date April 15, 2024, no supersession notice, media.defense.gov 403)
pitfalls_ko: removed unsupported EO 14434 claim; recorded the observed 'SI' vs 'AI' title difference between CISA pages
license_notice and distribution_reason rewritten as paraphrase citing CISA Notification, CISA alert page and NCSC-NZ legal page; distribution stays local-only
reading_scope_ko: stated that the text-layer extract was read, not figures or layout
remaining_concerns: The NSA original PDF (media.defense.gov) returns 403, so identity between the NCSC-NZ copy and the NSA file is unverified.

NCSC-NZ states a site-wide CC BY 4.0 licence for Crown-copyright material. Whether it covers this jointly authored PDF is unclear, so the note keeps local-only. If the NZ licence were accepted for the whole PDF, the decision could change.
The document defines 'AI systems' as ML-based and does not cover MCP or LLM agents. Every POL link is an analogy to gateway functions, not a direct textual match.
POL-01/POL-07 on provision 2 and POL-05/POL-46 on provisions 6, 12 and 16 are weak links that I left in place (not clearly wrong).
All 16 anchors exist and every ref and page number matches the anchor's page. Checker returns ok:true.

documents.title: EDPB Opinion 28/2024 on certain data protection aspects related to the processing of personal data in the context of AI models
documents.issuer: 유럽데이터보호이사회(EDPB). 아일랜드 감독기관의 GDPR 제64조 제2항 요청에 따른 의견
documents.edition: 2024-12-17 채택(Adopted), 35쪽
documents.key_dates: 표지에 2024년 12월 17일 채택으로 표기돼 있다. 아일랜드 감독기관의 요청일은 2024년 9월 4일, 자료 완비 판단일은 9월 13일이며 의장이 처리 기한을 연장했다(¶1~¶2). EDPB 문서 페이지의 게시일은 2024년 12월 18일이다. 의견은 모든 감독기관을 수신자로 하며 GDPR 제64조 제5항 (b)에 따라 공개된다(¶136).

defect_list.description: The note said the EDPB reuse terms could not be read and set local-only. The official page https://www.edpb.europa.eu/copyright_en (fetched 2026-10-17, linked from the document page footer) authorises reuse of the site's information for commercial and non-commercial purposes. The conditions are source attribution, no distortion of meaning and no liability for EDPB. The Opinion is EDPB's own document and the PDF carries no special condition.

'EU AI법 의무는 다루지 않는다' is not stated in the text. The text lists the excluded GDPR topics in para 17 and says GDPR measures are without prejudice to AI Act authorities in para 117. Also missing: SAs must take utmost account of the Opinion and it does not affect controllers' obligations (para 15), which matters because status 'voluntary' understates its weight.

The paraphrase said any controller deploying another controller's model is reviewed for unlawful development. The text places this in Scenario 2, where personal data is retained in the model and processed by another controller. It omitted that condition and the 'personal data breach' criterion.
POL-01 covers distribution provenance and integrity, not the provenance of training data.
POL-03 (security update support) and POL-39 (known vulnerability remediation) have no relation to SA corrective measures such as fines, erasure or retraining.

defect_list.kind: overstated modality / wrong actor / overstated control
defect_list.description: Both are non-prescriptive example measures ('may include', 'may for instance'; para 98 says the list is non-exhaustive and non-prescriptive), but were marked 'recommended'. The actors were 'provider' and 'deployer', which are not the Opinion's actor ('controller'). The gateway control text implied the gateway implements training-set masking and model output filters, but it only controls the tool-call path. The para 107(a) paraphrase also omitted that watermarking is aimed at unlawful reuse by general-purpose AI models.

The second sentence ('does not itself decide individual cases') is not in para 136. 'Addressed to all SAs' was rendered as 'delivered to'. Replaced with text supported by para 15 and the original wording.
The obligation text addresses SAs ('SAs should take into consideration the scope, frequency... of tests') but the actor was 'controller'.
'모델이 개인정보를 유지하는 정도에 따라 다르다' is not in the text. Rewritten to the executive summary and para 57-58 wording.

The original URL only worked via redirect. The canonical page is /documents/opinion-of-the-board-art-64/opinion-282024-on-certain-data-protection-aspects-related-to_en. Added the request date (4 Sep 2024), file-complete date (13 Sep 2024) and the page publication date (18 Dec 2024), all verified in the text and on the page.
Added what the verifier read and did not read. Added that the page showed no withdrawal or supersession notice on 2026-10-17 and that later EDPB guidance (e.g. on anonymisation) was not checked.
The anchor is in both the executive summary and para 43. Added para 43 to the ref.

doc_level_changes: official_page_url changed to the canonical EDPB page URL (200 on 2026-10-17); the old URL redirected
key_dates extended: request 2024-09-04, file complete 2024-09-13, page publication 2024-12-18; wording changed to 'addressed to all SAs'
scope_ko corrected (para 15 utmost account and no effect on controller obligations; para 17 excluded topics; para 117 AI Act authorities); the unsupported AI Act claim removed
pitfalls_ko item 3 reworded; new pitfall that paras 129-131 apply only to Scenario 2
reading_scope_ko and limitations_ko updated

license_notice rewritten from the EDPB copyright page; distribution changed from local-only to public-under-license with a reason limited to the unaltered PDF and its extract, plus conditions (source attribution, no distortion)
remaining_concerns: Status 'voluntary' / binding=false is defensible for an Art. 64(2) opinion, but SAs must take utmost account of it (para 15). Readers should not treat it as optional for supervisory practice.

Several gateway_control_ko entries are requirement-style (e.g. 'record the target audience in the intake form', 'raise the risk grade'). They describe candidate controls, not features confirmed to exist, and need a product check before being cited as implemented.
The POL-01 and POL-02 links on para 131 and the POL-05 link on para 55 are weak but not clearly wrong, so they were kept.

The licence rests on the EDPB site copyright page. If the PDF is redistributed with the extract, source attribution and unaltered meaning must be kept. Third-party works quoted inside the Opinion (CJEU judgments, etc.) were not separately cleared.
Paras 21-40 (section 3.1 and part of 3.2.1), 59-65 and 73-95 were not read by the verifier. No provision anchors there, but the summary relies on the executive summary for the headline points.

documents.title: Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 14 December 2022 on digital operational resilience for the financial sector and amending Regulations (EC) No 1060/2009, (EU) No 648/2012, (EU) No 600/2014, (EU) No 909/2014 and (EU) 2016/1011 (Digital Operational Resilience Act, DORA)
documents.issuer: 유럽의회와 이사회. 유럽연합 관보 OJ L 333, 2022-12-27
documents.edition: OJ L 333, 27.12.2022, 영어 PDF 79쪽(Publications Office Cellar 게재본)
documents.key_dates: 2022-12-14 서명, 2022-12-27 관보 게재(OJ L 333). 제64조: 관보 게재 후 20일째에 발효하고 2025년 1월 17일부터 적용한다. Publications Office 메타데이터(2026-10-17 조회)는 발효일 2023-01-16, 적용일 2025-01-17, 유효(in force) 표시, 효력 종료일 9999-12-31(종료 미정)로 기록하고 이 규정을 개정하는 법령은 기록하지 않는다. 따라서 2026-10-17 기준 적용 중이다. 규정이 위임한 규제기술표준(사고 분류 기준·보고 기한·보고 서식 등)의 구체 값은 이 문서가 아닌 위임 규정에 있다.

defect_list.ref: 제8조 제3항, 제7항; 제11조 제6항 (a); pitfalls
defect_list.description: 'microenterprise'를 '소기업'(small enterprise)으로 번역해 면제 범위를 잘못 서술했다. 제3조 제60호는 직원 10명 미만이고 연 매출 또는 연 자산 총액이 200만 유로 이하인 금융기관(거래소, 중앙청산소, 거래정보저장소, 중앙예탁기관 제외)으로 정의한다.
'최소 연 1회' 검토라고만 적었으나 본문(제6조 제5항)은 초소기업에 대해 '정기적으로'로 완화한다. 시행 근거 자료로 쓰는 경우를 위해 예외를 추가했다. 또 이 조항과 맞지 않는 POL-37 연결을 제거했다.
topic_ko가 사이버 공격 시 영향 자산의 자동 격리를 의무처럼 적었다. 본문은 자동 격리 메커니즘을 'may include'(예시)로 두고, 의무는 네트워크 연결 인프라를 즉시 단절·분할할 수 있게 설계하는 것(shall)이다.
중대한 사이버 위협 시 고객에게 보호 조치를 알릴 의무에서 'where applicable'(해당하는 경우) 한정을 빠뜨려 의무를 무조건처럼 적었다.
'등록부를 연 1회 감독 당국에 보고'처럼 읽히게 적었다. 본문은 최소 연 1회 신규 계약 수·제공자 범주·계약 유형·서비스와 기능을 보고하고, 등록부 전체는 요청 시 제출하도록 한다. 또 등록부 수준에 'sub-consolidated'가 빠져 있었고 감독 당국 제출용 내보내기를 이미 있는 기능처럼 적었다.
gateway_control_ko가 게이트웨이가 외부 서버의 처리·저장 위치 변경을 감지하고 데이터 반환·삭제를 확인한다고 주장했다. 근거가 없는 기능 주장이며 연결 주소 변경 재승인(POL-40)과 계약·도입 검토 절차로 한정해 다시 썼다.
'게이트웨이 장애 시 차단(fail-closed) 동작'을 제품 문서에 명시한다고 적어 근거 없는 현재 동작을 전제했다. 후보 방안으로 낮췄다. 관련성이 낮은 POL-42도 제거했다.
구성·연결·의존성 매핑을 '핵심 자산'에 한정해 적었으나 본문 제4항은 핵심 자산 매핑과 별개로 자산의 구성과 상호 연결·의존성 전반을 매핑하도록 한다.
MINT가 금융기관의 ICT 제3자로서 제29·30·31조의 영향을 받는다고 단정했다. 이는 ICT 서비스 정의(제3조 제21호) 해당 여부와 지정 여부에 달린 법적 판단이며 본문으로 뒷받침되지 않는다. 해당할 수 있다는 조건부 서술로 고쳤다.
'제28조 제9~10항이 재위탁 표준을 위임'했다고 적었다. 제28조 제9항은 등록부 표준 서식, 제10항은 핵심 기능 ICT 서비스 이용 정책의 세부 내용이고, 재위탁 관련 기술표준은 제30조 제5항이다.

중앙 검증 증거에 없는 세부 내용('© European Union, 1998-2026', 국제회계기준 예시, '브라우저로 직접 열람')을 EUR-Lex 법적 고지 인용에 넣었다. 검증 단계에서 해당 페이지는 curl로 열리지 않아(HTTP 202) 직접 재확인하지 못했다. 중앙 검증 문구만 남기고 인용 출처를 명시했으며 배포 판단(public-under-license, 보존 PDF에 별도 조건 없음)은 유지했다.
'사본 열람 권리'로 적었으나 본문은 현장에서 사본을 취할(take copies) 권리다.
원장이 사건을 '심각도와 함께' 기록한다고 적었으나 근거가 없다. 입력 자료로 활용 가능한 수준으로 낮췄다.
보고서 첨부용 내보내기 기능을 이미 있는 것처럼 적었다. 근거 자료 활용과 후보로 낮췄다.
obligation_ko가 패치·업데이트 정책(제4항 (f))까지 다루는데 ref에는 (e)만 있었다.
탐지 메커니즘 조항을 incident_reporting으로 분류했다. 보고가 아닌 탐지·모니터링이므로 security_risk_management로 바꿨다.
의무 주체(금융기관)에 GDPR 용어인 'controller'를 썼다. 규정이 쓰지 않는 용어라 'operator'로 바꿨다.
공식 제목에서 'and amending Regulations ...' 부분이 빠져 있었다. Publications Office 메타데이터의 전체 제목으로 고쳤다.
발효일(2023-01-16)과 서명일이 없었다. Publications Office SPARQL 메타데이터와 제64조(20일째, 관보 2022-12-27)로 확인해 추가했고 유효 상태(in force, 종료일 9999-12-31, 이 규정을 개정하는 법령 기록 없음)를 병기했다.
제2조를 읽지 않았다고 했으나 제2조는 ICT 제3자 서비스 제공자를 포함해 적용 대상을 열거하고 제3항에서 제외 대상을 둔다. 검증 단계에서 제1~4조를 확인해 범위 서술을 보강했다. reading_scope의 '제8~13조(제7조 제외)' 표현은 앞뒤가 맞지 않아 정리했다.
EUR-Lex ELI 페이지는 curl로 HTTP 202(본문 없음)가 와서 직접 확인하지 못했다. Publications Office Cellar 알림과 SPARQL로 ELI reg/2022/2554/oj 매핑, 제목, 서명일, 유효 상태를 확인했다. limitations_ko에 명시했다.

remaining_concerns: EUR-Lex 공식 페이지와 법적 고지 페이지는 이 환경에서 열리지 않았다(HTTP 202). 공식 페이지는 Publications Office 메타데이터로 대신 확인했고, 라이선스 문구는 중앙 검증 증거만 인용했다.
높음 또는 중간 결함이 있던 조항이 약 7~8개(21개 중)로 기준선 부근이었다. 대부분 수식어 누락, 번역 용어, 기능 과장이었고 모두 본문과 대조해 고쳤다. 발명된 의무는 발견하지 못했다.
gateway_control_ko의 일부 문장은 여전히 MINT 기능 어휘 수준의 설명이며 각 기능의 실제 구현 여부는 이 검증에서 확인하지 않았다.
제7조, 제13~16조, 제20~27조(TLPT 포함), 제31조 이후는 읽지 않았고 위임 규정(RTS/ITS)의 구체 기한·서식은 이 노트 범위 밖이다. 'major'와 'significant'를 모두 '중대한'으로 옮긴 점은 독자가 구분해 읽어야 한다.

documents.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 23 October 2024 on horizontal cybersecurity requirements for products with digital elements and amending Regulations (EU) No 168/2013 and (EU) No 2019/1020 and Directive (EU) 2020/1828 (Cyber Resilience Act)
documents.issuer: 유럽의회와 이사회. 유럽연합 관보 OJ L, 2024-11-20
documents.edition: OJ L, 20.11.2024, 영어 PDF 81쪽(PDF/A-2A, Publications Office Cellar 게재본)
documents.key_dates: 2024-10-23 스트라스부르에서 채택·서명, 2024-11-20 관보 게재(문서 표기). 제71조 제1항: 관보 게재 후 20일째에 발효하며 그 날짜(2024-12-10)는 문서 본문이 아니라 집행위원회 CRA 요약 페이지가 밝힌다. 제71조 제2항: 2027-12-11부터 적용한다. 다만 제14조(보고 의무)는 2026-09-11부터, 제4장(제35~51조, 적합성 평가 기관 통지)은 2026-06-11부터 적용한다. 따라서 2026-10-17 기준 제조자의 취약점·사고 보고 의무는 이미 적용 중이며 나머지 필수 요건은 2027-12-11부터 적용된다.

defect_list.description: The note said the CRA acts as an indirect requirement (supplier due diligence, SBOM, support period) on customers who adopt external MCP servers. The regulation puts no direct duty on such customers. Annex II item 9 makes SBOM access a manufacturer's choice, and item 7 only requires the support-period end date.

The note said the definitions of 'actively exploited vulnerability' and 'severe incident' sit in lower-level documents and were not read. They are in the Regulation itself (Art. 3(42) and Art. 14(5)). Only the Art. 16 platform design, the delegated and implementing acts under Art. 14(9) and 14(10), and the rest of Art. 3 are unread.
The summary listed 'products placed on the market without vulnerabilities'. Annex I Part I(2)(a) says 'without known exploitable vulnerabilities'.

The paraphrases dropped the condition from the Annex I Part I(2) lead-in ('on the basis of the cybersecurity risk assessment ... and where applicable'). The (e) confidentiality item was also overstated as 'protect with state-of-the-art encryption'. The text gives encryption as an example ('such as by encrypting ... and by using other technical means').
No pitfall flagged that the Annex I Part I(2) requirements are risk-based and apply 'where applicable' (Art. 13(3)), while Part II has no such qualifier. Added one.

The note said 'the scouting stage deems 2024-12-10 the date of entry into force'. That is an internal-process leak, and the date is not stated in the PDF (Art. 71(1) only says the twentieth day after publication). Rewrote the field with the signing date, the OJ date and Art. 71(1), and cited the Commission CRA summary page for the 2024-12-10 date, which I fetched and which states it.
The text referred to 'the ENISA platform news mentioned by the scouting stage'. Reworded to state plainly that the platform's actual launch was not confirmed.

The notice added details beyond the centrally verified evidence: the '© European Union, 1998-2026' year range and 'IFRS and other documents carry special conditions'. I could not re-fetch the legal notice (EUR-Lex returns an empty bot-challenge response). Rewrote it to the centrally verified statements only. I also confirmed that the PDF text layer contains no copyright or reuse wording.

The reason did not say that the PDF was acquired from the Publications Office Cellar as the OJ L 2024/2847 edition. It also presented the plan to keep the SHA-256 and a source URL as if it were a licence condition. Reworded. The decision stays public-under-license, which matches the reuse evidence for OJ legal acts.
The title omitted the 'and amending Regulations (EU) No 168/2013 and (EU) No 2019/1020 and Directive (EU) 2020/1828' part. Restored it as printed on page 1 of the PDF.

The note said MINT 'requests the manufacturer's risk assessment document'. The CRA does not give users that document. It goes into the technical documentation for authorities (Art. 13(4), 13(22)). Users get the Annex II information, which includes the support-period end date. Reworded as a candidate and as a duty with no gateway equivalent.

The text said to 'stop the function until fixed or isolated and notify the supplier'. POL-39 only says to isolate or stop use when remediation is impossible within the deadline, and says nothing about notifying the supplier. Reworded to follow POL-39 and marked as a candidate.
The text said the ledger 'supports the manufacturer's notification schedule'. Reworded as a candidate evidence source that does not replace the manufacturer's notification or deadline management.

The text implied the ledger provides 'calls suspected of malicious code execution'. Detecting malicious code execution is not an established MINT capability. Reworded as a candidate: call history and anomaly alerts, with no 'severe incident' determination.
The text said 'admin routes are restricted to administrator authentication'. That is a product claim with no basis in the guide's capability vocabulary or in the CRA text. Removed that clause.
POL-05 (testing tool description against actual behaviour at intake) does not match the manufacturer's regular security testing and CVD policy. Removed it.

The theme was transparency_labelling, but the article is titled 'Reporting obligations of manufacturers' and concerns notifying affected users of incidents, so I changed it to incident_reporting. timing_ko said 'timely' but para. 8 sets no deadline (only the CSIRT fallback if the manufacturer fails to inform 'in a timely manner'), so I emptied it.

The ref was 'Art. 3 point 1', but the obligation text also paraphrases point (2), 'remote data processing'. The paraphrase omitted 'or under the responsibility of the manufacturer'. Changed the ref to 'points 1, 2' and completed the paraphrase.

The EUR-Lex ELI page could only be read through a summariser, which reported 'In force: This act has been changed' with only a 20/11/2024 consolidated version. EUR-Lex blocks curl. I could not confirm whether any corrigendum or amending act (e.g. a digital omnibus) exists, and the Commission page mentions none. The note's limitations already say this was not checked; I added that EUR-Lex's amendment history could not be confirmed.

doc_level_changes: title: restored the full official title including the amending part.

key_dates: removed the scouting-process wording and added the signing date 2024-10-23 and OJ date 2024-11-20. The Art. 71(1) twentieth-day rule is now cited, with the 2024-12-10 date sourced to the Commission CRA summary page. The Art. 14 date of 2026-09-11, the Chapter IV date of 2026-06-11 and the general application date of 2027-12-11 are confirmed against Art. 71(2).
summary_ko: fixed 'without vulnerabilities' to 'without known exploitable vulnerabilities'.

pitfalls_ko: corrected the claim that the definitions are in lower-level documents, removed the indirect-requirement claim for customers, and added the risk-based 'where applicable' qualifier plus the Annex II items 7 and 9 notes.
limitations_ko: removed the scouting-stage reference and added the Commission-page and EUR-Lex access caveats.

license_notice and distribution_reason: rewritten to the centrally verified EUR-Lex reuse evidence only (Decision 2011/833/EU, special conditions, third-party and industrial-property exclusions, only the OJ authentic). Distribution stays public-under-license for the unaltered OJ PDF acquired from Cellar. The PDF text layer contains no special condition.

Unchanged after check: jurisdiction EU, instrument_type regulation, binding true, status in_force (staged application), language en, official_page_url, edition 'OJ L 20.11.2024, 81 pages' (matches provenance.json). Art. 14 reporting has applied since 2026-09-11, so it applies as of 2026-10-17; the rest applies from 2027-12-11.
remaining_concerns: I could not open the EUR-Lex pages (legal notice and legal-status page) with curl or WebFetch (empty bot-challenge response). The licence rests on the centrally supplied quotation and on the PDF text containing no reuse restriction; the status rests on the Commission CRA summary page plus a summarised EUR-Lex fetch.
Whether corrigenda or amending acts exist after 2024-11-20 (EUR-Lex showed 'This act has been changed' in a summary) is unconfirmed; the note already says so.

Many gateway_control_ko entries are intake-process candidates that mirror the POL texts (for example SBOM request and support-period recording), not established MINT features. Several are now marked 'candidate'.
Provision mappings POL-02 for Art. 13(1)-(3), POL-37 for Art. 13(9) and POL-39 for Art. 69 are tenuous but not clearly wrong, so I left them.

documents.key_dates: 2025-09-11 본문 머리의 일자(국가인터넷정보판공실), 2025-09-15 中国网信网 게시, 2025-11-01 시행(제14조).

defect_list.kind: wrong deadline basis / wrong actor level
defect_list.description: Summary said the 30-day summary report runs 'after reporting' (보고 후 30일) but Art. 8 runs it from the end of incident handling (处置工作结束后). It also said the 4-hour report goes to '시·성 網信부문', but Art. 4 para 4 names only 属地省级网信部门 (provincial level). It also described Art. 5 as an obligation of the service vendor, but Art. 5 obliges the network operator to require vendors by contract.

defect_list.kind: modality understated / ref covers other paragraph
defect_list.description: The note said the rest 'may' be supplemented (보완 보고할 수 있으며). The text allows only the minimal first report (可先报告第一项、第二项) and requires prompt supplementation (及时补报). The duty to report new important facts comes from para 3, not para 2, so the ref was wrong for that half.

Strength was 'mandatory', but the annex says 通常情况下…可判别为 (may be classified as). Important-data leakage was listed without the qualifier 'poses a relatively serious threat to national security and social stability' (较严重威胁). The note also omitted the precondition that the incident has not reached 重大 level.
The 1-hour and 30-minute limits apply only to 較大-or-above incidents (Art. 4 lead-in). The obligation text did not say so.
timing_ko said 'immediately judge' (즉시 판단). The text says only to classify on discovery or learning of the incident (发现或获知时) and sets no separate time limit.

POL-49 (return or deletion of documents held by an external provider at termination) is unrelated to incident-reporting contract clauses, so it was removed. gateway_control_ko claimed the product 'attaches contract evidence' and that a notification deadline is specified, but Art. 5 sets no deadline (only 及时) and this is an organisational contract duty. Rewritten as 'not applicable (organisational/contract)', with the evidence attachment as a candidate feature.

defect_list.kind: gateway_control_ko states candidate features as existing
defect_list.description: Wording such as '내보낸다', '제공한다', '둔다', '줄인다' and '지원한다' presented incident-summary export, deadline fields, version hashing and the like as existing MINT behaviour. These are not in the product capability list. The note also implied reduced disputes (제10조) and counting of data subjects in the minimised ledger (annex). Reworded as '후보 기능', and the non-compliance and not-a-ledger-count caveats were added.

The text states no starting point for the clock, yet the note said the deadline runs from 'discovery or learning' as if fixed. The note also claimed the Measures 'do not replace the CII Protection Regulation', which the text does not say. It also said 一般 events are 'not subject to' the Measures, which overstates; Art. 4 only sets a procedure for 較大-or-above events. Rewritten, with the unconfirmed start point stated.
Scouting-phase remarks about an expected 2026-11-01 date were carried into key_dates and pitfalls. The official date of 2025-11-01 (Art. 14) is correct and was kept.
The English parenthetical in the title is the scout's own translation, not in the document. Title is now the native title; the limitations field says the English is unofficial.

The note called the document a '부문규장' (departmental rule), but the extract shows no rule number or promulgation form. The note also gave no account of the staged HTML's site chrome. Now states exactly the evidence used (PRC Copyright Law Art. 5(1), 2021-06-01; page footer shows only '© 版权所有'). The MOFCOM URL was fetched and confirms Art. 5(1) and the 2021-06-01 effective date.

The staged file is the full cac.gov.cn HTML page (menus, footer '© 版权所有', script links, CMS credits), not a clean document. The Art. 5(1) evidence covers the measure's text only. public-under-license is kept, and the reason now says the site chrome is not covered.
'정량 지표로 열거한다' dropped 有限枚举 (limited enumeration); also now says the guide was 'drafted with reference to' GB/T 20986-2023.

documents.key_dates: 2024-08-30 국무원 상무회의 통과, 2024-09-24 서명(성문일), 2024-09-30 발행(gov.cn 정책 라이브러리 페이지 표기), 2025-01-01 시행(령 서문, 제64조). 게시처: 국무원공보 2024년 제29호.

defect_list.description: The note set public-under-license on PRC Copyright Law Art. 5(1) alone and cited a '© 版权所有' footer, which does not exist; the page footer reads '版权所有：中国政府网'. It did not mention the gov.cn site statement (content_5046258.htm), which I fetched. That statement bars commercial original-form reprinting and distortion of site content, says the site's copyright belongs to the site, and says the printed text prevails. The staged file is the whole gov.cn web page as acquired. Art. 5(1) and its 2021-06-01 effective date were confirmed on the MOFCOM page. The note ignored the contrary statement.

Public distribution of the unaltered gov.cn HTML page conflicts with the site statement the note never mentioned. The Art. 5(1) point covers the legal text, not the page as acquired. Changed distribution to local-only and rewrote license_notice and distribution_reason to state exactly the evidence used. The lead may revert if it decides to distribute only the extracted legal text.

The note said re-consent is needed when purpose, method, category or retention period changes. Art. 22(6) lists only purpose, method and category. Retention period appears in Art. 22(4), as a limit on processing beyond the consent. Removed the retention period from the re-consent trigger.

The text says '可以向境外提供' (may provide). The note rephrased it as a duty ('충족해야...제공할 수 있다') and set strength mandatory. It also dropped the HR-management and 'other conditions' items. Changed to a permission paraphrase, strength informative, and listed the items completely.

'구체 임계값은 별도 문서(데이터 출경 유동 규정)', the '누적 10만·100만 명' figures and the 'LIB-M30' reference are not in the Decree text. They came from memory. The scout file lists LIB-M30 as 'Provisions on Promoting and Regulating Cross-Border Data Flows', but the content was not read. Removed the figures and marked the point as not read.

The note said the gov.cn policy-library page (content_6977766) loads its body by script and cannot be extracted, and that the two copies were not compared. Plain curl returns the full text. Comparing it with the extract ignoring whitespace gave 9745 characters each, with one difference: a full-width versus half-width semicolon between Art. 35 items (7) and (8). Rewrote the pitfall with the actual result.

The note said data that the relevant department or region has notified or published as important data is 'the subject of declaration (제29조, 제37조)'. Art. 29(2) requires processors to identify and declare important data under national rules. Art. 37 only says data not notified or published as important data need not be declared as such for the outbound security assessment. Corrected.

The note claimed the ledger aggregate can export storage period, storage location and similar items for the annual report. A gateway call ledger does not hold those. Narrowed to per-call recorded items (purpose, category, quantity, method, scope, cross-border flag), with storage period/location and report submission marked out of scope.
The note said 1,000万+ personal-information processors follow the 'important data processor rules'. Art. 28 extends only Arts. 30 and 32. Corrected to name the two articles.
Training-data security management was filed under secure_development_supply_chain. Changed to security_risk_management.

'무리한 불가피' scoping: in the text, '无法避免' (unavoidably) governs both unnecessary personal information and personal information collected without lawful consent. The note's wording read as if any collection without consent triggers deletion. Reworded.

The note said criminal leads go to the public security organs only. The text says public security and national security organs. It also omitted the exception for cases where law says notification is not needed. Added both.
Separate consent (단독 동의) is obtained from the data subject by the processor. The gateway can only check a consent record as a policy condition. Added a sentence saying so.
Added the 2024-09-30 issue date and the 2024-09-24 document date. Both are shown on the gov.cn policy page I fetched.

The text said the full text was read and also that Arts. 3-7 and 62-64 were not read in detail. The cited gov.cn pages were not fully read and no amendment check was recorded. Rewrote after checking the full extract. A web search found no amendment notice for 2026, but this is not a direct check of the national law database, so the limitation states that.

Article numbers, modality, the 24-hour and 3-year figures, the annual cycle, the fine tiers (1,000,000 and 2,000,000 yuan), the cited article lists and the anchors match the extract. POL mappings are plausible, so none were removed or added. Status in_force, 9 chapters and 64 articles, Gazette 2024 No. 29, adoption 2024-08-30, signing 2024-09-24 and effect 2025-01-01 were confirmed on the staged page and the gov.cn policy page.

If the lead distributes only the extract of the Decree text, public-under-license would be defensible. For the as-acquired HTML, local-only is the conservative choice.

documents.edition: 2021-08-20 통과본 전문 8장 74조(PDF 21쪽). 이 사본은 태안(泰安)시 정부 도메인(dsjj.taian.gov.cn)에 올라온 PDF(WPS 문서로 제작, 파일 속성상 2023-07 생성)이며 발행 기관의 공식 게시본이 아니다. 본문은 CAC 페이지(출처 표기: 중국인대망)의 법률 본문과 공백·쪽 표시를 제외하고 글자 단위로 일치함을 대조했다.

defect_list.description: The note said the entrusted party must return or delete the data when the contract is 'invalid or terminated' and may not sub-entrust 'without consent'. The text says the contract 'does not take effect, is invalid, revoked or terminated'. Data is returned to the entrusting processor. Sub-entrustment needs that processor's consent.
POL-15 (separate credentials per MCP server) has no connection to entrusted processing duties.

The control said the gateway revokes call approvals 'for that data subject's data'. The gateway authorises by principal, server, function and data class, not by data subject, so this implied a per-subject consent capability it is not shown to have.
The obligation also covers the duty to ensure the foreign recipient meets PIPL standards. That duty is paragraph 3, not paragraph 1.
The obligation also covers the exemption from notifying individuals and the authority's power to require notice. Those are paragraph 2.
An entry-into-force clause was marked 'mandatory', but it states a date and imposes no obligation.
'Closer to the EU GDPR controller' was a comparison from outside the text. It has been replaced by the Art. 73(1) wording and a note that the schema actor 'controller' is a mapping.

The note said the official versions are the NPC Standing Committee Gazette and the CAC page, and that the copy was not compared with them. I compared the PDF text with the CAC page, which names 中国人大网 as source. After normalising whitespace and page markers the two are identical (8312 characters, no differences). I did not compare against the Gazette.

The note carried over the scout's claim that no amendment exists as of 2026-10-17. The CAC page shows no amendment notice and a web search found none, but the NPC Gazette and NPC law database were not checked. It is now marked unconfirmed.

The note cited 'the Copyright Law article previously confirmed by the wiki' without saying the staged file is a third-party copy. The PDF is a WPS-made file (author 'user', created 2023-07) hosted on taian.gov.cn, and it contains no reuse notice. Its text equals the CAC text with no commentary added. I kept public-under-license on the central evidence (Copyright Law Art. 5(1)) and rewrote both fields to state that evidence and that the file is not an official publication. The CAC page footer carries a site-wide copyright mark, and no separate reuse terms for the law text were found. I did not re-fetch the Copyright Law.
'CAC' was used as if it were the text's wording. The statute says 国家网信部门 (national cyberspace/internet-information department).

doc_level_changes: edition: added that the PDF is a WPS-made copy on a Tai'an government domain, and that its text matches the CAC page character for character

defect_list.description: scope_ko said critical-information-infrastructure operators (CIIOs) have almost no exemptions and are always subject to security-assessment filing. Art. 7 (last paragraph) says situations under Arts. 3-6 follow those articles, and only Art. 5(4) excludes CIIOs. scope_ko also said the rules apply to data 'collected in China', which the text does not say.

The pitfall that CIIOs get the first three Art. 5 exemptions 'without this distinction' was a reading not stated in the text, and it ignored the Art. 7/8 carve-out. Rewritten to what the text says; the interpretation is explicitly not made.

The extension of an assessment result is optional (可以, 'may apply'), but the provision was tagged mandatory and phrased as if it were required to continue exporting. The condition that no circumstance requiring re-filing has occurred was also missing. Strength changed to informative, wording and timing_ko corrected. The 3-year validity and the 60-working-day window are correct.

The paragraph 'situations under Arts. 3, 4, 5, 6 follow those provisions' was omitted. It changes who must file. Added to obligation_ko. The thresholds (100만 / 1만, cumulative from 1 January) match the text.
The same Arts. 3-6 carve-out in Art. 8's last paragraph was omitted. Added. The 10만-100만 and under-1만 sensitive thresholds match the text.

An exemption clause (免予) was tagged strength=mandatory, but the text is not phrased as shall/must. The last paragraph ('provided PI does not include important data') was missing. Changed to informative and added the paragraph.
Same exemption tagged mandatory; changed to informative. Item (2) named only labour rules and omitted collective contracts (集体合同). The 'necessary' (确需) condition was also missing. Corrected.
单独同意 was rendered as '단독 동의', which can be misread as 'sole consent'. Changed to '별도 동의(单独同意)' and added the 'etc.' and the 'laws and administrative regulations' source.
POL-37 (re-approval after MCP server changes) does not match a time-limited assessment result. Replaced with POL-08, which covers checking approval conditions and validity period.

Controls were written in the present tense ('차단한다', '제공한다', '경보를 내며'), as if MINT already did these things, and did not separate organisational duties (filing, contract signing, consent, impact assessment, incident reporting). Rewritten as '후보 통제 ... 할 수 있다', with the organisational duties stated. Art. 13 gateway text no longer says what the matrix 'does'.

The pitfall carried a scout-reported effective date (2026-01-01) for a separate PI export certification regime and used internal wording ('스카우트 단계'). The date is not in the document. The CAC page of 2026-03-23 only says the certification measure was issued in October 2025, with no effective date. Date removed; marked as outside this document and unconfirmed.

Status relied on 'scout search results'. Replaced with the evidence I used: no amendment or repeal found by web search, and the CAC page of 2026-03-23 treats the Provisions as operating without mentioning amendment. Added that the CAC and Gazette texts were not compared.
'합산하지 않고 따로 센다' and 'only if on the notified/published list' went slightly beyond Art. 2 and Art. 7(2). Reworded to the text ('不含敏感个人信息'; 'not notified or published as important data').
The English parenthetical in the title is not on the CAC page (no official English). Labelled as an unofficial translation.

The decision rests only on PRC Copyright Law Art. 5(1) (centrally verified; no explicit licence text). The staged copy is the whole CAC HTML page, including navigation, footer and scripts that this ground does not cover. Re-checked the MOFCOM page: it shows the Art. 5(1) text and effective date 2021-06-01, but it is a secondary copy with a disclaimer, now stated. The decision stays public-under-license for the regulation text. The wording now says exactly what evidence was used and that site-template parts are outside it.

defect_list.description: The note gave status 'voluntary' with no mention that a newer edition exists. The CAC site (https://www.cac.gov.cn/2026-09/14/c_1791137092283345.htm, source: TC260) reports that AI Safety Governance Framework 3.0 was released on 2026-09-14. As of 2026-10-17 the staged 2.0 PDF is therefore not the current edition. No explicit withdrawal text for 2.0 was found.

The 2.0 release date 2025-09-15 and the 'TC260 technical document' description rested on the scouting report. I re-checked both on the official CAC page (https://www.cac.gov.cn/2025-09/15/c_1759653448369123.htm): released 2025-09-15 at the National Cybersecurity Awareness Week main forum, led by CNCERT under CAC guidance, described as a TC260 technical document. The note also did not say that the 'non-binding' reading is an inference from that description.

scope_ko said the framework is 'used to interpret Chinese laws (Interim Measures for generative AI, Cybersecurity Law, etc.)'. The text does not say this, so it came from memory. 'Not a legal obligation' was also stated flatly.

The pitfall said 'every should is only a recommendation' and pointed to 'LIB-M09 interim measures' for the legal duties. That reference was not checked against any text. It also ignored 5.5 ('will be subject to') and 5.11 ('Developers will be required'), which describe future regulatory direction, and the 'must' in 6.2.2.
The pitfall named 'the deep synthesis provisions' as the place to check legal log-retention periods. That example appears nowhere in the extract and came from memory.

In the English translation the 5.10 heading is followed by a verbatim repeat of the 5.9 body (AI vulnerability database and threat-information sharing). The Chinese 5.10 is about data security and personal-information protection across training, labelling, use and output, plus de-identification. The anchor text for provision 5.9 therefore occurs twice in the extract and was not flagged. I added a pitfall.
The note gave Chinese pages 1-40 and English pages 41-92. In the extract, page 40 and page 92 are blank, Chinese ends on page 39 and English runs 41-91.

The reading scope was vague ('6.1 일부 이후의 세부 지침 ... 훑어보기') and said Appendix 2 and the risk table were unread. I rewrote it to what I verified: English pages 41-91 in full, Appendix 1-3 read, and the Chinese text compared only for 5.5, 5.9-5.10, 6.3.6 and 4.2.3(c).

The note said 'no reuse wording found (scout report)' and that it had not judged Copyright Law Art. 5(1). The decision 'local-only' is correct under the central evidence, which says TC260 technical documents are not covered, but the reasoning was missing. I grepped the PDF (no copyright or reuse notice) and checked the CAC page footer ('国家互联网信息办公室 © 版权所有', no reuse licence). The notice and reason now state exactly that evidence.
The limitations did not say that the 3.0 text was not read. I added that the note does not describe 3.0.

The passage is a first-person statement of principle ('We explore risk grading ... implement proportionate response measures'). It does not recommend anything to a named actor. It was marked recommended with actor 'authority'.

'불필수 서비스' was a wording error. gateway_control_ko claimed the product restricts admin routes with admin authentication, which is not in the MINT capability list or the text. It also gave no limit on what the gateway does not cover.

The paraphrase said AI used in critical information infrastructure 'is subject to registration and filing'. It left out the accompanying requirement in the same sentence (Chinese: 登记备案, and the system must have security protection capabilities matching its security needs).
gateway_control_ko spoke of a 'contract lock' and 'version policy' as if they already exist. Model and dataset versioning is the developer's duty, not the gateway's.

POL-28 (call and concurrency limits) has no basis in this passage, which covers monitoring, emergency plans, alert thresholds and switching to manual systems. gateway_control_ko also stated fail-closed behaviour of the policy engine as a default, which neither the passage nor the capability list supports.

gateway_control_ko claimed a 'China customer default of 6 months' for ledger retention. No such setting is shown anywhere. It also blurred the service's operational logs with the gateway's audit ledger.
