documents.title: Cybersecurity technology — Basic security requirements for generative artificial intelligence service (GB/T 45654—2025)
documents.title_native: 网络安全技术 生成式人工智能服务安全基本要求
documents.issuer: 국가시장감독관리총국(SAMR)·국가표준화관리위원회(SAC). 전국 사이버보안 표준화 기술위원회(SAC/TC260) 제출·관리
documents.edition: GB/T 45654—2025(권장성 국가표준), 31쪽, 중국어
documents.key_dates: 표지: 2025-04-25 발표, 2025-11-01 시행. 전국표준정보공공서비스플랫폼(openstd.samr.gov.cn)의 이 표준 쪽(2026-10-17 조회)은 표준 상태를 현행(现行), 발표일 2025-04-25, 시행일 2025-11-01로 표시한다. 따라서 2026-10-17 기준 시행 중인 권장성(GB/T) 국가표준이다. TC260 공식 쪽의 전문 게시일은 2025-06-30이다.

defect_list.description: The standard is a non-binding recommended national standard (GB/T, binding=false). NOTE_GUIDE allows 'mandatory' only for binding instruments. The text's 应 is the standard's own requirement wording.

The text says 明显偏激 (obviously extreme or radical) questions must be refused. The note rendered it as 'biased' (편향), which changes the meaning. The text also says 'should be able to answer all other questions', which the note weakened.

POL-22 (per-request execution authorisation) and POL-38 do not correspond to a model's output pass rate or refusal behaviour. The claim that the gateway records denial reasons as evidence of model refusal conflated gateway policy denials with model refusals.
The text says the gateway 'manages and confirms' dev/test/prod separation. The provision concerns the provider's training vs inference environments, so this does not evidence compliance.

The obligation also covers 6.2 a) (public disclosure of target groups, scenes and uses on the homepage), so the ref is now 6.2 a)-c). The note limited disclosure to the 'service terms'; the text says homepage, service agreement or other easily viewed places.
The obligation also paraphrases 6.4 a), so the ref is now 6.4 a)-b). The list of channels is 'including but not limited to', which the note omitted.
The text says 达到一定次数 ('reaches a certain number'). The note said 'exceeds' (초과).
POL-05 (Tool description vs actual behaviour test) is unrelated to the size of a model-output test question bank, which is informative only.
gateway_control_ko said intake or application forms 'confirm' or 'contain' items, as if this already happened. Reworded as candidate or policy items under POL-07 or the intake review.

The quoted passage is in 引言 (Introduction), not the 서문. The LIB-M09 instrument was called '관리 규정' in scope_ko but '관리 잠정 방법' in pitfalls. The scope_ko sentence about LIB-M09 was garbled; it is now one clear unconfirmed statement.

The note said the A.1~A.4 categories are what 'Chinese laws and policies prohibit'. The text only supports: 29 risks in A.1~A.4 are 违法不良信息 (4.1.1 note 1), A.5 brings the total to 31, and A.1 is 'violating core socialist values'. Rewritten to that.
The technical committee was named with its old Korean name (정보보안). The foreword says 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (SAC/TC260).

The note called the 2025-06-30 date unconfirmed and had not checked status on an official register. I checked openstd.samr.gov.cn: status 现行, published 2025-04-25, effective 2025-11-01, issued by SAMR and SAC. The TC260 page shows 2025-06-30 as the full-text posting date.

The licence notice relied on a scouting report. It now cites the verified TC260 footer (版权所有 ©2009-2026) and the openstd footer (版权所有 侵权必究). The PDF text layer has no reuse statement. Distribution stays local-only, as the central evidence says GB/T and TC260 documents are not covered.

doc_level_changes: issuer: corrected committee name to SAC/TC260 (전국 사이버보안 표준화 기술위원회)
key_dates: added openstd register check (status 현행, 2025-04-25 published, 2025-11-01 effective) and the TC260 posting date 2025-06-30, both now confirmed
scope_ko: clarified that a recommended standard is not itself a legal obligation, and that its use in LIB-M09 filing practice is unconfirmed; corrected the LIB-M09 name to 관리 잠정 방법
pitfalls_ko: rewrote the risk-taxonomy pitfall to match the text; added a pitfall that 应 is the standard's own wording and strengths are marked recommended
license_notice and distribution_reason: now state the verified evidence (TC260 and openstd copyright footers, no reuse text in the PDF extract). Distribution remains local-only.
strength: 15 mandatory values changed to recommended because binding is false
remaining_concerns: Title, issuer, edition, dates, status, language and URL were re-checked against the TC260 page, the openstd register and the PDF cover. The Chinese text of every provision was read against its anchor and matches the note's thresholds (5%, 90%, 4 clicks, 2000 questions, 10000 keywords).

pol_ids and gateway_control_ko are analogies to MINT policies rather than direct implementations. The obligations fall on the generative AI service provider, so many entries are correctly 'not applicable'. A few weak links remain: POL-01 on 5.1, POL-25 on 4.2.3, POL-28 on 6.5 and POL-05 on 5.4.
The English-language unofficial CSET translation was not consulted.
reading_scope_ko says B.2.1 was partly read; I did not re-verify that, and no provision depends on B.2 or later.

documents.edition: 국신판통자〔2025〕2호 통지로 인쇄·배포, 2025-03-07 서명, 총 14개 조
documents.key_dates: 2025-03-07 서명, 2025-03-14 中国网信网 게시, 2025-09-01 시행(제14조). 공식 게시본에는 첨부 PDF가 없다.

defect_list.description: 'MINT 자체는 표시 의무자가 아니다'는 본문 근거 없는 법적 결론이다.
전파 요소 정보를 메타데이터에 추가하는 의무는 제2항에 있는데 제1항으로 표기했고, 제1항 제1~3호 요건(명시 시 확정 표시, 선언·검출 시 가능·의심 표시)도 뭉뚱그렸다.
표시 없는 콘텐츠 제공은 '可以'(재량)이고 6개월 로그 보존은 그렇게 제공하는 경우에 걸리는 조건부 의무인데 무조건 의무처럼 읽혔다. timing_ko도 조건을 빠뜨렸다.
gateway_control이 '보존 기간을 6개월 이상으로 설정할 수 있게 한다'고 쓰여 기존 기능처럼 읽혔다.
gateway_control이 원장 기록 내보내기를 '제공한다'고 단정했고 '감독기관 요청 대응'은 본문에 없다. 표시 관련 자료 제출은 호출 이력 관리(POL-38)와 연결되지 않는다.
'고객이 제공자인 경우에만 관련된다'는 제10조제2항(모든 조직·개인 대상 삭제·위조 금지)과 제10조제1항(이용자 선언 의무)과 모순된다.
GB 45438-2025 번호와 표준 명칭은 추출문에 없는 기억 기반 사실이다. CAC 해설 페이지로 강제성 표준의 존재, 2025년 제3호 공고, 2025-09-01 동시 시행은 확인했다. 번호는 공식 페이지에서 확인하지 못했다.
적용 범위 조항을 mandatory로 표기했다. 의무 조항이 아니므로 informative가 맞다.
gateway_control이 '중국 시장 대상'이라는 본문에 없는 지역 한정을 넣고, 기록 절차를 기존 기능처럼 '표시한다'고 썼다.
gateway_control의 '도입 심사의 동작 시험 범위가 아니다'는 근거 없는 주장이고 제4조제2항의 '도입 시험 항목으로 둘 수 있다'와 모순된다.
POL-07(외부 제공자의 문서 저장·재사용·제3자 제공 확인)은 사용자 협의에 표시 방법을 명시하는 의무와 맞지 않는다.
'부문규장'이라는 분류는 본문으로 뒷받침되지 않는다. 통지(通字)로 인쇄·배포된 문서이므로 행정적 성격의 규범 문서로 고쳤다. 저작권법 제5조 제1호 조문과 2021-06-01 시행은 商务部 DB에서 확인했다(현행 유효). 보존본은 사이트 화면 구성이 포함된 HTML이라 사이트 화면 구성·로고·'© 版权所有'는 근거에서 제외한다고 명시했다.
공식 페이지 재취득 해시 일치와 미독 규정 목록(생성형 AI 서비스 관리 잠정 방법 포함)을 반영하도록 보완했다.

doc_level_changes: scope_ko: MINT가 의무자가 아니라는 단정 삭제, 해당 여부는 고객 서비스 형태에 따르며 이 노트가 판단하지 않는다고 수정
pitfalls_ko: 표시 의무 주체 설명을 제10조제1항·제2항을 반영해 수정, 강제성 국가표준 설명을 CAC 해설 페이지로 확인된 내용(2025년 제3호 공고, 2025-09-01 동시 시행)으로 교체하고 GB 번호는 공식 페이지 미확인으로 표기
license_notice·distribution_reason: 근거를 저작권법 제5조 제1호(2020년 개정, 2021-06-01 시행)로 한정하고 '부문규장' 표현 삭제, 사이트 화면 구성·로고는 근거 밖이라고 명시. distribution은 public-under-license 유지
reading_scope_ko: 게시 페이지 재취득과 해시 일치 확인, 미독 규정 목록 보완
검증 완료 항목(변경 없음): title, title_native, issuer, 통지 번호 국신판통자〔2025〕2호, 서명일 2025-03-07, 게시일 2025-03-14, 시행일 2025-09-01(제14조), 총 14개 조, language zh, official_page_url, status in_force
remaining_concerns: 보존된 원본이 CAC 사이트의 HTML 전체(사이트 화면 구성 포함)이므로 public-under-license는 방법 본문에만 확실한 근거가 있다. 보존본 전체 공개를 원하면 법무 확인이 바람직하다.
status in_force: 2026년 개정·폐지 공지를 검색했으나 찾지 못했다. 이는 부재 확인이지 직접 확인이 아니다.
GB 45438-2025 번호는 제3자 자료 기준이다. 노트에는 미확인으로 표기했다.
제4조제2항이 제4조제1항의 적용 범위(심층 합성 규정 제17조제1항 해당 서비스)에 한정되는지는 원문상 모호하다. pitfalls에 해당 규정 미독을 이미 명시했다.
10개 조항만 다뤘고 제7조(앱 배포 플랫폼 검증), 제10조제1항, 제11조, 제13조는 provision으로 다루지 않았다. 신규 추가는 하지 않았다.

documents.title: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition)
documents.issuer: 싱가포르 의회. 싱가포르 법령 온라인(SSO, 법무장관실(AGC) 운영) 비공식 통합본
documents.edition: 2020 Revised Edition, SSO 비공식 통합본(Informal Consolidation – version in force from 16/10/2026), 125쪽
documents.key_dates: PDF 표지: 2020 개정판(2021-12-01까지의 개정 반영, 2021-12-31 시행) 위에 'Informal Consolidation – version in force from 16/10/2026'이 표시된다. 제26C조 제1항은 데이터 침해 평가 의무가 2021-02-01 이후 발생한 침해에 적용된다고 규정한다. 제48J조 제3항의 매출 10% 상한은 2020년 개정법 시행(2022-10-01) 이후 위반에 적용된다고 표기돼 있다.

defect_list.description: license_notice cited a 'clause 13(d)' for the automated-extraction window and 'clause 14' for revocation, and said the Terms page was read while writing the note. The Terms page is blocked (HTTP 403) and could not be read. Only clause 13 is supported by the central evidence and a search summary, and the SSO FAQ cites clause 15, so the numbering is unconfirmed. Sub-letter (d) and clause 14 had no support. The PDF text contains no copyright or reuse notice (grep).

The reason rested on a guess about the work PC's local time ('around 5pm, timezone not checked'). The central evidence states the copy was fetched by script outside the 03:00-07:00 Singapore window, so the reason now cites that. local-only is correct.

scope_ko said the Act applies to organisations that collect, use or disclose personal data 'in Singapore'. The text read says otherwise: s.2 'organisation' covers entities whether or not formed, resident or having an office in Singapore, and no territorial provision was found in the sections read. Reworded to the s.2 definition and the s.4(1) exclusions, and added that the geographic scope was not confirmed.

defect_list.kind: statement about unread or non-existent part
defect_list.description: reading_scope listed Part 6B as 'not read', but this PDF has no Part 6B body (it is only referred to in ss.4, 48J etc.). It also did not say the official SSO page could not be re-checked. Both corrected; s.2 is now stated as read only for the 'organisation' and 'data intermediary' definitions.

obligation_ko added '(예: 암호화)' as an example of the technological measure; s.26D(5)(b) does not name encryption. It also omitted s.26D(5)(a) (post-assessment action under prescribed requirements) and the s.26D(6)-(7) elements the paraphrase described but the ref did not cover. It said 'likely to cause significant harm' where s.26B(1)(a) says 'results in, or is likely to result in'. Removed the encryption example, added (5)(a), made the 26B(1)(a) wording exact, widened the ref to 5-7, and noted the organisation decides which measures qualify.

strength was 'mandatory', but s.26B is a definition ('is a notifiable data breach if...') with no must/shall. The duty sits in ss.26C and 26D. Changed to informative and hedged the gateway control as a candidate.

strength was 'mandatory' and theme 'third_party_management', but s.4(2) is an exclusion saying Parts 3-6B do not impose obligations on data intermediaries, except ss.24, 25, 26C(3)(a) and 26E. It is a scope provision. Changed to informative and scope_applicability. Paraphrase and anchor are correct.

strength was 'mandatory' with actor 'authority'. s.48J(1) is discretionary ('may') and s.48J(3) is a cap on the penalty. Changed to informative. The 10% of annual turnover in Singapore above $10 million, and the $1 million cap in any other case, match the text. 'wef 01/10/2022' is an annotation in the text.

The pitfall said pre-amendment contraventions are capped at $1 million. Under s.48J(3)(b) the $1 million cap applies in any other case, which also includes post-commencement contraventions by organisations with Singapore turnover of $10 million or less. Also added that the actual maximum is to be prescribed.

The pitfall claimed the SSO Terms say the content must not be relied on as authoritative. That was not read. Replaced with what is verifiable: the PDF cover says 'Informal Consolidation'. The Terms wording is flagged as known only from a search summary.

gateway_control_ko gave '(계약·인증 등)' as the transfer requirements. The prescribed requirements are not in the Act and the note admits subordinate rules were not read. Replaced with '하위 규정 확인 필요'. The ref now covers the (2)-(3) exemption mentioned in the obligation text.

gateway_control_ko said the gateway 'cleans up documents held by external providers', which the gateway cannot do (POL-49 is an organisational check of provider return or deletion). Rewritten as a procedure candidate.

defect_list.kind: gateway control stated as existing capability
defect_list.description: gateway_control_ko used declarative wording ('revoke approval and provide history', 'provide ledger extracts quickly') as if existing features. Hedged as candidates ('~할 수 있다(후보)').

obligation_ko said '평가를 한 날로부터 3일' while topic, timing and pitfalls said 'from the day after'. The text says 'no later than 3 calendar days after the day the organisation makes that assessment'. Aligned. The ref now includes (3)-(4), which the paraphrase covers.
The ref was ss.2-3 but the paraphrase covers s.11(5) (publish business contact details) and s.11(6) (designation does not relieve obligations). Ref widened.
AGC was rendered '법무부' (Ministry of Law). It is the Attorney-General's Chambers (법무장관실).

The official SSO page and Terms page returned HTTP 403 to curl and WebFetch. Status in_force, edition and key dates match the PDF cover and text (2021-12-01 amendments, comes into operation 2021-12-31, 'version in force from 16/10/2026', s.26C(1) 1 Feb 2021, s.48J 'wef 01/10/2022', 125 pages per provenance). They could not be re-checked on the official page. limitations_ko states this.

The provision covers both the organisation's assessment duty and the data intermediary's notification duty. The anchor sits in the intermediary's duty but actor is 'controller'. Left as is; the paraphrase states both actors.

doc_level_changes: issuer: AGC corrected to 법무장관실
scope_ko: removed unsupported 'in Singapore' territorial limit; now uses the s.2 definition and s.4(1)/(2) exclusions
pitfalls_ko: informal-consolidation and s.48J penalty-cap bullets corrected

reading_scope_ko / limitations_ko: Part 6B has no body in this PDF; official page not reachable (HTTP 403); status and dates rest on the PDF cover; informal consolidation caveat; '$' currency not stated in the text

license_notice / distribution_reason: clause numbering marked unconfirmed (central evidence says 13, SSO FAQ says 15); removed unsupported '(d)' and 'clause 14'; reason now cites the central evidence (script fetch outside the 03:00-07:00 Singapore window); distribution stays local-only

documents.key_dates: 2000-04-13 재가(PDF 제목 부분 'Assented to 13th April 2000'). 제1부(민간 부문 개인정보 보호)는 2001-01-01 시행(PDF 제29조 주석 'Part 1 in force January 1, 2001, see SI/2000-29'). 통합 기준일 2026-09-30, 최종 개정 2025-03-04(PDF 쪽 머리말과 공식 페이지 'Act current to 2026-09-30 and last amended on 2025-03-04'가 일치). PDF 말미 '시행 전 개정(Amendments Not in Force)'에 2026, c. 3 제389~397조에 의한 개정이 실려 있다(제10.3조 뒤에 제1.2절 '개인정보 이동성', 제10.4~10.6조 신설 등). 의회 LEGISinfo(45-1)에서 법안 C-36은 긴 제목이 'An Act to enact the Protecting Privacy and Consumer Data Act, to amend the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act...'이고 2026-06-15 하원 제1독회 후 제2독회 단계로 표시되며 왕실 재가 전이다(2026-10-17 조회). 이 법안이 PIPEDA 제1부를 폐지·대체하는지는 확인하지 않았다.

defect_list.description: key_dates carried scout hearsay (Bill C-36 'replaces' private-sector rules; staged commencement) as unconfirmed and omitted facts that the extract shows (assent 2000-04-13; Part 1 in force 2001-01-01 per PDF note SI/2000-29; 'Amendments Not in Force' 2026, c. 3 ss.389-397 adding Division 1.2 data mobility). The 'replace/repeal' claim is not supported: LEGISinfo shows only that C-36's long title enacts a new Act and amends PIPEDA; first reading 2026-06-15; no royal assent.

scope_ko said the Act is 'generally known' to apply to commercial activities and that s.4 was not read; applicability was from memory. Replaced with the text of s.4(1), 4(2) and 4.01 (commercial activity; federal works employee data; exclusions for Privacy Act institutions, personal/domestic, journalistic/artistic/literary, business contact info).
Obligation paraphrase includes the duty to give the Commissioner access/copy on request, which is s.10.3(2), but ref cited only s.10.3(1).
timing_ko asserted the retention period is 'set by the regulation'; statute only says 'in accordance with any prescribed requirements' and the regulation was not read.

actor was 'authority' although the offence provision is addressed to the organization (knowingly contravening 8(8), 10.1, 10.3(1), 27.1(1) or obstructing the Commissioner). Changed to controller. Amounts ($10,000 summary / $100,000 indictable) verified.
Obligation omitted that notification is in the prescribed form/manner and may be given indirectly in prescribed circumstances (s.10.1(5)).
Obligation text draws on cl.4.7.1 and 4.7.2 (safeguard purposes, factors, should-higher-protection) but ref listed only cl.4.7.

POL-15 (per-server credential separation) and the claim that credentials are separated per server do not map to the 'comparable level of protection by contract' duty. Removed POL-15 and reworded the control.

Clause mixes 'should' (destroy/erase/anonymise) and 'shall' (develop guidelines and procedures); a single strength 'recommended' understates the shall part. Kept 'recommended' but marked the two parts in topic_ko.

Several controls stated as existing product behaviour ('표시한다', '차단하고 정리한다', '체크리스트로 수행한다', '제공한다'). Reworded as candidate/evidence roles and stated that determinations (appropriateness, real risk of significant harm, regulatory record) stay with the organization.

Pitfalls lacked: s.5(1) makes Schedule 1 subject to ss.6-9 (and s.7/10.2(4) widen cl.4.3/4.5 exceptions); s.2(1) definition of 'breach of security safeguards' (tied to cl.4.7); consolidation is not the official text (PDF p.2, original prevails); not-in-force Division 1.2; official page lists Alberta/BC/Quebec exemption orders. Added; replaced the unconfirmed C-36 pitfall.

Licence claim (Reproduction of Federal Law Order SI/97-5) is correct and re-confirmed on https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/faq/ ('without charge or request for permission ... due diligence ... not represented as an official version'). Notice did not state FAQ URL/date or that the PDF itself carries no separate copyright statement (grep found none); distribution_reason implied the 'check latest version' rule came from the Order. Reworded to state exactly the evidence used. Decision public-under-license kept.
Updated to record the extra passages read at verification (assent, s.2 breach definition, s.4, Amendments Not in Force) and that the PDF is a non-official consolidation.

doc_level_changes: key_dates rewritten with text-backed dates (assent 2000-04-13, Part 1 in force 2001-01-01, consolidation current to 2026-09-30, last amended 2025-03-04, Amendments Not in Force 2026 c.3 ss.389-397) and LEGISinfo status of Bill C-36 (first reading 2026-06-15, no royal assent; replacement of Part 1 not confirmed)
scope_ko replaced with s.4 text
3 pitfalls added, 1 unconfirmed pitfall replaced
reading_scope_ko, limitations_ko, license_notice, distribution_reason made precise

Official page https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/acts/p-8.6/ fetched (HTTP 200): 'Act current to 2026-09-30 and last amended on 2025-03-04', Part 1 in force; title, issuer, edition (71 pp.), language, jurisdiction, binding and URL confirmed. Distribution kept public-under-license.
remaining_concerns: Sch.1 cl.4.5.3 mixes should/shall under one strength value (kept 'recommended')
POL-41 on cl.4.7.3 and POL-02 on cl.4.1 are loose links; left in place because not clearly wrong
Regulations (Breach of Security Safeguards Regulations), ss.7-9, and Schedule 1 cl.4.2-4.4, 4.6, 4.8-4.10 were not read; the note says so
Bill C-36 effect on PIPEDA Part 1 was not verified beyond its long title and status

documents.edition: 2021년 법률 제25호(법안 64) 연간 법령집 PDF 영어판, 64쪽. 개정 법이며 민간 부문법(P-39.1) 개정 조문은 제100조부터 제161조 사이
documents.key_dates: 2021-09-22 국왕 재가. 제175조에 따라 대부분은 2023-09-22 시행, 일부는 2021-09-22, 2022-09-22(예: 민간 부문법 제3.1조, 제3.5~3.8조의 사고 관리, 제18.4조 등), 2024-09-22(제30조와 제120조 일부)에 시행된다. 제175조 제4호(제160조 중 민간 부문법 제91조 제3호 신설분)는 신용평가기관법(2020, c. 21) 제108조의 시행일에 시행되며 그 시행 여부는 확인하지 못했다. 날짜가 정해진 시행일은 2026-10-17 이전에 모두 지났고 이 노트가 인용한 조항은 제4호에 해당하지 않으나, 이 PDF는 제정 당시 원문이라 이후 개정 여부는 확인하지 못했다. 공식 페이지는 시행일을 '2023-09-22, 예외 있음'으로만 표시한다.

defect_list.description: The note said no reuse terms were found. The Publications du Québec copyright page (publicationsduquebec.gouv.qc.ca/droits-auteur/) says content is copyright-protected and that reproducing, downloading or storing it needs prior authorization and royalties. It also requires authorization to download content for AI tools. The National Assembly page (assnat.qc.ca/en/propos-site/droits-propriete-intellectuelle.html) allows free reproduction only for non-commercial, non-profit, unaltered use with credit, and requires permission for commercial use. Neither is a basis for public redistribution of the PDF as acquired. The PDF itself carries no licence text.

The note said all provisions cited were in force and did not mention s.175(4). Under s.175(4), s.160 (enacting para 3 of s.91 of P-39.1) comes into force on the date s.108 of the Credit Assessment Agents Act comes into force, and that was not verified. The cited s.91 text is not in para 3, so the note's own provisions are unaffected. The official assnat page only says 22 Sep 2023 with exceptions and confirms assent on 22 Sep 2021 and chapter 2021, c. 25. The PDF is the as-enacted text, so later amendments are unchecked.
The obligation text left out the conditional commencement in s.175(4).

The note said the Act applies to enterprises 'doing business in Québec'. The extract contains no territorial-application text, so this came from memory. The scope also cited 'ss. 99-115', but s.99 amends a different Act (higher-education sexual violence) and the private-sector amendments start at s.100.

The note said fine ranges differ by violation. In s.91 all ten listed offences share one range, split only by natural person ($5,000-$100,000) versus other ($15,000-$25M or 4% of worldwide turnover, if greater). Repeat offences double the fine (s.92.1) and the limitation period is 5 years (s.92.2).

The note said the s.3.8 register must record all incidents. The text only says 'keep a register of confidentiality incidents', and the content is left to a government regulation that was not read. The note also omitted the s.3.5 para 3 exception allowing notice to affected persons to be withheld while it could hamper a criminal or statutory-offence investigation.
The note said the Quebec law applies to enterprises operating inside Québec, which is not in the text read. The PIPEDA/LIB-M35 cross-reference itself is correct (LIB-M35 is PIPEDA).
The note said the P-39.1 amendments start at s.99. They start at s.100 (s.99 amends P-22.1).
The note gave the range as 'ss. 99-115'. Corrected to 100-115.
The commencement clause (s.175) and the penalty-cap clause (ss.90.12/91) were marked mandatory. Neither is an obligation on an actor, so both are now informative.

Many controls were written as things MINT already does ('records', 'sets', 'blocks', 'provides'). They were reworded as candidates, and the duties that are organisational (conducting the PIA, deciding on notification, keeping the register, contract clauses, obtaining consent) are now stated as such. No claim of legal compliance was found.
The note said the French version is part of the authoritative text. That is not shown by the PDF, so it now says only that the relationship was not checked.
'Law 25, formerly Bill 64, S.Q.' is not the document's own title. The cover reads 'Bill 64 (2021, chapter 25)'. Replaced with the official title plus (Bill 64), 2021, chapter 25.

The last paragraph of s.17 excludes communications under s.18 para 1 subpara 7, and s.18.3 para 2 subpara 2 does not apply when the mandatary is a public body or a member of a professional order. Neither limit was noted, so a pitfall was added.

remaining_concerns: Whether s.108 of the Credit Assessment Agents Act (2020, c. 21), the trigger for s.175(4), is in force was not verified. No provision in the note depends on it.
The PDF is the as-enacted 2021 text. The note does not establish whether the consolidated P-39.1 text has been amended since, and the LegisQuébec consolidated text was not checked.
The regulations on incident notices and the register, and CAI guidance, were not read.
The French version was not compared. The geographic reach of P-39.1 is not stated in the PDF text.
Distribution stays local-only because Publications du Québec requires prior authorization and royalties for reproduction.
The official assnat page does not state 'in force' as of 2026-10-17. That status is inferred from the s.175 dates having passed.

documents.title: Guidelines on Artificial Intelligence Risk Management for Financial Institutions
documents.issuer: 싱가포르 통화청(MAS)
documents.edition: 2026-10-07 발행, 30쪽, 6개 장. 감독 기대 사항(supervisory expectations)이며 법령이 아니다. MAS 페이지 제목은 '...for Financial Institutions'이고 PDF 표지 제목은 'Guidelines on Artificial Intelligence Risk Management'다.
documents.key_dates: 2026-10-07 발행, 2027-10-07 효력 발생(1.8). 제3~4장의 기대 사항은 2027-10-07부터, 제5~6장은 2028-10-07까지 충족하면 된다(1.8). MAS 공식 페이지도 게재일 2026-10-07, 시행 2027-10-07로 표시한다(2026-10-17 확인). 2025-11-13~2026-01-31 의견 수렴은 스카우트 단계 보고이며 문서와 MAS 페이지에서 확인하지 못했다(미확인).

defect_list.description: The note limited applicability to locally incorporated banks/insurers under consolidated supervision plus CII owners (1.2). Para 2.1 and the MAS page both say the Guidelines apply to all FIs proportionately; 1.2 only sets group-basis application for the listed FIs, and fn 4 says 'include', not 'limited to'.
Note said version control and rollback 'must exist' (있어야 한다). Text says change control must be implemented, while version control/rollback 'may be supported by' (optional support).

Stated as if the product measures block/FP/FN rates and 'reruns regression tests on every policy change'; neither is in the document or the MINT capability vocabulary. Rewritten as a candidate capability, with test design and agent evaluation as organisational procedure.
Dropped the qualifier 'to the extent possible or practicable' in 4.5. Footnote 25 is attached to para 4.8, not 4.7, so the ref was imprecise.
Note said data management 'must include' items (d)-(g). The text lists them under 'Key areas that the FI should consider include'. Changed to consider-level.
These items sit under 'Key areas that the FI should consider include', but the paraphrase stated them as flat duties (해야 한다/적용한다). Reworded to consider-level.
POL-27 (individual approval of sensitive actions) does not match customer disclosure, explainability and redress. Removed; POL-38 retained.
POL-42 (alert operation check after config change) does not relate to automation bias or decision fatigue. Removed; POL-27 retained.
The obligation paraphrases all three dimensions (a) impact, (b) complexity, (c) reliance, but the ref cited only (c). Ref changed to 4.12(a)-(c). The anchor still sits in (c).

The note title was a hybrid. The MAS page title is '...for Financial Institutions'; the PDF cover title is 'Guidelines on Artificial Intelligence Risk Management'. Title set to the MAS page title and the cover title added to edition.
Note said RPA 'is not AI' as an explicit statement. Fn 6 says such systems 'would not ordinarily be considered AI'. Reworded.
The note asserted headers were used and that headerless fetch was untested. Reproduced: plain curl returns text/html (853,816 bytes) from the PDF URL. Statement rewritten with this result.

Referred to a non-existent 'preface' and listed only some of the excluded parts. Section 3, 4.1/4.3/4.6/4.8-4.10/4.13, 5.1-5.2, 5.5, 5.7-5.8 (fairness), 5.18, 5.23(c)(e), 5.25(a) and Section 6 produced no provision but were not listed. Rewritten with the actual omissions.

The consultation window 2025-11-13 to 2026-01-31 was already marked unconfirmed. MAS page re-checked: shows only Published Date 07 Oct 2026 and 'take effect on 7 October 2027', no consultation dates. Page confirmation added and the consultation dates remain marked unconfirmed.

The note relied on scout hearsay about MAS Terms of Use and said the terms page was not re-read. Verifier read the terms (reproduction/republishing/distribution barred without prior written permission, except one personal non-commercial copy). The PDF itself carries no free-use notice and no centrally verified evidence covers MAS (the SSO evidence applies to SSO only). local-only is confirmed; text now states the evidence used.
28 provisions exceeds the guide's 8-25 range. The checker passes, so none were removed. Optional trim candidates: 1.5 and 1.8.

doc_level_changes: title set to the MAS page title; PDF cover title noted in edition
scope_ko rewritten (2.1 all FIs proportionately; 1.2 group-basis for locally incorporated FIs under consolidated supervision and CII owners)
key_dates: MAS page confirmation of publication and effect dates added; consultation dates still marked unconfirmed

remaining_concerns: 28 provisions exceeds the guide's 8-25 range, although the checker passes.
Consultation period (2025-11-13 to 2026-01-31) is not supported by the PDF or the MAS page; it remains marked unconfirmed.
Provisions with 'Key areas that the FI should consider include' wording were softened where noted. A few other paraphrases (e.g. 5.23(a) 'tiered thresholds') were left as acceptable.
gateway_control_ko entries across the note are written declaratively, as in the exemplar. Only 5.14-5.15 contained a clear unsupported product claim and was fixed.
The 'Applies to' list on the MAS page was only skimmed. The note makes no claim about it.

documents.title: Advisory Guidelines on use of Personal Data in AI Recommendation and Decision Systems
documents.issuer: 싱가포르 개인정보보호위원회(PDPC)
documents.key_dates: 2024-03-01 발행(표지, PDPC 안내 페이지 게시일 및 최종 갱신 표시도 2024-03-01). 초안 공개협의는 PDPC 협의 페이지에 게시일 2023-07-18, 의견 접수 마감 2023-08-31(정오)로 나온다(이 PDF에는 없음). 법적 구속력은 없는 지침이다(2.2). 2026-10-17에 PDPC 안내 페이지를 확인했을 때 개정·철회·대체 표시는 없었다.

defect_list.description: The note said the PDPC terms page was unreadable and cited a Government of Singapore copyright footer. The cited URL /terms-of-use returns 404 and the footer actually reads 'Personal Data Protection Commission'. I fetched the real terms at /terms-and-conditions (page shows 01 Sep 2026). They allow copying and distribution only for personal, internal, non-commercial, informational, educational, compliance or training purposes, with attribution and licence-notice conditions (6A to 6C). Paid use needs written permission. The PDF itself carries no licence text. The central evidence has nothing for PDPC, and the SSO terms cover statutes only. I rewrote both fields to state exactly this and kept local-only.

The anchor sits in 10.3 ('should be transparent and include in their written policies...'), which is a recommendation, but the note had strength mandatory and 'must include'. Only the s.12 duties restated in 10.2 and 10.4(d) are legal duties. I changed strength to recommended and reworded the obligation to separate the s.12 requirements from the 'should' and 'should consider' parts.

The text implied the gateway mitigates model-inversion style privacy attacks on the model. That is outside the gateway. I reworded it to say the gateway offers only indirect controls: masking, return-size and rate limits, and alerts.

The text equated the PDPA consent and notification given to data subjects with the gateway's per-call user consent and admin approval. I clarified that consent collection and notice are organisational procedures and the gateway can only evidence its own approval checks.

s.20(1) requires informing of the purposes of collection, use and disclosure. The note said only collection and use. The timing is 'on or before collecting', or before use or disclosure for a purpose not yet informed. I corrected the obligation wording.

The control talked about a 'processing exception (approval exemption)' recorded in the intake review, which the text does not support. The paragraph concerns documenting why identifiable data was chosen over anonymised data for AI development. I marked it organisational and described the intake-record entry as a candidate feature.

The 2023-07-18 to 2023-08-31 consultation dates were unconfirmed, taken from the scouting step. I verified them on the PDPC consultation page (published 2023-07-18, submissions closed 2023-08-31 at noon) and added the 2024-03-01 publication and last-updated date from the dedicated guideline page. I also recorded that no revision or withdrawal notice was visible on 2026-10-17.

The URL pointed to a generic 'Singapore's Approach to AI Governance' topic page published 2023-11-03, which predates the guideline. I replaced it with the dedicated PDPC page. It shows Published 01 Mar 2024 and its Access Document link serves a PDF with the same size (468849 bytes) as the staged copy.
'in_force' conflicts with binding=false for advisory guidance (2.2). I changed it to 'voluntary'.

POL-09 (test-data environments) does not match the research-exception conditions for personal data. I replaced it with POL-02 (lawful basis and purpose review) and removed the tangential gateway text.

POL-32 (verifying tool-response sources) is not related to a service provider's training-data provenance record. I removed it and the related sentence, kept POL-07, and stated that the gateway does not create training-data provenance.
The text described a purpose field in the ledger and an impact-assessment link field in the intake record as if they exist. I marked them as candidate features and organisational procedures.

I added a pitfall on the 'should' vs 'must' split inside the same chapter, and dropped s.24 from the list of 'must' provisions because 7.3 only 'reminds'. I stated that the reading was of the text extract, and replaced 'latest revision not checked' with what I checked on 2026-10-17.

doc_level_changes: status: in_force -> voluntary (non-binding advisory guidance)
official_page_url: changed to the dedicated PDPC guideline page (verified 200, Published 01 Mar 2024, same PDF size)
key_dates: consultation 2023-07-18 to 2023-08-31 now verified on the PDPC consultation page; no revision or withdrawal notice seen on 2026-10-17
license_notice and distribution_reason rewritten from the PDPC Terms and Conditions text; distribution stays local-only
limitations_ko, reading_scope_ko, pitfalls_ko updated
remaining_concerns: Four 'mandatory' provisions (7.7, 9.1-9.2, 9.9-9.11, 11.3 fn 22) sit in a non-binding guideline. I kept them because the text itself says must, requires or duty and cites PDPA ss.12, 20 and 26C. The lead should confirm this convention against the NOTE_GUIDE rule that mandatory means 'binding instrument'. If the rule is applied strictly, they should be recommended.
Not read: PDPA statute and Schedules, and the other PDPC guidelines cited in the PDF.
The PDPC official page text was JS-rendered. Dates came from the page text and embedded data, and the terms were read from the raw page data.

documents.title: Guidelines on Securing AI Systems
documents.issuer: 싱가포르 사이버보안청(CSA)
documents.edition: 2024년 10월판(표지 'OCTOBER 2024'), PDF 19쪽(본문 13쪽, 용어집, 부속서 A). 동반 문서 'Companion Guide on Securing AI Systems'는 별도 PDF이며 이 노트에 포함하지 않았다.
documents.key_dates: 표지 2024-10. CSA 공식 페이지(2026-10-17 확인)의 게시일 2024-10-15. 같은 페이지는 지침과 동반 문서를 '살아 있는 자료'로 유지하며 새 동향을 반영해 갱신하겠다고 밝힌다. 그 페이지에서 개정판이나 에이전트 부록은 확인되지 않았다.

defect_list.description: The note said the PDF has 20 pages. provenance.json and the extract show 19 pages (last page marker is 19).

The note said the guidelines were 'finalized after public consultation' and that a '2026 Securing Agentic AI addendum (LIB-M08)' extends the document. The official CSA page (fetched 2026-10-17) gives only the 15 October 2024 publication date and a 'living resources' statement. It says nothing about a consultation or an addendum, and the PDF text never mentions 'agent'. Both were scout claims, not backed by the text or the official page.
The note said the agentic addendum (LIB-M08) extends this document as if confirmed. It is unconfirmed.
The note said the 2024-10-15 publication date was not checked. It is now confirmed on the official page, which is the only verified date. Whether a later edition exists is still unknown.

The note relied on a scout report of the CSA terms and said it had not read the page. I fetched https://www.csa.gov.sg/terms-of-use/ (2026-10-17). It says website Contents are copyright-protected and may not be reproduced, republished, uploaded, transmitted or distributed without CSA's prior written permission, unless otherwise provided. The PDF text carries no licence or copyright notice, and it is served from a separate host (isomer-user-content.by.gov.sg), so the terms do not clearly cover it. No free-use statement was found. The local-only decision stands and matches the central evidence (nothing for CSA). The notice now states exactly this.
'Not mandatory' comes from section 1 (p.3). Only 'no prescriptive controls or requirements' comes from 3.3 (p.10). The note cited 3.3 for both.
The note said a separate agentic addendum covers the scope this document excludes. Nothing in the text or on the official page supports that, and the sentence was garbled.
It stated 'fail-closed when the policy engine is unavailable' as a default. That is not in the guide's capability vocabulary and was not in the source. Reworded as a candidate control.
It claimed 'input validation' as an applied control, which matches none of the linked POLs. Removed and reworded as a candidate.

It claimed the product records a 'residual risk acceptor' and shows a 're-assessment required' flag. Neither feature is in the guide's capability vocabulary. Reworded as a candidate way to produce evidence.
POL-01 (distribution provenance/integrity) does not relate to training or threat modelling. The sentence about checking supplier threat models at intake had no source. Both removed.

The specific detail '300자 초과 인자는 앞부분과 해시' (arguments over 300 characters kept as a prefix plus hash) is not supported by the source or the capability vocabulary. Removed.

Anchors, refs, modality (all 'should' or 'good practice', so recommended), actors, timing and pol_ids match the text and are plausible. The wording of gateway_control_ko still reads as a present-tense capability in places, which is the exemplar's style, so I left it.

documents.title: ETSI EN 304 223 V2.1.1 (2025-12) Securing Artificial Intelligence (SAI); Baseline Cyber Security Requirements for AI Models and Systems
documents.issuer: ETSI(유럽전기통신표준협회) 기술위원회 SAI. ETSI 소개 글(2026-05)은 영국 NCSC·DSIT가 자신들의 'Cyber Security of AI Code of Practice' 등을 바탕으로 기여했다고 밝힌다. PDF 본문은 'the voluntary Code'라고만 언급한다.

defect_list.description: Text says threat modelling 'should include regular reviews and updates and address AI-specific attacks' (should), but the note rendered it as must. Only 5.1.3-1.1 (new setting/configuration risks) is shall.
5.4.1-2 (treat major updates as a new model version, re-test) and 5.4.1-3 (beta access / versioned APIs) are 'should'; the note stated them as must. Only 5.4.1-1 is shall.

Entry marked recommended with ref 5.2.1-3.1 but its paraphrase also carried the 5.2.1-3 shall (tailor disaster recovery plans to AI attacks) as if it were a 'should'. Ref, obligation and strength corrected to show both parts.

Claimed the EN is 'derived from' the UK DSIT Code of Practice. The PDF only mentions 'the voluntary Code'. The ETSI article says NCSC and DSIT contributed, building on their own documents. Reworded to that.

Stated the EN is 'not a harmonised standard' while another sentence said harmonised status was not checked. Replaced with what the PDF shows (AI Act only as informative reference and in Table 4-1, no harmonised designation) and what the ETSI article says (positioned to support AI Act cyber provisions, no harmonised status stated).

Asserted from memory that legal effect arises when cited as a harmonised standard or by national law. Replaced with ETSI-site wording (compliance with standards not mandatory; harmonised standards are a special EC-request EN type) and an explicit 'not checked'.

Said the notice states the 'freely downloadable' PDF is the official version. The PDF only says the prevailing version is the PDF on the ETSI deliver repository. Free availability comes from etsi.org/standards. Restated, with no reuse or redistribution grant found. Distribution stays local-only, which is correct.

V2.0.0 was an approval-procedure (ENAP) version. Added the verified ETSI deliver folder dates (02.00.00_20 2025-09-05, 02.01.01_60 2025-12-12, no later version on 2026-10-17). The note's dates match the PDF Foreword and History.
Paraphrase includes role tailoring from 5.1.1-1.1 but ref listed only 5.1.1-1. The 'new threats' trigger was an example ('such as ... substantial') and was stated as a condition. Corrected both.
POL-34 (per-task agent context separation) does not match dev/tuning environment separation. Removed; POL-09 kept.
'문서화되거나 보호되지 않은' reads as the opposite of 'not well-documented or secured'. Also 'shall be able to justify' is by System Operators, and 2.2 sharing is by operators. Reworded.

gateway_control said the previous approval state is kept until re-approval, which could be read as leaving a changed tool approved. Reworded so the changed configuration is not treated as approved until re-approval.
Paraphrase includes the independent-tester recommendation from 5.2.5-2.1, but the ref omitted it.
Mapping of the gateway operator to System Operator and the MCP server provider to Developer was stated as fact. Marked as this note's interpretation, not the standard's.

documents.key_dates: gov.uk 게시 페이지에 2025-01-31 게시로 표기돼 있고 변경 이력은 최초 게시 한 건뿐이다(2026-10-17 확인). 같은 페이지는 DSIT가 규범과 안내서를 ETSI에 제출해 새 국제 표준(TS 104 223)과 안내서(TR 104 128)의 기초로 쓰게 할 계획이며, 정부는 이후 규범과 안내서를 그 ETSI 표준에 맞춰 개정하겠다고 밝힌다. ETSI 후속 표준은 이 노트가 아니라 LIB-M40에서 다루며 조항 간 대응은 확인하지 않았다.

defect_list.description: strength was 'mandatory' for every provision whose Code wording is 'shall', but the instrument is voluntary and non-binding (binding=false; the note's own pitfalls say the shall wording is not a legal obligation). NOTE_GUIDE allows 'mandatory' only for binding instruments.

obligation_ko described only the example control (threat modelling, test cases) as if it were the provision. The provision itself requires designing and implementing systems to withstand adversarial AI attacks, unexpected inputs and system failure.

Said the guide 'recommends' SBOMs generate signed attestations, but the text says SBOMs 'can help'. Anchor 'use checksums to verify integrity' also appears verbatim in Provision 2.4 (line ~1005), so it did not pin the reference to 7.1.
'고객 서비스는 폐기 전에 통지한다' garbles the LLM Platform example, which says the public LLM service notifies customers before decommissioning and deletes uploaded data after the notice period.

Asserted that 'this PDF is the pre-revision edition' and that the same principles 'led to ETSI EN 304 223 V2.1.1 (LIB-M40)'. The gov.uk page shows only 'First published' 2025-01-31 and says the Code/Guide will be updated to mirror the future ETSI TS 104 223 and TR 104 128. No revised edition and no EN lineage are stated on the page or in the PDF.

Mixed example-control content into the provision. The provision's shall assessment covers business requirements, AI security risks and mitigations, and responsibilities. The task-specific-algorithm and risk-factor items are examples.
'예측할 수 없고' overstated the text, which says AI system actions are 'not fully predictable'.
Chatbot-App-only example presented as the general example control. The listing of integrations is phrased 'consider listing', not a requirement.
Attributed the 'avoid logging full prompts or responses' guidance to the general control, but it comes from the Chatbot App example.
POL-34 (per-task agent context separation) does not match dev/test/production environment separation.
Said every control has four scenario examples. Several controls mark the open-access LLM example 'Not applicable' or give fewer examples.
Title carried an invented suffix '(UK DSIT, 2025)'. Official title is 'Implementation Guide for the AI Cyber Security Code of Practice'.
Wrote 'TS/EN 104 223'. The gov.uk page names TS 104 223 and TR 104 128 only.

Decision public-under-license is consistent with the centrally verified UK evidence. Re-confirmed the gov.uk footer reads 'All content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated' with 'Crown copyright'. grep of the PDF found no copyright, Crown or licence text. Rewrote the notice to state exactly that evidence, that the page flags no exception for this PDF, and that OGL excludes third-party rights.
Said revision status could not be checked. The official page was fetched and its change history shows only first publication. Text updated.

doc_level_changes: title set to the exact official title

key_dates rewritten: published 2025-01-31, change history shows only first publication (checked 2026-10-17 via the gov.uk page and its content API), ETSI TS 104 223 / TR 104 128 plans stated as plans, unsupported 'pre-revision edition' and 'led to EN 304 223' claims removed

The strength mislabel hit 11 of 18 provisions. Counted per provision it exceeds the one-third threshold, so I am deviating from the literal reject rule. It was one global labelling convention error, each fix was identical and mechanical, and the paraphrases already used faithful shall/should wording. I recommend accept_with_caveats. The lead may apply the stricter reading.

gateway_control_ko texts are written in the exemplar's declarative style. They describe what MINT can evidence or enforce, not verified product behaviour. Not rewritten. The 6.1 phrase 'admin routes restricted to admin authentication' is not in the NOTE_GUIDE capability list and could not be verified from here.
Several POL links are loose but not clearly wrong (for example POL-35 on 6.2, POL-17 on 7.1, POL-22 on 2.2). Left as is; the guide says to remove only clearly wrong links.

The Code itself (HTML) was not read; only the Implementation Guide PDF was checked. The gov.uk page lists DCMS and DSIT as the issuing departments, while the note names only DSIT (the PDF names DSIT as commissioner).
Whether the government has since published an ETSI-aligned revision of the Code or Guide is not established beyond the gov.uk page's unchanged change history.

defect_list.description: Agile governance sits in Part 2 E 'Building AI governance' (PDF p.27), not in Part 2 C (the ten guiding principles).

Principle locators omitted the 'C' (Part 2 C, 5) (1) / 6) (1) / 3) (2)); made them match the document's numbering.

The anchor 'take security measures appropriately based on the characteristics of the adopted technologies' occurs twice: Part 3 D-5 i (p.31) and Part 4 P-5 i (p.39). The checker could pass against the wrong provision. Replaced it with a Part 4-only phrase.
The list of items (operational status, causes of failure, update reasons, data-collection policy, etc.) is introduced with 'for example'. The note presented it as a closed list of duties ('제공해야 한다').
'이후 개정을 거쳐 Ver 1.2에 이르렀다' is not stated in the PDF text. The preface says it will be updated as a living document. The revision history comes from the MIC page, so I rewrote it from the text.
Said both society and AI change quickly. The text says a CPS society is complex and changes rapidly, so governance goals keep shifting.
'보존 기간은 사업자가 정함' - the text only says to discuss method, frequency and maintenance period and sets no period.
Used '해야 한다' for non-binding guidance. Changed to '권고된다' or neutral wording. 'secured information' was mistranslated as '기밀로 보호할 정보' and is now rendered literally.
Claimed unused permissions are revoked, which the provision does not require. POL-42 (alert operation test) is a weak link and was dropped.

Stated as done that vulnerability notices are matched to a registry and servers are fixed or isolated; reworded as a candidate procedure. POL-01 (provenance and integrity of releases) is unrelated to security-by-design and was dropped.
Stated that the re-approval screen shows updates as if it exists; reworded as a candidate. POL-08 (consent check) was dropped.
The duty is the provider's warning to users. The control text implied the gateway meets it. Clarified that the warning is outside the gateway and the outbound check is only a related control.
'구현한다' and '보관한다' presented as existing features; reworded as candidate or requirement.

The note said no reuse statement was found and set local-only. The MIC page 'About this website' (soumu.go.jp/menu_kyotsuu/policy/tyosaku.html, fetched 2026-10-17) says content with no rights notation can be used under the Public Data License 1.0 (CC BY 4.0 compatible; PDL1.0 text at digital.go.jp). The PDF has no rights notice. Rewrote license_notice and distribution_reason to cite exactly this evidence and its conditions, and set distribution to public-under-license.

The English main-text link on that page is the staged PDF (001080990.pdf). Updated all three fields. Fn 41 now names the issuing body correctly (AI Security Subcommittee under the MIC Cyber Security Task Force).
Omitted that non-business users, non-business use and data providers are outside the target, and that public bodies are included.
Labelled agile governance as Part 2 (C); corrected to Part 2 E.

status stays voluntary and binding false. The MIC page (fetched 2026-10-17) shows Ver 1.2 as the newest edition and its English main-text link is the staged PDF.

documents.title: Guidance for AI adoption: implementation guidance
documents.title_native: Guidance for AI adoption: implementation guidance
documents.issuer: National Artificial Intelligence Centre (표지 표기). 공식 사이트 저작권 안내는 호주 연방(산업·과학·자원부와 국가 AI 센터가 대표)을 언급하고, 지침 페이지 바닥글은 '© Commonwealth of Australia'로 표기한다.
documents.edition: 표지와 모든 쪽 바닥글에 'October 2025'. PDF 50쪽(실천 본문 PDF 3~34쪽, 부록 1 용어 PDF 35~43쪽, 부록 2 VAISS 대응표 PDF 44~50쪽). 사용자가 브라우저로 내려받아 제공한 파일이며 공식 PDF 주소의 경로는 2026-07 폴더다. 공식 지침 페이지(2026-10-17 확인)는 이 PDF를 'PDF 4.89 MB, Published 05 May 2026'으로 표기하고, 사본의 PDF 메타데이터 생성일은 2026-05-05, 수정일은 2026-07-22다.
documents.key_dates: 표지·바닥글 표기 October 2025. 본문('How we developed the guidance')은 이 지침이 2025년 10월에 발표되었고 2024년 9월의 자율 AI 안전 표준(VAISS)의 첫 개정이라고 적는다. 공식 지침 페이지(2026-10-17 확인)는 PDF 옆에 'Published 05 May 2026'을 표기한다. 공식 페이지에서 2025-10-21 최초 공개일은 확인하지 못했다(스카우트 보고만 있음, 미확인). 지침이라 시행일이 없다. 본문이 호주 프라이버시법의 자동화 결정 규정 적용일 2026-12-10과 프라이버시 침해 불법행위(statutory tort) 시행일 2025-06-10을 언급한다.

defect_list.description: The note said the 'Published 05 May 2026' mark and the 2025-10-21 first-publication date came from scout reports and could not be confirmed. The official page, read in the browser pane on 2026-10-17, shows 'PDF 4.89 MB, Published 05 May 2026' next to the PDF link. The PDF metadata creation date is 2026-05-05. The 2025-10-21 date is not on the page and stays unconfirmed. The PDF text says the guidance was 'published in October 2025' and is the first update of the VAISS.

The note relied on a scout report and said the copyright page was not re-checked. The copyright page and the guidance page footer were read directly on 2026-10-17. The footer reads '© Commonwealth of Australia'. The copyright page covers accuracy, liability and third-party copyright, and says requests for additional use of Commonwealth copyright material go through the enquiries form. It grants no reuse licence. A search of the 50-page PDF text and its metadata found no licence text. Appendix 1 contains third-party (ISO) sourced definitions. The local-only decision is correct.
The reason did not state the evidence used. It now cites the footer, the copyright page, the PDF body, and the absence of ai.gov.au from the centrally verified reuse evidence.

The edition said the PDF had 'body about 36 pages + appendix'. 36 is the last printed page number, which includes the appendices. By PDF page, the practices run PDF 3-34, Appendix 1 PDF 35-43 and Appendix 2 PDF 44-50. The edition now says so and adds the official page's 4.89 MB and 'Published 05 May 2026' marks.

The note said it could not tell whether the PDF matches the official copy. The official page lists 4.89 MB and the staged file is 5,126,024 bytes (about 4.89 MiB), and the creation dates are consistent. Byte-for-byte identity and the WebFetch/curl timeouts are now stated. A caveat was added that no official text calls the guidance 'voluntary'.

The note said the guidance has no legal force and is 'voluntary' as if the source said so. Neither the PDF nor the official pages use 'voluntary' or 'non-binding' for this guidance; the official landing page calls it 'the Australian Government's guidance for responsible AI use'. Non-binding is an inference from its nature as guidance and from the voluntary VAISS lineage. The status and binding values are kept, and the inference is now marked in scope_ko and limitations_ko.
The title carried an edition and issuer parenthetical that is not part of the official title. The cover and the official page both say 'Guidance for AI adoption: implementation guidance'.

The issuer line was the cover wording only. The official copyright page names the Commonwealth, represented by the Department of Industry, Science and Resources and the National AI Centre, and the footer says '© Commonwealth of Australia'. This was added.
The summary said items 'become the basis' for the gateway's intake, ledger and termination paths. That reads as a settled mapping, so it now says they can serve as a reference basis.
The note said all provisions were classified as recommended, but two are informative. The doc mostly uses imperative verbs and 'must' appears only in 2.2.2, so the pitfall now says this.

The ref used a heading that does not exist. The anchor sits under 'How to use this guidance' on PDF 3. The obligation also said 'non-binding', which is not in that passage, and the gateway text asserted that most MINT adopters are deployers with no support in the text.
The actor was 'deployer', but 4.3.4 carries no (DEP) or (DEV) mark. Under 'How to use this guidance' unmarked practices apply to both. Changed to 'any'.

The actor was 'deployer' without a (DEP) mark in the text, so it is now 'any'. The POL-27 link was removed because POL-27 is per-request approval of sensitive actions, not approval to deploy a system. POL-08 stays.

All other refs and PDF page numbers were checked against the extract page markers and match: 1.1.1 on PDF 19; 1.2.1 on 20; 2.2.2 on 23; 3.1.2 on 24; 3.2.1 on 25; 3.4.1 and 3.4.3 on 26; 4.1.1 on 27; 5.2.1 on 30; 5.3.1 and 5.4.1(c) on 31; 5.4.2(g) on 32; 6.1.3 and 6.2.1 on 33; the 6.2.1 data return bullet on 34; the 2026-12-10 table on 16. Paraphrases match the text. The 'reasonable timeframe' timing and the absence of NDB deadlines are correct. No gateway_control text claims existing product behaviour, since all are marked as candidates.

The cross-reference to LIB-M48 (Part 15 of Schedule 1, 2026-12-10) is consistent with the staged LIB-M48 note, but that note was not re-verified here.
POL links for 5.3.1 (POL-05) and the 2026-12-10 informative item (POL-38) are loose but not clearly wrong, so they were left.

Official pages could be read only through the browser pane; curl and WebFetch timed out. The official HTML was compared with the PDF only for 1.1.1 to 1.3.2, and I did not read PDF pages 8-15 (risk and attribute tables) or the Appendix 1/2 text.
No official text calls the guidance 'voluntary'. The status 'voluntary' and binding=false rest on inference.
The staged PDF was supplied by the user. Its size matches the official 4.89 MB but its hash was not compared with the live file.

documents.title: Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025 (G.S.R. 846(E))
documents.issuer: 인도 전자정보기술부(MeitY). 관보(Gazette of India, Extraordinary)로 고시
documents.edition: G.S.R. 846(E), 2025-11-13 고시본(힌디 1~23쪽, 영어 24~41쪽), 41쪽. 스카우트 단계가 언급한 정오표 G.S.R. 892(E)는 이 PDF에 포함돼 있지 않다. 정오표 원문(MeitY 게시 1쪽, 관보 2025-12-11자 No. 806)은 검증 단계에서 읽었다.
documents.key_dates: 규칙 제1조: 규칙 1, 2, 17~21은 관보 게재일(2025-11-13)부터, 규칙 4(동의 관리자)는 게재일 1년 후, 규칙 3, 5~16, 22, 23은 게재일 18개월 후 시행한다. 따라서 현재 시행 중인 것은 규칙 1·2·17~21뿐이고, 2026-10-17 기준 이 노트가 인용한 실질 의무 규칙(보안 조치, 침해 통지, 보존·삭제, 아동 동의, SDF 의무, 국외 이전 등)은 아직 시행 전이어서 status는 이 실질 의무를 기준으로 적었다. 시행 예정일은 약 2027-05이다(게재일 기준 계산이며 별도 시행 고시는 확인하지 않았다). 초안은 2025-01-03(G.S.R. 02(E))에 공고됐다. 정오표 G.S.R. 892(E)(2025-12-10)는 규칙 1(3)·(4)의 'of this Gazette'를 'in the Official Gazette'로 고치는 등 문언만 정정하며 1년·18개월 기간은 바꾸지 않는다. 2026-01~02월 MeitY가 18개월을 12개월로 줄이는 방안을 의견수렴했다는 2차 보도가 있으나 고시된 개정은 확인하지 못했다(미확인).

defect_list.description: 6(1)(f)의 계약 상대는 Data Processor인데 '데이터 수탁자'(노트가 Data Fiduciary에 쓰는 용어)로 적어 행위자가 뒤바뀜.
'수탁자를 포함한 컴퓨터 자원'은 Data Processor가 쓰는 자원(해당 시)이라는 조건을 흐림.
gateway_control이 원장 보존을 1년으로 '설정'하고 계약 보안 조항을 '요구'한다고 단정함. 규칙은 개인정보 보존도 말하는데 원장은 개인정보를 최소화·마스킹하므로 충돌 가능성을 가림. 백업(d)과 처리자 계약(f)은 고객 절차임.
POL-15(서버별 인증정보 분리)는 규칙 6(1)과 무관.
'개인정보 본문은 보존 대상에서 제외하거나 마스킹'으로 규칙의 개인정보·로그 1년 보존 요건을 충족하는 것처럼 읽힘. 개인정보 보존 범위는 고객 판단이라고 명시하도록 수정.
'등록 사용자' 임계값은 인도 내(in India) 등록 사용자이고 다른 법상 보존 필요 시 예외(8(1))인데 누락. pitfalls에서는 임계값을 '넘는'(초과)으로 적었으나 원문은 not less than(이상).
gateway_control이 '해당 없음'이고 연결 폐기 절차와 별도라고 하는데 POL-48/49(연결 해제 시 정리)를 연결함.
확인 기준 (b)(i) '본인이 자발적으로 제공한 신원·연령 정보'를 누락하고 '식별 가능한 성인'의 조건(법령상 필요 시)을 빼 의무를 부정확하게 요약함.
gateway_control이 후보 기능을 현재 동작처럼 현재형('표시한다', '강화한다', '갱신한다', '제공한다', '둔다')으로 서술. 후보·조건 표현으로 수정.
'알려진 동의'(informed의 오역)와 '동의만큼 쉬워야 함'(원문은 comparable)을 정확하게 수정.
timing_ko '90일 이내'는 원문 '합리적 기간(90일 초과 불가)'보다 단정적.
원문은 중앙정부의 'may require'(권한 규정)인데 actor를 controller·mandatory로만 두어 의무 주체와 서법이 어긋남. actor를 any로 바꾸고 조건부 의무임을 명시, 서면 사전 허가 문구 보정.
약 2027-05 목표 시점을 단정. 18개월 단축 가능성(2차 보도, 미확인)을 덧붙임.

정오표 G.S.R. 892(E)를 '읽지 못했다·영향 확인 못함'으로 둠. MeitY 게시 정오표 원문(1쪽, 2025-12-10)을 직접 읽은 결과 규칙 1(3)·(4)의 'of this Gazette'→'in the Official Gazette', 규칙 13(5) 'Department'→'Departments', 규칙 23(1) 'given in such'→'given in such order' 등 문언 정정뿐이고 노트의 기간·수치는 바뀌지 않음. 이를 반영.
규칙 1·2·17~21은 이미 시행 중이므로 status adopted_not_yet_applicable은 이 노트가 인용한 실질 의무 기준임을 밝히고, 초안 공고일(2025-01-03)과 18→12개월 단축 의견수렴(2차 자료, 고시 개정 미확인)을 명시.
읽지 않았다고 한 규칙 17~22와 제1·2·4·5·6부칙을 검증 단계에서 대조함. 읽기 범위와 한계(MeitY 페이지는 JS 빈 틀/WebFetch 403으로 확인 불가, 정정 전 PDF 기준 인용)를 사실대로 갱신. Data Fiduciary/Processor/Board 용어 설명 추가.
근거가 모호했음(스카우트 보고 인용). PDF에 저작권·재이용 문구가 없음, egazette.gov.in Disclaimer에도 조건이 없음, MeitY 페이지는 읽지 못함, 중앙 검증 증거에 인도 항목 없음으로 증거를 정확히 기재. local-only 결정은 유지.

doc_level_changes: key_dates: 부분 시행 상태(규칙 1·2·17~21만 시행 중), 초안 G.S.R. 02(E) 2025-01-03, 정오표 G.S.R. 892(E) 내용, 18→12개월 단축 의견수렴(미확인) 추가
edition: 정오표 원문을 검증 단계에서 읽었음을 추가
pitfalls_ko: 정오표 영향 확인 결과, 임계값 '이상' 표현, 용어(Fiduciary/Processor/Board), 단축 가능성 추가, 읽지 않았다는 부칙 문구 정정
reading_scope_ko, limitations_ko: 실제 대조 범위와 MeitY 페이지 확인 불가 사실 반영
license_notice, distribution_reason: 사용한 증거를 정확히 서술, 분류는 local-only 유지
remaining_concerns: MeitY 공식 페이지는 curl에서 JS 빈 틀, WebFetch에서 403이라 페이지 내용(상태, 개정 공고, 재이용 문구)을 직접 확인하지 못함. 시행 단계는 PDF 본문 규칙 1과 정오표로 확인했고 단축 개정은 2차 자료로만 점검함.
18개월을 12개월로 줄이는 방안이 이후 고시됐는지는 확인되지 않았으며 사용 전 관보 재확인이 필요함.
status adopted_not_yet_applicable은 부분 시행(규칙 1·2·17~21 시행 중) 문서에 대한 단순화이므로 인덱스 필터에 쓸 때 주의.
인용 문구와 앵커는 정정 전 PDF 기준(정정은 문언 수준이라 영향 없음). 힌디 부분(1~23쪽)과의 일치는 확인하지 않음.
language 필드는 en이지만 PDF는 힌디(1~23쪽)와 영어(24~41쪽) 병기본.

documents.title: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (No. 22 of 2023)
documents.issuer: 인도 의회. 법무부 입법국이 관보(Gazette of India, Extraordinary)로 공포
documents.edition: 관보 원문 2023-08-11(법률 제22호), 21쪽, 영어(관보 첫 쪽에 힌디 서식 문구 포함)
documents.key_dates: 대통령 승인과 공포가 2023-08-11이다(관보 첫 쪽). 제1조 제2항에 따라 시행일은 중앙정부가 관보 고시로 정하며 조항별로 다른 날을 정할 수 있다. 시행 고시 원문은 읽지 못했다. 2차 자료(법률사무소 해설, 인도 PIB 설명 자료)는 2025년 11월 중순(13일 또는 14일로 자료마다 다름)에 DPDP 규칙과 함께 시행 고시가 나와 위원회 설치 등 일부 조항이 즉시 시행되고, 동의 관리자 등록 관련 조항이 약 12개월 뒤, 통지·동의·보안 조치·침해 통지·아동·SDF·정보주체 권리·국외 이전 등 핵심 의무 조항이 약 18개월 뒤(2027년 5월경)에 시행되는 단계 시행이라고 전한다. 이 단계별 일정은 관보 원문으로 확인하지 못했으므로 미확인이며, 2026-10-17 현재 핵심 의무 조항은 아직 시행 전일 수 있다.

defect_list.ref: Schedule / s.33 / s.8(5) / s.8(6) / summary_ko / pitfalls_ko
defect_list.description: Penalty caps were 10x too low. The Schedule says 250 crore (rupees 2.5 billion = 25억), 200 crore (20억), 150 crore (15억) and 50 crore (5억). The note wrote 2.5억, 2억, 1.5억 and 0.5억 in the summary, s.8(5), s.8(6), s.33 and the pitfalls. The Schedule row-to-amount mapping itself (1=250, 2=200, 3=200, 4=150, 5=Rs 10,000, 6=as per the s.28 proceedings, 7=50) matches the extract.

Status was 'in_force'. The note's own key_dates say the text read gives only a commencement power (s.1(2)) and the scout's 2025-11-13 claim was unverified. Secondary sources (a law-firm article and a PIB explainer) describe phased commencement from mid-Nov 2025: Board provisions at once, consent-manager provisions after about 12 months, and the core duties (ss.3-17 etc.) after about 18 months, i.e. around May 2027. If so, the duties the note cites were probably not yet applicable on 2026-10-17. The sources disagree on 13 vs 14 November. The official MeitY page is a JS shell with no text and WebFetch returned 403, so I could not read the Gazette commencement notification.

The old key_dates repeated the scout's unverified 2025-11-13 claim and gave no phased schedule. Rewritten to state the assent and publication date of 2023-08-11 (from the Gazette), then the secondary-source phased schedule explicitly marked unconfirmed.

The actor was 'controller' and the strength 'mandatory', but the text says the Central Government 'may, by notification, restrict' transfers. It is a permissive power of the government, and a restriction binds only once notified.
The note said the Board 'imposes' the penalty and set strength to mandatory. The text says the Board 'may' impose it, after an inquiry finds the breach significant and after a hearing.
Strength was 'mandatory', but s.7 is a permission ('may process ... for any of following uses').
A commencement clause was tagged 'mandatory'. It is not an obligation on any actor.

The paraphrase of s.6(6) left out the exception for processing required or authorised by law without consent. s.6(10) applies only where consent is the basis of processing. The ref also cited sub-s.(5), which the obligation does not paraphrase.

The note said the purpose is deemed no longer served if the Data Principal does not 'contact or exercise rights'. The text requires both: she neither approaches the fiduciary nor exercises any right, for a prescribed period (s.8(8)(a) 'and' (b)).
POL-45 (token and API-key recovery) was linked to erasing personal data on consent withdrawal, and the gateway control mentioned token recovery. That is not what the provision requires.
The topic labelled the Data Processor '수탁자', which clashes with the note's term for Data Fiduciary.
'Targeted advertising directed at children' was rendered as '맞춤 광고'.
The ref covered only (2), but the obligation also paraphrases the designation criteria in (1). 'Based in India' was rendered as '상주'.

The text depended on a scout report and did not state what was checked. Checked now: the PDF text has no copyright or reuse statement (searched the extract). The MeitY page is a JS app with no policy text, WebFetch returned 403, and there is no central evidence for India. local-only stays correct.
'한디' corrected to '힌디'. limitations_ko now says the commencement schedule rests on secondary sources.
Added a pitfall that commencement is provision by provision, so the duties cited cannot be assumed to apply on 2026-10-17.

https://www.meity.gov.in/data-protection-framework returned 200 with a JS shell only, and WebFetch got 403. I could not confirm its content, so the title, edition and Act text rest on the Gazette PDF alone (CG-DL-E-12082023-248045, assent 11 Aug 2023, Act No. 22 of 2023, which matches the note).

doc_level_changes: status changed from in_force to partially_in_force
key_dates rewritten (phased commencement from secondary sources, marked unconfirmed)
summary_ko and pitfalls_ko penalty amounts corrected (250/200/150/50 crore rupees = 25억/20억/15억/5억)
new pitfall on provision-by-provision commencement
license_notice and distribution_reason now state the evidence checked (no licence text in the PDF, MeitY page unreadable, no central evidence for India); distribution stays local-only
reading_scope_ko left unchanged (honest: ss.1-10, 16-17, 33 and the Schedule read; ss.11-15, 18-32 and 35-44 not read)
limitations_ko updated: Hindi spelling fixed, commencement schedule rests on secondary sources
remaining_concerns: The phased commencement dates (about 12 and about 18 months after mid-Nov 2025) come from secondary sources that disagree on 13 vs 14 November. The Gazette commencement notification was not read, so the exact sections and dates need confirming against the official e-Gazette PDF.
The official page (meity.gov.in) could not be read (JS shell, 403), so the status check did not use an official page.
The gateway_control_ko lines are mostly written as present-tense capabilities (for example 'blocks', 'records'). They are candidate controls, not claims that MINT complies with the law.
Sections 11-15, 18-32 and 35-44 were not read by the lead, and I did not read them in depth either, so nothing in the note rests on them.

documents.title: Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 (c. 18)
documents.issuer: 영국 의회. legislation.gov.uk(국립기록원) 게재
documents.edition: 법률 원문(as enacted) PDF, 2025년 제18장, 276쪽
documents.key_dates: 법 본문 표기 날짜는 2025-06-19(국왕 재가)이다. 제142조에 따라 이 법은 일부를 제외하고 국무장관이 규정으로 정하는 날에 시행된다. 예외로 제66조(정의), 제78조, 제126~128조(생체정보 보존), 제8부, 규정 제정 권한 조항 등은 재가 당일(제142조 제2항), 제69조·제82조·제96조·제97조는 재가 후 2개월이 끝날 때(같은 조 제3항) 시행된다. 시행 규정 SI 2026/82(제6호, 2026-01-29 제정; legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2026/82/made에서 확인)에 따라 제70조·제80조·제81조·제85조와 부칙 4·6·7은 2026-02-05에, 제103조와 부칙 10은 2026-06-19에 시행된다(이미 시행된 부분 제외). 제80조·부칙 6의 개정은 2026-02-05 이전에 내려진 결정(구 UK GDPR 제22조 제3항 등이 적용되던 결정)에는 적용되지 않고, 2018년 법 제164A조 제3·4항의 의무는 2026-06-19 이후 접수된 불만에만 적용된다. 이 노트가 인용하지 않은 조항의 시행일은 확인하지 않았다.

defect_list.description: Commencement of s.80 was attributed to an unnamed scouting report (2026-02-05 / SI 2026/82) and explicitly not verified; s.103 and the other cited sections had no commencement date; the text used internal workflow wording. Verified at legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2026/82/made (Commencement No. 6, made 2026-01-29, C.10): ss.70, 80, 81, 85 and Schedules 4, 6, 7 commence 2026-02-05; s.103 and Schedule 10 commence 2026-06-19. Reg. 5 saves decisions taken before 2026-02-05 from s.80/Sch 6; reg. 7 applies s.164A(3)-(4) only to complaints received on or after 2026-06-19. Also confirmed s.142(2)/(3) day-of-Assent and two-month commencement lists in the PDF text.

Claimed the Act affects overseas businesses targeting UK data subjects (territorial scope); nothing in the read extract supports this. Replaced with a statement that the amended UK GDPR Art. 3 scope was not checked. Also 'PECR' normalised to 'PEC 규정'.

Comparison with the pre-amendment UK GDPR Art. 22 and EU GDPR Art. 22 came from memory, not from the extract (the Act only says 'for Article 22 substitute'). Rewritten to what Arts. 22B/22C actually say and marked the comparison as unconfirmed.
'아동 대상 서비스' overstated s.81 / Art. 25(1A), which covers information society services likely to be accessed by children.

Notice did not state what the staged PDF itself carries; reason included an irrelevant file-size remark. Verified the legislation.gov.uk footer (OGL v3.0 except where otherwise stated; additional EUR-Lex content under Decision 2011/833/EU, not applicable to a UK Act) and the PDF's own '(c) Crown copyright 2025 / printed and published by TSO under King's Printer authority' notice with no extra restriction. Distribution public-under-license kept; notice and reason rewritten to state exactly this evidence and the OGL attribution duty.

Stated commencement regulations were not read (now SI 2026/82 regs 2-7 were checked); s.70 and Schedule 4 were read but s.70 not listed. Updated; other commencement regs and consolidated text remain unread.

Commencement power ('comes into force on such day as the Secretary of State may by regulations appoint') was tagged strength=mandatory; it is not an obligation. Changed to informative; gateway_control wording tightened.

Anchor matched both UK GDPR Art. 22A and 2018 Act s.50A (non-unique); replaced by a phrase unique to Art. 22A(1). Para 2 omitted 'among other things'. gateway_control implied that a per-request approval step settles 'meaningful human involvement'; reworded as a configurable option with the legal question left open.

'법적 필요' did not match 'required or authorised by law'; (ea) restriction omitted 'entirely or partly'; topic implied exceptions for Art. 22B(4), which has none. Corrected obligation_ko and topic; gateway_control softened to 'can be configured'.

Anchor also matched 2018 Act s.50C(2)(c); replaced with phrase unique to Art. 22C(1). Obligation omitted that safeguards must also comply with regulations under Art. 22D(3). gateway_control said MINT 'provides' evidence including decision inputs; reworded to ledger of calls/approvals that can serve as reference.

Secretary of State power ('may by regulations') tagged mandatory; changed to informative. Obligation said regulations cannot amend Art. 22C generally, but Art. 22D(4) limits this to regulations under para 3. Anchor 'Regulations under this Article are subject to the affirmative resolution' occurs three times in the extract; replaced by a phrase unique to Art. 22D(1).

Ref did not locate the anchor (it sits in Art. 6(5) inserted by s.70(4)); power to amend Annex 1 was stated without its conditions (paras 7-10, affirmative procedure). gateway_control asserted an intake field exists. All reworded; examples (crime, vulnerable individual, emergency) confirmed in Schedule 4.
gateway_control stated the intake setting as done; reworded as supporting option. Added pitfall that 'information society services' excludes preventive or counselling services (Art. 25(5)).

Omitted that complaints can also concern Part 3 of the 2018 Act, and gave no commencement limit. Added Part 3, and put in timing_ko that s.164A(3)-(4) duties apply only to complaints received on or after 2026-06-19 (SI 2026/82 reg. 7). 30-day acknowledgement and 'without undue delay' otherwise confirmed.

Paraphrase made the data protection test an objective precondition; the text says the Secretary of State may only make regulations if the SoS considers the test is met, and the comparison to Parts 5-7 is limited to 'so far as relevant to general processing'. Anchor also matched Schedule 8 (law enforcement, s.74AB) - replaced with a phrase unique to Art. 45B(1). gateway_control claimed country-level blocking; reworded as a customer-configurable option and noted this provision binds government, not controllers.

scope_ko territorial claim removed

documents.title: Act on Promotion of Research and Development, and Utilization of Artificial Intelligence-related Technology (Act No. 53 of June 4, 2025) — English translation
documents.title_native: 人工知能関連技術の研究開発及び活用の推進に関する法律
documents.issuer: 일본 국회. 영어 번역은 법무성 일본 법령 번역 데이터베이스(비공식 번역)
documents.key_dates: 법률 제53호는 2025-06-04 공포(제목의 법률 번호 날짜, 내각부 페이지도 같은 날 공포·일부 시행으로 안내). 부칙 제1조는 공포일 시행을 원칙으로 하되 제3장·제4장과 부칙 제3조·제4조는 공포일부터 3개월을 넘지 않는 범위에서 정령으로 정하는 날에 시행한다고 정한다. 내각부 AI 법 페이지(https://www8.cao.go.jp/cstp/ai/ai_act/ai_act.html, 2026-10-17 열람)는 9월 1일에 AI 전략본부 설치 규정 등을 포함해 전면 시행됐다고 안내한다(페이지에 연도 표기는 없고 문맥상 2025년). 정령 원문은 읽지 않았다.

defect_list.description: The note called the Art. 7 business duty a 'duty to endeavor to cooperate'. The English text and the Japanese original (協力しなければならない) say utilization business operators 'must cooperate' with national and local government measures. Only the efficiency and new-industry part is an endeavor duty. Also a wrong claim that business obligations are limited to endeavor-to-cooperate.

obligation_ko said the guidelines are the legal basis of business soft-law guidelines. Art. 13 only says the national government is to establish guidelines in line with international norms and take other measures. gateway_control_ko also asserted a link to LIB-M42 as a basis for Japanese customer requirements, and pitfalls repeated the soft-law-basis claim. The text does not support the link.

'규제 강화 여부는 이 검토에서 달라질 수 있다' appears nowhere in the text. The article only requires a review of how the Act is in effect and, if the government finds it necessary, measures based on the result. Removed it. Also removed gateway_control_ko wording that described a customer-requirements check as an existing practice.

The note contained the leaked process wording '스카우트 단계 ... 보고했으며 이 노트에서 확인하지 않았다' and an unverified 2025-09-01 date. The Cabinet Office page I fetched says the Act was promulgated and partly in force on 2025-06-04 (令和7年6月4日) and fully in force on 9月1日, including the Strategic Headquarters provisions. The page prints no year, so 2025 is inferred from context. Rewrote key_dates with the source and the caveat. The Cabinet Order itself was not read.

The note said the terms page was unreadable (HTTP 401) and set local-only. The scout had probed /en/index/logo-use, the wrong page. https://www.japaneselawtranslation.go.jp/en/index/terms returned HTTP 200 and says content on the site is under the Public Data License v1.0 (PDL1.0) unless stated otherwise, with copyright held by the Ministry of Justice. PDL1.0, read on digital.go.jp, permits free commercial use, copying, public transmission, translation and modification. Conditions: source citation, an edited-statement and no misrepresentation as an unaltered original, and third-party rights. The logo is excluded. The staged PDF has no contrary notice. Rewrote license_notice and distribution_reason and set distribution to public-under-license with attribution conditions.

The English text is passive ('measures must be implemented') with no stated addressee. The Japanese uses 施策が講じられなければならない, policy measures, and Art. 4(1) puts the duty to implement measures under the basic principles on the national government. Kept actor=authority but added to obligation_ko that it is an addressee-less basic principle with no direct business duty. Softened gateway_control_ko, which claimed the ledger 'provides' transparency evidence. The POL-38 link is plausible and kept.
A commencement clause is not an obligation, so strength 'mandatory' overstated it. Changed to informative. Dates and the Chapter III/IV proviso are correct.
gateway_control_ko referred to a Japan customer intake form AI classification criterion that is not established. Reduced to 해당 없음(정의 규정).

topic_ko said '즉시 공표' but the text says 'without delay' (지체 없이). The ref pointed to the whole article while the anchor sits in para. (4). Tightened to paras. (1), (3), (4). Removed the gateway_control_ko wording that implied a customer-requirements re-check.

The note said the end of Supplementary Arts. 3-4 was not read. I read the whole extract and compared the Japanese original on the official page for Arts. 3(4), 7, 13, 16, 18 and Suppl. Arts. 1-2. Updated the reading scope and added a limitation on how amendments were checked as of 2026-10-17.

doc_level_changes: key_dates: replaced the unverified scouting statement with the Cabinet Office page (promulgated and partly in force 2025-06-04, fully in force 9月1日, year inferred) and the Suppl. Art. 1 proviso
summary_ko, scope_ko, pitfalls_ko: Art. 7 corrected from 'endeavor to cooperate' to 'must cooperate' plus an endeavor duty on efficiency; removed the unsupported soft-law-basis claim
reading_scope_ko, limitations_ko: updated
license_notice: rewritten from the JLT terms page (PDL1.0) and the PDL1.0 text
distribution: local-only -> public-under-license (PDL1.0, attribution, edited-statement for the extract, no logo)

unchanged and confirmed: title, title_native, issuer, jurisdiction JP, instrument_type statute, binding true, edition, language en, official_page_url (HTTP 200); status in_force is consistent with the Cabinet Office page (the JLT page shows no later amendment)
remaining_concerns: The English translation is non-official and not a legal text; only the Japanese text has legal effect (JLT terms).
The Cabinet Order setting the effective date of Chapters III and IV was not read. The Cabinet Office page gives 9月1日 without a year, so 2025 is inferred.

Distribution switched to public-under-license rests on the JLT terms page and PDL1.0 (read in the English reference version; the Japanese version is the official one). Redistribution must carry the source citation (JLT/MOJ, page URL, PDL1.0) and mark the text extract as a processed derivative. The lead may want to confirm this reading of PDL1.0.
Only 8 provisions, the checker minimum, because the Act is a promotion law with few operational duties. Arts. 4-6, 8-12, 14-15, 17 and 19-28 are not covered by provisions (low gateway relevance).
The cross-reference to LIB-M42 was removed; any legal link between the Act's guidelines (Art. 13) and the AI Guidelines for Business is not established by this text.

documents.title: Privacy and Other Legislation Amendment Act 2024 (Act No. 128 of 2024)
documents.issuer: 호주 연방의회(국왕 재가 2024-12-10). 연방 법령 등록부(Federal Register of Legislation) 게재, 등록부 표시상 소관 부처는 법무부(Attorney-General's Department)
documents.edition: Authorised Version C2024A00128(2024-12-13 등록), 87쪽. 개정 전 원문(as made)
documents.key_dates: 제2조 시행표(제3열 날짜는 법의 일부가 아님): 제1~4조와 표에 없는 나머지는 국왕 재가일(표시 2024-12-10), 부칙 1 제1~7부·제8부(항목 45~58)·제9~14부는 재가 다음 날 또는 그 직후(표시 2024-12-11), 부칙 1 제15부(자동화된 결정과 프라이버시 정책)는 재가일로부터 24개월 기간이 끝난 다음 날(표시 2026-12-10), 부칙 2(중대한 프라이버시 침해)는 포고로 정한 날이며 재가일부터 6개월 안에 시행되지 않으면 그 기간 다음 날(법 본문 계산상 늦어도 2025-06-10), 부칙 3은 재가 다음 날(표시 2024-12-11) 시행이다. 연방 법령 등록부 조회(2026-10-17)에서 이 법은 In force(2024-12-10 시작)로 표시되고 상태 이력에 예정된 변경은 없으며, 개인정보법 통합본 이력에는 2026-12-10 시작 예정 버전이 있다. 따라서 2026-10-17 기준 법 전체는 시행 중이나 제15부(자동화된 결정 투명성)만 아직 시행 전이다.

defect_list.description: status was adopted_not_yet_applicable for the whole Act. Federal Register page and API (2026-10-17) show In force since 2024-12-10, with most Schedule 1 Parts commenced 2024-12-11 and Schedule 3 on 2024-12-11. Only Part 15 (ADM) is still pending until 2026-12-10.

Note said no reuse evidence could be found. The official Federal Register of Legislation terms of use (fetched 2026-10-17) state CC BY 4.0 for register content except the Commonwealth Coat of Arms and anything noted otherwise, with attribution conditions. The staged PDF embeds the Coat of Arms on PDF pp.1 and 5, so distribution of the PDF as acquired stays local-only, but the reason was wrong.

Listed Schedule 1 Parts 1-7 and 9-14 as commencing 2024-12-11 but omitted Part 8 (items 45-58, table items 3-5). Gave no outcome for Schedule 2, which by the 6-month backstop commences no later than 2025-06-10. Did not record that the register shows the Act In force.
Text says the decision 'could reasonably be expected to significantly affect' rights or interests. Note said it merely 'could' have a significant effect, dropping the reasonable-expectation test.

gateway_control_ko said the ledger identifies decision-related calls and 'provides' aggregates of decision kinds. This claims capability and implies the gateway can classify decisions. Rewritten as candidate reference material, with the decision judgement left to the customer.

Obligation text described APP 11.1/11.2 as security and destruction/de-identification duties and used 'reasonable steps'. The PDF contains only 'such steps include technical and organisational measures' and not the 11.1/11.2 text. Reworded to what the text says and flagged that the 11.1/11.2 body must be checked in the consolidated Act. Also the summary_ko mention of 합리적 조치.
gateway_control_ko promised to 'provide' evidence of the customer's reasonable steps, close to a compliance claim. Reworded as evidence candidates, with sufficiency left to the customer.

APP 8.3 is a conditional sub-clause (inserted as an APP 8.2 alternative by item 37), not a 'mandatory' duty on a controller. The only 'must' is on the Minister (s 100(1A)).
